title: Chef de produit digital F/H
descriptionHtml:
LIANAKA est une filiale du Groupe Fondasol, spécialiste de l’ingénierie conseil de la construction.

Allier le meilleur des données de sols, de l’IA et de l’analyse humaine dans une plateforme technologiquement avancée, pour permettre aux porteurs de projets de construction d’anticiper les risques et de saisir les opportunités liées à l'environnement des sites de leurs projets : tel est l’engagement de LIANAKA.

Dès la recherche foncière, notre plateforme délivre aux acteurs de la construction un accès direct à une information globale, qualifiée et synthétique des risques et opportunités du sous-sol.

Chaque phase du projet est également l’opportunité d’optimiser les hypothèses techniques et les solutions de travaux.

Les bénéfices directs pour nos clients? Une fiabilité des données du sous-sol optimisée, sur les critères eau, pollution des sols, géotechnique et géothermie. Une meilleure anticipation et maitrise de leurs projets. Des décisions prises plus rapidement. Une identification immédiate des gains financiers. Une contribution à l’empreinte environnementale des projets. Le tout dans un environnement digital convivial et agile.

Soyez le pivot stratégique de notre transformation numérique : entre expertise technique et performance commerciale, portez le succès d'une solution SaaS qui révolutionne l'analyse des risques de la construction.

Le Projet

Dans le cadre de notre développement numérique, le Groupe FONDASOL a déployé une plateforme SaaS innovante LIANAKA dédiée à la modélisation et l’analyse des risques du sous-sol. Elle offre aux acteurs de la construction une information fiable, rapide et optimisée en amont de leurs projets.

Vos missions

En tant que Chef de Produit, vous êtes le chef d'orchestre de cette solution et votre rôle est transverse :

  1. Comprendre le terrain et l'attente de nos clients

  2. Piloter la technique et l'évolution de la plateforme

  3. Booster le business et la commercialisation de cet outil

Rattaché à la Direction Commerciale et sous la responsabilité du Responsable de la Filiale Digitale, vous êtes au cœur de notre stratégie de croissance et de transformation digitale.

  • Vous pilotez la croissance du produit en contribuant à sa stratégie commerciale et aux argumentaires commerciaux, tout en accompagnant les équipes marketing et ventes dans le lancement des nouveautés et l'optimisation des performances via le suivi des KPI (adoption, usages, ventes, satisfaction client).

  • Vous êtes le trait d’union entre les clients, les équipes techniques et commerciales

  • Vous sensibilisez les équipes interne aux enjeux du digital tout en étant force de proposition pour optimiser les processus et l’expérience utilisateur.

Ce que nous vous offrons ?

  • La possibilité de participer à la création et au déploiement d’un produit numérique innovant à fort impact

  • Être au cœur de la transformation digitale du Groupe

  • Travailler sur des enjeux concrets liés à l’aménagement du territoire et à la gestion des risques

  • Bénéficier d’une forte autonomie et d’un rôle stratégique dans le développement du produit


Votre profil

  • Issu d'une formation Bac+5 (Ingénieur, Commerce ou Université) avec une spécialisation en digital ou innovation

  • Vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée de 3 à 7 ans en tant que Product Manager, idéalement sur un produit SaaS.

  • Curieux, rigoureux et attiré par l'innovation à fort impact terrain, vous disposez idéalement d'une connaissance du secteur de la construction, du BTP ou de l'aménagement.

  • Doté d'un fort esprit entrepreneurial et d'une grande autonomie, vous maîtrisez le pilotage de produits numériques (roadmap, MVP, itérations) et possédez une réelle capacité à vulgariser des sujets techniques ou data complexes.

  • Votre sens business et votre orientation résultats vous permettent de structurer une offre performante, tandis que votre aisance relationnelle fait de vous un leader naturel pour travailler en transverse avec des profils variés (ingénieurs, dev, commerciaux).

Les qualités qui feront votre réussite

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne avenante, communicante et orientée terrain. Vous aimez aller à la rencontre des clients, comprendre leurs enjeux et créer du lien avec des interlocuteurs variés.

Curieux(se) et proactif(ve), vous ne restez pas derrière votre bureau : vous prenez naturellement l'initiative d'échanger avec les utilisateurs pour identifier les freins à l'adoption de la plateforme et recueillir les retours du terrain.

Grâce à votre excellent relationnel, vous êtes aussi à l'aise avec les clients qu'avec les équipes internes ou les membres du CODIR. Vous savez écouter, convaincre, fédérer et transformer les besoins exprimés en pistes d'amélioration concrètes pour le produit.

title: Chemical Lab Technician – Semiconductor (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Build Europe's semiconductor future with us!

Join us during the exciting build-up phase of one of Europe’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites in Dresden. As a Chemical Laboratory Technician, you will ensure the highest purity standards across our manufacturing processes. Working with state-of-the-art analytical equipment, you will analyze chemicals, ultra-pure water, and cleanroom air impurities that directly safeguard our semiconductor yield. You bridge advanced trace analysis with active engineering support in a modern, 24/7 high-tech manufacturing environment.


Job Responsibilities
  • Routine & Trace Analysis: Perform testing on routine samples (process chemicals, ultra-pure water, and cleanroom air) following strict Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Instrument Operations: Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot advanced analytical tools (e.g., ICP-MS, Ion Chromatography, GC-MS).
  • Data Collection & Reporting: Evaluate test results, compile accurate data, and generate analytical quality reports for internal engineering teams and external partners.
  • Engineering Support: Collaborate with engineers on experimental design, method optimization, and new process qualifications.
  • Tool Maintenance & Calibration: Perform routine calibrations, basic maintenance, and quality gating to ensure maximum laboratory tool uptime.
  • Safety & Compliance: Uphold the highest laboratory safety protocols and maintain a clean, organized, and compliant workspace.
  • Shift Collaboration: Ensure seamless 24/7 lab support by working within a rotating day/night shift schedule.
  • Training & Mentorship: Assist in onboarding and sharing best practices with new team members.

Your profile

Must Have  

  • Completed 3-year vocational training as a Chemical Laboratory Technician (Chemielaborant), Chemical Technical Assistant (CTA), Physical Technical Assistant (PTA), or a comparable technical qualification.
  • 0–3 years of professional experience in an analytical laboratory, manufacturing, or quality control environment (career starters are welcome).
  • Familiarity with standard PC operations and MS Office (Excel, Word).
  • Willingness to work in a rotating day/night shift model.
  • Readiness to complete an intensive ~6-month on-the-job training program in Taiwan during your onboarding to gain hands-on equipment expertise and build an international network.
  • Fluent English skills (written and spoken); German communication skills are an advantage.

Nice to Have  

  • Hands-on experience with analytical instruments such as ICP-MS, IC, or GC-MS.
  • Prior experience in the semiconductor, pharmaceutical, chemical, or cleanroom-regulated industries.
  • Basic programming or data-automation skills.

Reasons to join ESMC
  • Security & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs.
  • Company Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).
  • Relocation Support for Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the support you will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden.
  • Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center, gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training, while you continuously expand your knowledge.
  • Health & Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit.
  • Meals & Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket).

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one. 

What we offer you

As our Chief Commercial Officer, you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in our HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never-ending growth curve, we provide you with:

What we expect from you

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Start date

Flexible 

Monday - Friday we work from our office (next to Victoria Station) and do not offer remote work.

title: Chief of Staff
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. Each track operates as a mini-business, empowered with dedicated resources (e.g., product marketing, data analytics, and operational support) and direct accountability for performance.

 

Why this role exists

Pennylane is one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs, building the financial operating system for SMBs and their accountants. As the company grows, the quality of its execution depends increasingly on how well its leadership team sets priorities, makes decisions, and follows through across the organization.
This role makes that system work. You’ll work directly with the VP Strategic Initiatives and closely with the executive committee to bring structure and momentum to Pennylane’s most important company-wide rhythms, from OKRs and leadership meetings to cross-functional steering and Board preparation.

This is not a traditional strategy role or a position observing executives from the sidelines. It is a high-leverage operating role for someone who enjoys creating clarity, improving how teams work together, and making sure important decisions turn into action.

 

What you'll own

You’ll help the executive team operate with greater focus, clarity, and consistency. That means:

  • Running our leadership rhythms. Structure the agendas, preparation, and follow-through for key executive and leadership forums. Make sure the right topics are discussed at the right time and that decisions, owners, and next steps are clear

  • Turning priorities into an operating cadence. Help coordinate the definition, cascade, and tracking of company OKRs. Maintain a clear view of progress and surface misalignment or execution risks early

  • Strengthening cross-functional follow-through. Bring consistency to how major company initiatives are reviewed through steering committees and executive reporting—without replacing the leaders accountable for delivering them

  • Preparing high-stakes moments. Coordinate the materials and inputs required for Board meetings, executive offsites, annual planning, and company-wide communications

  • Improving the system. Identify where information gets lost, decisions stall, or responsibilities are unclear, and design lightweight processes that help the organization move faster

Who we're looking for

  • 3–7 years of experience in top-tier management consulting and/or an operating role in a fast-growing company, with evidence of an exceptional trajectory

  • Outstanding organizational judgment—you can distinguish what requires executive attention from what should be resolved elsewhere

  • A structured, concise communicator who can turn complex and fragmented inputs into a clear agenda, decision, or executive-level document

  • Strong interpersonal skills and low ego. You are comfortable coordinating senior stakeholders, challenging constructively, and creating accountability without relying on formal authority

  • High attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. You anticipate what is needed, close loops, and reliably follow through

  • Comfortable operating behind the scenes and measuring success through the effectiveness of the broader team

  • Fluent in French and English

This role is designed as a launchpad into a broader operating position at Pennylane. It is a strong fit for someone early in an ambitious career who wants unusual exposure to how a scale-up operates and is motivated to turn that exposure into tangible organizational impact.

Recruitment process

Screening with Orane, Senior Business Recruiter (30 min)

Interview with Eric, VP Strategic Initiatives (1h)

Take-home business case, presented live (1h)

Final interview with a founder (45 min)

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

Domain Expertise & Thought Leadership

title: Commercial Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About us

At STRATOS Technologies, we are transforming how companies make data-driven decisions. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, enabling businesses to strengthen their long-term strategies through clear and actionable insights.

Our founders, former business and tech executives who led a $1B division at a Fortune 500 industrial company, originally built a digital twin of their enterprise to drive synchronized planning and execution. Seeing the market’s lack of such a system, they launched STRATOS in 2022 with a bold mission: to unifiy all internal and external data into a single platform.

Today, STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup funded extensively by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by nearly a dozen global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.

From commercial AI agents to embedded intelligence that supercharges lean teams, STRATOS enables businesses to achieve 10x productivity and strengthen long-term strategies through actionable insights. We are now expanding our team to accelerate our growth even further and help our customers outperform their competition

The role. You own a piece of the relationship with one of our customers: their data, their questions, and whether the product answers them. You will do the analysis, present it to their commercial leadership, and take what you learn back to our engineers as something we should build. The difference from where you are now is that you stay with it. You see whether the recommendation worked, and when it doesn't, you're the one who fixes it.

The roles you'll play

  • Owner of a workstream — take a defined part of the deployment end to end: the market model, the target list or the scoring logic, from first data through to something the customer's teams use every week.

  • Advisor to the customer's commercial team — run working sessions with sales and commercial leadership, present your own analysis, and handle the challenge yourself. You are in the room, not behind it.

  • Co-owner of the account — you share the relationship with a senior CPM and take on more of it as the year goes on, up to running a customer of your own.

  • Voice of the customer in our roadmap — turn what you see in the field into what we build, and stay with it through the roadmap until it ships.

  • Builder of how we work — sharpen the standards, templates and tooling that make the next deployment better than the last.

Who this is for. Most people who do well here have one to three years behind them in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or an analytical commercial role.

  • You have run a workstream yourself: not just the analysis, but the stakeholder who didn't want to give you the data and the deadline that moved.

  • You are quick in data and you check your own numbers. Excel and PowerPoint are assumed; any SQL or Python is a bonus, not a requirement, and we'll teach you what you need.

  • You can present to people twenty years your senior without either deferring to them or lecturing them.

  • You are curious about how industrial businesses actually work — how a building-materials group reaches its customers, why a distributor behaves the way it does.

  • You want more responsibility than your peers get, and you understand that comes with being the one who is wrong in public sometimes.

This probably isn't for you if you want to specialise early, or if you'd rather be handed a defined analysis than decide what the right question is.

What we offer

  • Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company

  • A highly competitive salary

  • Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for

  • Work alongside former MBB consultants and Fortune 500 executives who will teach you directly — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum

  • Private healthcare

  • Pension scheme

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays

  • Work from abroad — up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time

  • Hybrid office policy, with visa sponsorship available

  • A company committed to social and environmental responsibility — we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes

Practicalities

  • London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office

  • Travel to some customer sites around, mostly within Europe

  • German is genuinely useful here and several of our customers are German-speaking, but it is not a requirement

The process

  • Beratungskompetenz: Erweitere deine Beratungsfähigkeiten, um Kundenbedürfnisse zu analysieren und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen zu entwickeln, die den Mehrwert und den Umsatz steigern.
  • Business Case Entwicklung: Lerne, überzeugende Business Cases zu erstellen, die die Vorteile deiner Lösungen klar kommunizieren und intern wie extern verteidigt werden können.
  • Accountanalyse: Vertiefe dein Verständnis für die Analyse von Kundenaccounts, um Potenziale für Upselling und Cross-Selling zu erkennen und zu nutzen.

Mittelfristige Entwicklung:

  • Key Account Management: Nachdem du Erfahrung in den oben genannten Bereichen gesammelt hast, steigst du in das Key Account Management auf, wo du strategische Verantwortung für die Betreuung und Entwicklung unserer größten und umsatzstärksten Kunden übernimmst. Deine Aufgabe wird es sein, langfristige Beziehungen zu pflegen und die Umsatzverantwortung für diese wichtigen Accounts zu tragen.

Langfristige Karriereperspektiven:

  • Führungspositionen: Langfristig bietet sich die Möglichkeit, in Führungspositionen innerhalb des Vertriebs, des Customer Success oder des Business Development aufzusteigen. In diesen Rollen übernimmst du die Leitung von Teams oder Abteilungen, entwickelst strategische Initiativen zur Geschäftsentwicklung und treibst das Unternehmenswachstum voran.

What's in it for you

Leistungsorientierte Boni: Erhalte quartalsweise ausgeschüttete Boni bei Erreichung deiner Ziele, um deinen Erfolg direkt zu belohnen.
Verwirklichung statt politische Entscheidungen: Entfalte dein Potenzial in einer Unternehmenskultur, die Eigenverantwortung schätzt und datengetriebene Entscheidungen fördert.
Dynamisches Lernen: Entwickle dich stetig weiter mit Zugang zu Büchern, Coachings und LinkedIn Learning – alles ohne Angst vor Fehlern.
Ausgezeichnete Arbeitsumgebung: Als mehrfach ausgezeichnetes Top-Unternehmen bieten wir ein Umfeld, das berufliches Wachstum unterstützt und Wertschätzung garantiert.
Flexibilität und Chancengleichheit: Nutze flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit der Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice. Bei uns zählt dein Beitrag, unabhängig von deiner Position.
Hundefreundliches Büro: Bringe deinen Hund mit – bei uns sind alle Familienmitglieder willkommen.
Gemeinsame Feiern: Erlebe, wie wir Erfolge bei Teamevents, von Sommerfesten bis Weinwanderungen, gemeinsam feiern.

How you can make an impact

Als Customer Success Manager bist du für das kontinuierliche Account Management, das heißt für die bestmögliche Nutzung und den Kundenumsatz verantwortlich. Deine Hauptaufgaben umfassen:

Kontinuierliches Account Management:

  • Durchführung von Jour Fixes zur Analyse der Kundenzufriedenheit, Nutzungsevaluation und aktuellen Herausforderungen.
  • Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Vorschläge und Kommunikationsstrategien, basierend auf spezifischen Kundenbedürfnissen.
  • Anfertigung von Business Case Narratives zur internen Verteidigung unserer Lösungen.
  • Durchführung kundenübergreifender Webinare und kundenspezifischer Workshops.

Management des Sales Cycles:

  • Upselling: Identifizierung zusätzlicher Bedürfnisse im Kundenunternehmen.
  • Retention: Sicherstellung der Kundenbindung und der Vertragsfortsetzung.

Netzwerk- und Stakeholder-Management:

  • Ausweitung des Netzwerks innerhalb des Kundenunternehmens durch Identifikation und Ansprache neuer relevanter Ansprechpartner.

Skills to be successful

  • Vertriebsorientierung und Vernetzungsfähigkeit: Freude an der Vernetzung mit neuen und bekannten Ansprechpartnern. Außerdem ein Challenger-Mindset, um selbstbewusst und mutig im Umgang mit unseren Kunden zu handeln.
  • Kommunikative Fähigkeiten: Eloquenz und Wortgewandtheit, gepaart mit der Fähigkeit, Kundeninteressen zu verstehen und zu vertreten.
  • Struktur und Genauigkeit: Ein strukturierter Arbeitsansatz und Genauigkeit in allen Aufgabenbereichen, unterstützt durch eine starke Eigenverantwortung und eine datengetriebene Arbeitsweise.
  • Lernbereitschaft: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft, Kommunikation, Medien oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung sind wünschenswert. Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Kundenbetreuung, Vertrieb, Marketing, HR oder Consulting sind von Vorteil aber kein Muss. Erforderliche Fähigkeiten können schnell gelernt und schrittweise vertieft werden.

Über uns

Wir bauen das intelligente Rückgrat für die Wirtschaft von übermorgen.

Omnora ist die treibende Kraft der Intelligence Economy. Wir lösen eines der drängendsten Probleme der modernen Wirtschaft: Den massiven Wissensverlust durch den demografischen Wandel und das Scheitern herkömmlicher Wissensmanagementsysteme. Während andere lediglich auf KI-Modelle setzen, liefern wir den entscheidenden Treibstoff dafür: Menschliche Erfahrung.

Wir glauben an eine Zukunft, in der Unternehmen zu intelligenten Organismen werden. Unsere Mission ist es, individuelles Erfahrungswissen aus den Köpfen zu entkoppeln und in ein selbstlernendes Unternehmensgedächtnis zu überführen. So erschaffen wir eine hybride Intelligenz, in der menschliches Know-how und KI nahtlos verschmelzen. Wir machen Wissen nicht nur verfügbar, sondern im Moment der Entscheidung operativ nutzbar, rund um die Uhr und in Echtzeit. Das ist für uns die wahre AI-Readiness.

Was du bei uns erlebst?

  • Echte Wirkung: Wir stoppen die „organisatorische Amnesie“ und sichern die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit namhafter Kunden vom Mittelstand bis zum Großkonzern.
  • Stabilität & Unabhängigkeit: Wir wachsen profitabel, sind unabhängig von externen Investoren und handeln mit einer langfristigen, nachhaltigen Perspektive.
  • Technologische Speerspitze: Von automatisierten Experteninterviews bis hin zu prozessintegrierten KI-Agenten, wir bauen die Infrastruktur, die den Unterschied macht.

Bei Omnora triffst du auf ein hochambitioniertes Team, das Prinzipien wie Ownership, Integrität und Exzellenz tatsächlich lebt. Wir glauben an radikale Klarheit, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und das ständige Streben nach dem besseren Weg.

Wir bieten dir kein Umfeld zum „Verwalten“, sondern zum Gestalten. Wenn du Lust hast, Verantwortung für echte Innovation zu übernehmen und in einem Umfeld zu arbeiten, das dich fordert und fördert, dann ist Omnora dein nächster Schritt.

Werde Teil der Intelligence Economy. Willkommen bei Omnora!

title: Customer Support (part-time)
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

title: Data-Analyst (m/w/d) in SaaS-Startup (Remote / Hybrid)
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind cinify – ein junges, KI-getriebenes Start-up, das das Gesundheitswesen datenintelligent macht. Wir verbinden Praxisverwaltungs-, Radiologie- und Terminsysteme, führen ihre Daten zusammen und machen daraus Dashboards, Reports und zunehmend KI-gestützte Anwendungen, die Praxen und Radiologiezentren wirklich weiterbringen.

Wir denken AI-first. Ein Großteil unseres Codes, unserer SQL-Queries und Dashboards entsteht heute schon mit KI, und genau so wollen wir weiterwachsen. Wir suchen Menschen, die KI nicht als Spielerei sehen, sondern als selbstverständliches Werkzeug, mit dem sie schneller, besser und kreativer arbeiten.

In deiner Rolle arbeitest du eng mit Kunden aus dem Gesundheitswesen zusammen, nimmst ihre Anforderungen auf und entwickelst mit SQL und KI maßgeschneiderte Lösungen. Dabei bist du nicht nur technischer Umsetzer, sondern auch Projektmanager, der seine Projekte eigenständig organisiert und zum Erfolg führt.

Tipp: Auf unserer Webseite unter „Jobs“ findest du ein kurzes Video, in dem unsere Data Analysts von ihrem Job erzählen. Schau gern vorbei!

Aufgaben

Als Data-Analyst bei cinify ist es Deine Aufgabe, komplexe Sachverhalte möglichst greifbar und verständlich für unsere Kunden aufzubereiten.

  • Du stehst im direkten Kundenkontakt, berätst und setzt Anforderungen direkt um.

  • Du baust Dashboards, Reports und Workflows und nutzt dafür konsequent KI-Tools, um vom Datenmodell bis zum fertigen Dashboard schneller ans Ziel zu kommen.

  • Du integrierst, validierst und optimierst Daten aus unterschiedlichsten Quellsystemen.

  • Du entwickelst unser Produkt aktiv weiter, inklusive neuer KI-Anwendungen für unsere Kunden.

  • Du arbeitest im Team an Standardlösungen für den Gesundheitsmarkt und hilfst dabei, unsere AI-first-Arbeitsweise stetig zu verbessern.

Qualifikation

Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, bringst Du folgende Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium und/oder erste Berufserfahrung im kaufmännischen oder IT-Bereich

  • Routinierter Umgang mit SQL

  • Erfahrung mit BI-Lösungen wie Power BI, Qlik oder Tableau

  • Praktische Erfahrung im Arbeiten mit KI-Tools (z. B. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) und Lust, deinen Arbeitsalltag damit neu zu denken

  • Datenaffinität und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten zu verstehen und ansprechend zu visualisieren

  • Selbstständigkeit und den Antrieb, unser Produkt immer besser zu machen

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Remote-first

  • Falls gewünscht EGYM-Wellpass und Corporate Benefits

  • Mitwirken bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer innovativen BI-Lösung

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Engagiertes, modernes und kreatives Arbeitsumfeld in einem aufstrebenden Start-up

  • ca. 1x im Quartal Team-Events (unsere letzten Team-Events: Weihnachtsmarkt, Escape-Room, VIP-Lounge Basketball Alba Berlin, Spielshow, Beachvolleyball)

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20% Zuschuss

Standort:

Unser Büro ist in Bochum. Der Großteil des Teams ist aber Deutschlandweit aktiv. Unter anderem: Berlin, München, Stuttgart, Frankfurt und Düsseldorf.

Teamwork:

Unser Teamgeist ist uns besonders wichtig. Wir legen viel Wert auf gegenseitige Unterstützung und offene Kommunikation. Eine offene Fehlerkultur gehört bei uns dazu – wir lernen aus Fehlern und wachsen gemeinsam daran. Wir sind kein Konzern mit starren Strukturen, sondern ein dynamisches Start-up, bei dem du direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des Unternehmens hast. Du gestaltest den Weg von cinify aktiv mit und siehst, wie deine Arbeit echten Impact hat. Wenn du eine Umgebung suchst, in der dein Beitrag zählt und du gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchtest, dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Ablauf der Bewerbung:

  1. SQL-Test: Im ersten Schritt bekommst du von uns einen kurzen SQL-Test, da wir solide SQL-Grundlagen voraussetzen.

  2. Gespräche: Danach führst du voraussichtlich zwei Gespräche mit unseren Gründern und aktuellen Data Analysts, in denen wir gemeinsam herausfinden, ob cinify und du ein Match seid.

Bock drauf?

Wenn du richtig Bock hast, ein Teil unseres Teams zu werden, dann schick uns eine Bewebung!

Wir wissen, dass es immer schwierig ist, sich von einem Unternehmen zu überzeugen, wenn man es noch nie gesehen hat. Schau doch mal auf unserer LinkedIn-Seite vorbei, um etwas über uns zu erfahren. Wir würden uns freuen, wenn Du uns über die Fragen in dem Bewerbungsformular oder in einem Anschreiben erzählst, was Dich an cinify interessiert, wie du KI heute schon in deiner Arbeit einsetzt und warum Du Dich bei uns bewerben möchtest.

Wenn Du Fragen hast oder weitere Informationen benötigst, stehen wir Dir gerne zur Verfügung. Wir freuen uns darauf, gemeinsam mit Dir Großes zu erreichen.

title: Delivery Manager - Generation Flex
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Generation Flex
The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU with a focus on Germany.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform.

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform, including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.

  • Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.

  • Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

  • Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements, making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

  • Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

  • Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

  • Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

  • Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

  • Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

  • Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

  • Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

  • Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

    • Network and communications diagrams

    • Site and asset specifications

    • PPC and controller documentation

    • Modbus register maps

    • IP addressing and network information

    • Functional Design Specifications

    • Metering and telemetry information

    • Hardware and connectivity requirements

  • Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

  • Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

  • Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process, ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

  • Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

    • Gateway installation and connectivity

    • Operational acceptance testing

    • Kraken market and service testing

  • Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

  • Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

  • Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

  • A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications, including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

  • Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

  • Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

  • Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties.

  • A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously.

  • The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly.

  • A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

  • A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end, rather than treating the software platform as a black box.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function.

  • Language: professional fluency in German and English

⭐ Bonus points

  • Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial.

  • Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources.

  • A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA

  • Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets.

  • Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services.

  • Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration.

  • Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning.

  • Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity.

descriptionHtml:
Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Expertinnen und Experten, die als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen vorantreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen für anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Werde Teil einer der besten und verlässlichsten Beratungen und nutze vielfältige Entwicklungschancen. Als engagiertes Teammitglied kannst Du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf ein starkes Team, das zusammenhält und wirklich etwas bewegen will.

Ziel der Position

Du entwickelst und verantwortest unsere Corporate Website als zentrale Plattform für Positionierung, Sichtbarkeit und Leadgenerierung.

Dein Fokus liegt auf dem Aufbau einer modernen, performanten und suchoptimierten digitalen Präsenz, die unsere Marke im Markt klar positioniert und nachhaltig in relevanten Informations- und Suchräumen sichtbar macht – von klassischer Suche bis hin zu AI-basierten Systemen.

Gemeinsam mit Content-, Campaign- und Business-Teams sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Themen genau dort gefunden werden, wo unsere Zielgruppen nach Lösungen suchen.

Du berichtet an den Head of Digital Marketing

Was Dich erwartet

  • Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb der Corporate Website als zentrale Image- und Leadplattform (Struktur, UX, Inhalte, Conversion)

  • Steuerung und Umsetzung der SEO-Strategie (technisch, strukturell und inhaltlich) zur nachhaltigen Steigerung der Sichtbarkeit

  • Optimierung der digitalen Auffindbarkeit in modernen Suchsystemen inkl. AI-getriebener Suche und neuer Informationskanäle

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung von Website- und Content-Strukturen entlang der Customer Journey (Awareness bis Conversion)

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Content-, Campaign- und Fachbereichen zur Entwicklung such- und zielgruppenrelevanter Inhalte

  • Analyse und kontinuierliche Optimierung der Website-Performance (Traffic, Rankings, Engagement, Conversion)

  • Steuerung externer Dienstleister und Agenturen (z. B. Entwicklung, SEO, Content)


Was wir uns wünschen

  • >5 Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen B2B-Marketing mit Fokus auf Website und SEO, idealerweise im Beratungs-, Technologie- oder Professional-Services-Umfeld

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Content-Strukturen, digitalen Customer Journeys und Suchmaschinenlogiken,

  • Gespür für digitale Markenführung, Inhalte und Nutzererlebnis

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit gängigen CMS-, SEO- und Analytics-Tools

  • Analytisches Denken und Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Optimierungspotenziale abzuleiten

  • Teamplayer mit Humor, Leidenschaft, Kommunikationsfähigkeit und eigenverantwortlicher sowie ergebnisorientierter Arbeitsweise

  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse. Erfahrung im internationalen Kontext von Vorteil

Unsere Benefits:

Aus- und Weiterbildung

Fachspezifische Schulungen und Weiterbildungsangebote

Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung

Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Zusatzversicherungen, diverse Sportangebote wie Urban Sports Club, Yoga etc.

Events

Beratertage, Weihnachtsfeier, Sommerfest, Teamevents, Alumni-Treffen, Jubiläumsfeiern und -reisen

Prämien

Attraktive Gehaltsmodelle, Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprämien

Arbeitszeiten

Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, mobiles Arbeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub, Workation

Ausstattung

Firmenhandy (iPhone), Notebook / Macbook, Mitarbeiter PC Programm, Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, Kostenlose Getränke, Gemeinschaftsräume mit Wohlfühlcharakter

Mobiliät

Mobilitätspauschale, Bahncard, Jobrad

Zuwendungen

Zuschüsse für Kindergarten/Kita und außerordentliche Zuwendungen je Lebenssituation und Betriebszugehörigkeit

title: Director, Field & Channel Marketing - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role:

As Senior Director, EMEA Marketing, you have the opportunity to shape the strategy and execution of full stack marketing in Tenable’s fastest growing theater. This is a unique opportunity to operate as the region's marketing lead across: field and demand generation, channel marketing, advertising, communications, and social. You own the ideas and decisions that drive pipeline creation and advancement across EMEA, and you are the primary marketing partner to sales leadership in turning that strategy into bookings. You lead a team of proven regional marketing managers across the theater, and you report to the Global SVP, Revenue Marketing.

Your Opportunity:

Marketing Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Operate as a “regional CMO” for EMEA — equally comfortable setting integrated marketing strategy, doing a brief on an ad campaign, reviewing a communications plan, or defending pipeline attribution in a QBR, rather than specializing in a single discipline.
  • You are a member of the well respected Global Revenue Marketing leadership team that has dramatically shaped and shifted the Tenable brand and the very idea of marketing’s importance to the business.
  • Stay current on modern marketing technology and strategy (intent data, ABM, attribution modeling, AI-enabled marketing tools) and bring that fluency to how the theater’s marketing programs are built, measured, and evolve.
  • Collaborate closely with global marketing teams—including product marketing, brand, and corporate communications—to localize initiatives for the EMEA region while relaying critical regional needs back to headquarters.

Pipeline Creation, Advancement & Attribution

  • Redefine our integrated go-to-market plans with your new viewpoint across the regions to bridge company targets with local revenue benchmarks. Build long-lasting and collaborative partnerships with corporate functions and field sales executives to secure the alignment needed to drive marketing impact and efficiency.
  • Drive pipeline creation and progression across EMEA while measuring marketing's attribution to pipeline as a core measure of this role's success.
  • Use data and modern marketing/revenue technology — CRM, marketing automation, intent and account-based platforms, BI/analytics, and AI — to continuously identify where investment is and isn't converting, and YOU decided how to reallocate resources and program funds accordingly.

Team, Regional & Channel Leadership

  • Be a leader that leads from the front, inspiring and driving a team across EMEA marketing, setting priorities, developing talent, and ensuring consistent execution across countries and sub-regions.
  • Maintain fiscal governance for the theater, overseeing resource allocation and fund distribution across sub-regions with clear strategic guidance.
  • Representing Tenable at various events; from presenting to partner relations and customer insights
  • As a channel-led organization, this position owns how distributors, resellers, and strategic partners are enabled, funded, and activated—utilizing MDF, joint marketing initiatives, and partner enablement programs to accelerate pipeline generation.

Sales Partnership

  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to Tenable's EMEA Theater Sales SVP and country/segment sales leaders — co-owning pipeline coverage plans, forecast conversations, and go-to-market execution.
  • Represent marketing in regional sales leadership forums, with a clear point of view on where the pipeline is healthy, where it's at risk, and what marketing will do about it.
  • True understanding of the requirements from each regional sales leader from a market perspective.  Being present in each region at least once a year for sales relationship, partner meetings and team connect.

What You'll Need:

  • 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including 5+ years in a marketing leadership role managing people and budgets.
  • A demonstrated track record as a broad, full-funnel marketer —with a key focus on numbers as well as driving social media to cast a bigger shadow  Demand generation is core to your background.
  • Experience owning a marketing budget of comparable scale, with direct management of multi-million-dollar spend and influence over a larger pool.
  • A strong track record partnering with sales leadership, including comfort presenting pipeline and marketing-attribution data to senior sales and executive stakeholders.
  • Solid understanding of channel/partner marketing dynamics — this is a channel-led business, and comfort working through distributors and resellers is required.
  • Fluency with modern marketing technology and strategy, including being AI-forward: marketing automation/CRM platforms, intent and account-based marketing tools, and data/analytics platforms. 
  • Cybersecurity industry experience is strongly preferred; candidates from other B2B industries will be considered.
  • Fluent English required; no additional language requirement.
  • Based in London, UK, with a hybrid work model; regular travel across the EMEA theater is required.

title: Director of Engineering
descriptionHtml:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About the Role

Our largest and fastest-growing markets are staffed and operated from our London hub, and we need a technology leader to join our UK leadership team. This role will be based at our London HQ, following a 3-day hybrid schedule. You will bring together two engineering organisations into one unified team, lead engineering in London, and serve as the primary engineering partner for our UK commercial and product leaders. Reporting to the CTO, you will work closely with executives in London and have the autonomy to make the engineering calls for the UK business.

  • Unify two orgs into one. The team is 35 engineers across two engineering organisations. You will manage six to eight direct reports (engineering managers and staff engineers) and establish a unified standard for how both teams plan, build, ship, and hold each other accountable.
  • Drive platform consolidation. We run several platforms across our international markets today. You will help decide how they become one, and what we keep.
  • Run the London engineering site. Serve as the senior engineering voice in the building, including dotted-line support for US-focused teams based in London. That means setting the tone, facilitating local leadership forums, and making London a place where exceptional engineers join and stay.
  • Translate commercial outcomes. Partner directly with UK commercial, clinical, and product leaders as a true peer. You will serve as the primary contact across the business, evaluating trade-offs through a commercial lens and communicating them rather than escalating them.
  • Shape what we build, not just how. Evaluate whether proposed initiatives deliver real value and instil that thoughtful product instinct across your management team.
  • Build and mentor the team. Own senior hiring in London, set clear quality standards, and mentor engineering managers to become skilled hiring partners who can recruit effectively.
  • Raise engineering standards. Strengthen delivery predictability, quality, and operational reliability across a distributed organisation, and increase what the team delivers through small squads and AI.

About You

  • You've built and led an engineering organisation through managers, including making hard people decisions at the right pace.
  • You have experience designing and leading an organisation through significant structural change such as an integration, restructure, or operational overhaul where teams emerged stronger. You can reflect openly on the parts that went badly and what you learned.
  • You use AI tooling in your own work, and you've changed how a team builds with it rather than just your own workflow. You can say what it made better, what it made worse, and where you chose not to use it.
  • You've demonstrated commercial fluency, holding constructive conversations on revenue, margin, and prioritisation while making speed, scope, and risk trade-offs clear and explicit. You can point to a commercial result you were accountable for.
  • You have experience building and scaling systems from the ground up, rather than simply maintaining a machine that already runs itself.
  • You are technically strong and partner credibly with senior engineers, you evaluate system architecture, and spot when technical estimates lack substance. You stay close to the details and on the tools, prototyping ideas and unblocking your team, without owning committed work on the critical path. Our ecosystem is built on React, React Native, TypeScript, Go microservices, GraphQL, Kubernetes, and GCP.
  • You operate with high agency, independence, and clarity across time zones. You hold strong opinions and change them when someone makes a better case.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in regulated sectors (such as healthtech, fintech or gaming), finding creative paths forward inside compliance constraints rather than being stopped by them.
  • Experience navigating post-acquisition organisational integration and the messy alignment work that follows.

Why join Eucalyptus

  • What's next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer, launching into new conditions, demographics and geographies.
  • Build something world-changing - We're on the path to becoming the world's largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced and deeply rewarding.
  • Make real impact - Your work directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.
  • Accelerate your growth - High ownership, continuous feedback and dedicated development support.
  • Join a motivated team - Talented peers solving complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What's ahead in the UK

  • Be an owner - Your own stake in the business with Hims & Hers RSUs
  • Invest in your growth - Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave
  • Work flexibly - Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration
  • Support your well-being - Private health insurance through Vitality, or a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you
  • Take time off - 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks a year
  • Join a connected team - A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport and seasonal events

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

title: Director of Field Operations (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role


You will own how Orbem shows up at customer sites — installing, servicing, and maintaining multi-million-euro imaging systems that sit at the heart of our customers’ production lines. When our systems run, our customers run. When they don’t, the cost is measured in lost production days. Field Operations is where our technology meets reality, and you own that interface.

Field Operations spans Europe and the US, with regional teams on both sides of the Atlantic. A lot has already been built: dedicated Field Engineers and Project Managers, regional leadership, and real investment in SOPs, planning, and tooling. The next step is maturity — turning what exists into an operation that runs consistently across every site, every partner, and every geography, and that scales without depending on individual heroics.

You inherit that and the mandate to shape what comes next. We are expanding fast into new verticals and geographies, and installation and service quality is one of the few things that can either unlock or throttle that growth. This is a role for someone equally at home setting the operating model and being close to the work itself — credible with a customer's engineers and with our executive team on the same day — and who is unwilling to let the same problem happen twice.


Your Day to Day

Running Operations (≈ 40%)

  • Own end-to-end delivery of installations, on-site service, and scheduled maintenance across Europe and the US — on time, on budget, and at a quality level appropriate to assets worth more than €1M each.

  • Empower and enable Regional Leaders and Project Managers to flawlessly orchestrate complex site deliveries involving customers, MRI suppliers, and automation partners.

  • Be the escalation point that actually resolves things — including on site, out of hours, when a go-live is at risk.

  • Own the operational KPIs and the commitments we make to customers, and keep Technical Customer Support, Business Development, and the executive team informed.

 

Building the Operating System (≈ 35%)

  • Raise SOP maturity — across our own team, our partners, and our customers’ contractors.

  • Implement a continuous improvement engine together with the Operational Excellence team.

  • Leverage and drive the tooling and data we need to run this at scale — field service management, installation and service documentation, spare parts and capacity planning — and make sure people actually use it.

  • Build the quality and safety standards our engineers work to, and hold the line on them under schedule pressure.

 

Leading and Scaling the Team (≈ 25%)

  • Lead and develop the whole team — Field Engineers, Project Managers, and regional leads alike — building the depth and ownership that lets each region run well without you in the detail.

  • Design the organisation ahead of the growth curve: hire, structure, and re-structure as we add verticals and geographies, and find the right mix of own team, partner networks, and variable capacity models to absorb fluctuating demand.

  • Define and operationalize the Field Operations roadmap, and translate it into a capacity and hiring plan the business can commit to.

  • Build the culture: high standards, low ego, no blame, and a bias toward fixing things properly.

How You Fit In

  • You report to the Chief Operating Officer and lead Field Operations through two regional team leads, with Field Engineers delivering installation, on-site service, and maintenance work and Project Managers coordinating customers, partners, and internal teams. The team will keep growing as we roll out new geographies and products.

  • You work closely with Technical Customer Support, Operational Excellence, Supply Chain, Hardware, Product, and Business Development, and you own our operational relationship with our equipment and automation partners.

  • You are part of the wider operations leadership team and contribute to decisions well beyond your own function.


Your Experiences and Skills

  • 10+ years in field or service operations. You have led installation, on-site service, and maintenance operations for complex technical products.

  • Hardware plus service business models. You understand a business where the machine is only half the promise and installation, uptime, and maintenance are the other half.

  • Experience at operational scale. You have worked inside an organisation that had already solved this properly — mature SOPs, field service tooling, quality processes, clear team structures — and you know what “good” actually looks like, not just in theory.

  • Multi-region leadership. You have built and led geographically distributed teams and developed team leads into strong operational leaders.

  • Hands-on and strategic. You can design the operating model and the roadmap, and you will also get on a plane and stand on a site on short notice when the situation calls for it.

  • Continuous improvement as a reflex. You see every error as an opportunity and an obligation to be better next time, and you have the methods to back that up.

  • Technical fluency. You can engage credibly on site planning, requirement specifications, and installation and commissioning detail, and hold your own with engineers, suppliers, and customers’ technical teams.

  • Drive and proactiveness. You move before being asked, chase ambiguity down rather than escalating it up, and you are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

  • Senior communicator. You build trust with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, and you can deliver difficult messages without damaging the relationship.

  • Practicalities. Willingness to travel to European and US sites, and an EU Class B driver’s licence. Fluent in English; additional languages (German, Spanish, Italian, French) are a plus.


What Makes You Stand Out

descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief 

Lead quality and continuous improvement across the business to deliver reliable products, successful missions and customer confidence. Establish independent assurance, a scalable QMS and a leadership culture in which quality is built into every function. Enable on-time vehicle delivery at the agreed cadence through capable processes, credible readiness evidence and sustained improvement.

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Customer quality. Own customer quality relationships, requirements, reviews, audits, complaints and escapes. Work with Mission Launch Operations as the internal customer for launch vehicles to define quality acceptance and handover evidence. Cascade requirements through Engineering, production, AIT and suppliers to raw materials; lead containment, corrective action and feedback.
  • Product assurance. Lead independent mission, project and design assurance from requirements through development, qualification, production and mission readiness. Establish assurance plans and gate evidence covering risks, traceability, interfaces, configuration, verification and validation. Challenge gaps and escalate unresolved risks to accountable decision-makers.
  • QMS and compliance. Own the QMS across all business functions, including process controls, records, audits, management review and corrective action. Use AS9100 as the aspirational framework with a proportionate maturity roadmap. Coordinate compliance assurance with Legal and specialist owners, ensuring applicable contractual, regulatory and certification obligations have accountable owners and evidence.
  • Supplier and operational quality. Lead quality assurance across suppliers, manufacturing, Propulsion AIT, Launch Vehicle AIT, engine testing and launch-pad AIT. Establish control plans, traceability and acceptance arrangements. Support current delivery and future product readiness, using AS9145 APQP as guidance.
  • Inspection requirements and quality at source. Through the Chief Inspector, define inspection requirements, techniques and acceptance evidence with Engineering. With Production Engineering and Operations, maximise poka-yoke, automated checks and real-time in-process verification to prevent defects and drive right first time (RFT), reducing reliance on offline inspection. Validate controls against technical requirements; ensure capable methods, calibrated equipment, competent personnel and traceable results, retaining required independent acceptance.
  • Problem solving and learning. Lead disciplined containment, root-cause analysis and corrective action for significant defects and escapes. Verify effectiveness, prevent recurrence and feed lessons from suppliers, builds, tests and missions into design and process improvements.
  • Lean management. Own the business-wide Lean methodology, standards, capability development and maturity assessment. Equip leaders to improve their own functions through daily management, visual performance, standard work and structured problem solving, supported by specialist coaching.
  • Continuous improvement. Govern a prioritised business-wide improvement portfolio aligned with customer outcomes, delivery, quality, lead time and cost. Coordinate cross-functional learning and verify sustained benefits with accountable leaders and Finance.
  • Digital thread and AI. Connect quality and assurance evidence across PLM, ERP, MES, test and mission readiness. Apply AI and automation to analysis, document review, reporting and workflows to improve departmental efficiency, with trusted data, appropriate access controls and accountable human review.

Authority and working relationships

  • Chief Inspector. Reports directly to this role and leads inspection capability and technical practice. Set priorities and assure the suitability of inspection methods, equipment and competence; Engineering retains authority for technical requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Independent quality authority. Authority to stop work, contain material or withhold quality acceptance where conformity or required evidence is inadequate. Define escalation and disposition routes and provide independent visibility of risks to executive leadership.
  • VP Spectrum Production. Owns production teams, resources and execution. The Production System / CI Leader reports to VP Spectrum Production with a functional link to this role for methodology, standards, coaching capability and maturity assessment. Manufacturing and AIT leaders own local improvement delivery and sustainment.
  • Director Spectrum Value Stream. Owns end-to-end industrial delivery, customer commitments and Spectrum-wide production system performance through Block 2 and Block 4 Leads. Agree quality readiness priorities and improvement outcomes; provide independent assurance and evidence without assuming vehicle schedule accountability.
  • Engineering and Programmes. Chief Engineers retain design authority and technical concession approval. Programme and mission leaders retain programme and mission decisions. Assure their processes and evidence, working with Production Engineering on process readiness, capability and design-for-manufacture feedback.
  • Mission Launch Operations. Agree quality handover criteria and assurance evidence, communicate product risks early and close readiness gaps with delivery owners. Campaign command and launch authorisation remain with designated leaders.
  • Enterprise Planning and functional owners. Align QMS controls with the business process architecture owned by Enterprise Planning and Transformation. Functions retain execution and compliance ownership; specialist teams retain their domain authority. Coordinate supplier quality with Procurement and local implementation with site leaders, including MD Sweden.

Qualification Checklist 

  • Senior quality leadership in space, aerospace or another high-reliability business, including multiple sites, product development and production ramp-up.
  • Strong experience in customer quality, mission/project/design assurance, supplier and operational quality, QMS, audits and corrective action. Working knowledge of AS9100 and APQP principles.
  • Proven ability to deploy Lean through leaders, coach improvement capability and deliver sustained gains across technical, operational and support functions.
  • Practical AI capability is required: demonstrable use of AI and automation to improve departmental efficiency, with measurable results. Experience with digital traceability and connected engineering and operational information.
  • Relevant technical qualification or equivalent experience; clear judgement, constructive executive challenge and a record of building capable teams

Aim radically high • Deliver, no excuses • Act with trust and integrity • Mission first, always

Promote openness, early escalation and shared ownership of quality and improvement.

descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.
