We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the Role

We hire builders with founder-level energy—people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do.

As Director, Regulatory Compliance (UK), you will serve as the senior compliance authority and strategic partner for Airwallex’s rapidly expanding UK presence. Operating as a licensed Electronic Money Institution (EMI) supervised by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), Airwallex requires compliance leadership that sees regulatory integrity not as a roadblock, but as a critical commercial enabler and competitive differentiator.

In this role, you will lead our UK compliance framework, serve as the primary interface with local regulators and industry bodies, and work cross-functionally across Product, Strategy, Commercial, and Operations to safely launch cutting-edge payment infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead UK Regulatory Compliance: Lead a UK-based team of regulatory compliance professionals; own and continuously evolve the UK compliance management system, policies, registers, and operational controls to ensure ongoing compliance with FCA handbooks, PSRs, EMRs, and UK AML/CTF regimes.

  • Drive FCA Engagement: Act as the principal point of contact for the FCA, handling regulatory inquiries, notifications, audits, thematic reviews, and routine reporting with transparency and authority.

  • Product & Commercial Advisory: Partner early with Product, Commercial, and International Expansion teams to design compliant-by-default cross-border payment, issuing, acquiring, and embedded finance architectures.

  • Safeguarding & Governance: Oversee compliance aspects of key UK regulatory regimes including safeguardingand Consumer Duty in close partnership with Finance, Risk, Product, and other teams.

  • Regulatory Horizon Scanning: Monitor domestic and international regulatory developments (e.g., Consumer Duty, operational resilience, PSR APP fraud reimbursement schemes) and proactively translate emerging rules into pragmatic technical and operational roadmaps.

  • Team Leadership & Culture: Build, coach, and scale a high-caliber UK compliance advisory and operations team while fostering a company-wide culture of risk accountability and ethical rigor.

  • Board & Committee Reporting: Prepare and deliver clear, actionable regulatory compliance reporting and key risk indicator (KRI) updates to executive leadership, local operating boards, and audit/risk committees.

What We’re Looking For

Essentials

  • 10+ years of regulatory compliance experience within UK fintech, payment services (EMIs/APIs), neo-banking, or modern global financial institutions.

  • Leadership Track Record: At least 4+ years managing and developing high-performing compliance teams in high-growth environments.

  • Deep Regulatory Knowledge: Expert grasp of UK financial regulations, including the Payment Services Regulations (PSRs), Electronic Money Regulations (EMRs), FCA Principles for Businesses, and Consumer Duty standards.

  • FCA Interface Experience: Direct track record of managing formal regulator relationships, supervisory inspections, or key authorization filings with the FCA.

  • Pragmatic Problem-Solving: Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements through a first-principles lens, providing creative, commercial, and defensible paths forward.

  • Executive Presence: Strong communication, negotiation, and written advocacy skills capable of influencing board members, executive partners, and external regulatory bodies.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Prior experience holding an approved person / Senior Management Function (SMF) role under the FCA regime.

  • Background handling regulatory aspects of cross-border multi-currency schemes, merchant acquiring, or credit/lending adjacencies.

  • Relevant legal qualification or industry certifications (e.g., ICA Diploma in Governance, Risk & Compliance).

You’ll Thrive Here If

  • You own the outcome: You don't wait for permission to solve structural bottlenecks—give you a complex regulatory challenge, and you chart the solution.

  • You’re commercially astute: You understand that compliance is an enabler of sustainable hyper-growth, not an isolated checklist.

  • You balance technical precision with plain-English clarity: You can dissect statutory instruments line by line, then distill the essence clearly for engineers, sales leads, and executives.

  • You’re not precious about traditional playbooks: You push hard from first principles, challenging legacy banking compliance norms with modernized, technology-driven solutions.

  • You value in-person collaboration: You thrive working shoulder-to-shoulder with cross-functional leaders in our London hub.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 Months: Complete a comprehensive assessment of our existing UK compliance controls, policies, and FCA commitments; build alignment with key UK commercial leads and partner banks.

  • Within 6 Months: Streamline product approval compliance workflows; enhance local risk governance reporting; and lead strategic readiness for any pending UK regulatory changes.

  • Within 12 Months: Institutionalize a top-tier UK compliance function that scales seamlessly with transaction volume and new market offerings while maintaining an immaculate standing with the FCA.

Why Join Airwallex

  • Competitive base salary, performance incentives, and meaningful equity.

  • High autonomy to build, scale, and influence the core infrastructure powering the global digital economy.

  • Comprehensive health, wellness, pension, and parental leave coverage.

  • Dynamic, global culture with clear paths for rapid professional development.

We are seeking a Director of Silicon Logical Design to lead and scale our Logical Design group within the Silicon department. This role is accountable for the overall strategy, technical direction, execution quality and team development for Graphcores microarchitecture and RTL design efforts. 

The Director will be responsible for ensuring that our logical design methodologies, architectures and RTL implementations meet world class standards for performance, power, area, and schedule. This leader will partner closely with Architecture, Physical Design, Verification, DFT and Program Management teams to ensure successful, predictable silicon delivery aligned with Graphcores long term product roadmap. 

The Team 

The Logical Design team deliver the micro-architecture and RTL that realise our advanced chip architectures. As Director, you will guide this multi site team, strengthen cross functional collaboration, and drive the evolution of our design flows and capabilities. 

Responsibilities and Duties 

Leadership & Strategy 

  • Define and execute the strategic roadmap for Logical Design, ensuring alignment with Graphcores silicon and product strategy. 
  • Lead, grow and mentor a high performing RTL/micro architecture design organisation. 
  • Establish and implement best in class design methodologies, documentation standards and quality metrics. 
  • Drive continuous improvement across team structure, workflows, tooling, and design processes. 

Technical Ownership 

  • Provide technical oversight of micro architecture specification and RTL development across all major blocks and subsystems. 
  • Guide architectural feasibility studies, contribute to architectural trade offs and micro architecture definition. 
  • Oversee the integration of third party IP, complex application specific blocks, and high performance custom designs. 
  • Ensure robust design sign off through high quality linting, synthesis, CDC/RDC, timing closure and coverage metrics. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Partner closely with Physical Design, Verification, DFT, Architecture and Program Management teams to ensure cohesive planning and execution. 
  • Foster strong communication across teams and global sites, ensuring alignment on priorities, risks and deliverables. 
  • Support silicon bring-up and debug efforts by providing expert guidance and deep understanding of RTL behaviour and architecture. 

Execution & Delivery 

  • Own delivery of high quality, on schedule RTL for multiple parallel silicon programs. 
  • Establish scalable project planning and tracking practices, including resource planning and risk mitigation. 
  • Champion design automation and infrastructure improvements to accelerate productivity and improve design quality. 

Essential Skills & Experience 

  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field; advanced degree preferred. 
  • Extensive experience in digital logical design, micro-architecture and RTL development for large scale, high performance silicon projects. 
  • Proven success leading and developing technical teams in a semiconductor environment. 
  • Deep expertise in SystemVerilog or VHDL and familiarity with modern digital design flows. 
  • Strong ability to diagnose and resolve complex design issues, including via scripting/programming (Python, Tcl, etc.). 
  • Demonstrated excellence in cross functional leadership and communication across global teams. 
  • Strong organisational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities and drive execution in fast-paced environments. 

Desirable Experience 

  • Processor or accelerator micro architecture. 
  • High-speed serial interfaces and complex, high bandwidth IP blocks. 
  • Arithmetic pipeline design and floating point datapaths. 
  • Advanced synthesis, timing analysis, power analysis, and logical equivalence checking. 
  • Design-for-test methodologies. 
  • Power integrity and silicon device level understanding. 
  • Experience with silicon bring-up and post-silicon validation. 
  • Program planning and multi-project execution leadership.

title: Division Operations Senior Associate, Undersea Dominance
department: Maritime & Maneuver Dominance : Undersea Dominance - Engineering & Operations
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Maritime Division Operations Senior Associate

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Maritime Division, one of Anduril's fastest growing divisions, has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. We are fielding the next generation of autonomous systems to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of maritime operations. Anduril has brought to market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth underwater vessel platform and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "small" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

We are seeking to sustain our early successes with deep investment in an expanded product portfolio. These products, including Dive-XL, Dive-LD, Copperhead, Seabed Sentry, and other unannounced systems, will deliver a coherent system-of-systems, enabling the end-to-end conduct of a variety of autonomous missions in the maritime domain. If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact and working on systems that directly contribute to achieving national strategic priorities for Australia and its allies, we want you to join Anduril's Maritime Division and help us build the future of defence capability.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Division Operations Senior Associate to join our rapidly growing Maritime Division Operations team in Sydney, Australia. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting our internal business lines as well as the entire division. The Maritime Division Operations team is a small but mighty team of talented business generalists who enable the division to scale through hyper-growth while breaking as few things as possible.

We're looking for someone to help us build out the business infrastructure required to grow this into Anduril's largest division over the next few years. Our goal is to fundamentally reshape the way future peer to peer conflicts are fought by developing next generation undersea and surface capabilities, such as our XL-AUV, Copperhead, and Seabed Sentry platforms.

This is an operator role, not an advisory one. You won't be writing recommendations for someone else to execute. You'll own the outcome. You'll work closely with division leadership in Sydney and partner across time zones with teams in the U.S., so you'll need to be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead various strategic initiatives and special projects, as directed by Directors and the Chief of Staff, to establish scalable operations across the portfolio, ranging from strategic and international finance, production and supply chain, facilities and real estate, security, etc
  • Act as the connective tissue between efforts related to the design, development, and implementation of new processes, strategy, and execution plans
  • Build the models, trackers, and dashboards the division runs on (headcount, financial, facilities, and production) and keep them alive, not just stand them up
  • Coordinate and prepare for executive leadership meetings, including setting agendas, tracking action items, and ensuring follow-through
  • Support internal team operations like new employee onboarding, all hands, internal business reviews, and other division-wide events so that we rapidly ramp new employees and maintain a culture of "doing things differently"
  • Support our corporate planning cycle by helping to build out and monitor performance against goals, financial plans, and headcount plans so we can hit our aggressive growth targets
  • Establish the operating model and battle rhythm for a rapidly growing team with an emphasis on cross-division coordination and repeatable execution patterns

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • You have 3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, finance, or general business analysis in a commercial, government, or defence industry environment
  • You can clearly articulate why defence, and why Anduril. You have a genuine conviction in the mission, not just interest in the technology
  • You have personally built something operational (a process, tool, or system) that other people used day-to-day. Not advised on it. Built it.
  • You love solving complex, ambiguous, cross-functional problems in a people-centric way, and can point to a time you drove alignment across teams with competing priorities without direct authority
  • You're a clear, structured communicator, in writing and in the room, with senior leaders and engineers alike
  • You manage stakeholders at every level, from engineers and technicians on the floor to program managers, functional leads, Directors, and executives, plus partner teams in the U.S. You build trust, tailor your message to the audience, manage up, push back when needed, and keep people aligned when you aren't in the room
  • You're highly competent with AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) and use them every day to analyse data, draft, research, and build. You know their limits, check the output, and can show us real examples where AI made your work faster or better
  • You're both high ownership and low ego, approaching everything with strong outcome orientation and high humility
  • You get energy from being a thought partner for others and it excites you to spend time translating operational problems into data problems, and to then going and executing on them
  • Strong hands-on Excel skills (modelling, data manipulation, pivot tables). Be ready to show us what you've built
  • You're discerning and an incredibly fast learner. When something doesn't check every box, you figure it out
  • You're tactical and don't only sit at a 30,000 foot level
  • Must be an Australian citizen and able to obtain and maintain an Australian Government security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in business, engineering, law, or a related field
  • Background in a high-growth tech company, or in corporate finance, accounting, or strategy
  • Exposure to supply chain, production, or workforce planning problems
  • Experience with data and analytics tooling including Excel and beyond (e.g. SQL, Tableau, Power BI, Palantir Foundry)
  • Hands-on experience building AI-enabled tools or automations (e.g. custom GPTs or Claude projects, agents, scripts, Power Automate, or LLM APIs) and an understanding of how to use them safely in a security-conscious environment

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

Data Privacy

title: Ehrenamt · remote · 4–6 Std./Woche: Projektleiter / Projektmanager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du hast Freude daran, Ideen in konkrete Projekte zu verwandeln, Menschen zusammenzubringen und Vorhaben von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung zu begleiten? Vielleicht bringst du bereits Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, in der Organisationsentwicklung oder in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Teams mit.

Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für spannende Projekte mit gesellschaftlicher Wirkung. Eines davon ist DEHIB Masterminds, unser Qualifizierungs- und Leadership-Programm, das ehrenamtliches Engagement mit fachlicher Weiterbildung, Persönlichkeitsentwicklung und praktischer Führungserfahrung verbindet.

Du musst nicht jede Projektmanagementmethode beherrschen. Viel wichtiger sind uns Eigeninitiative, Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele zu begeistern

Gleich vorweg: Das ist ein Ehrenamt

Die Aufgabe ist unbezahlt und begründet kein Arbeitsverhältnis. Wir suchen Menschen, die ihre Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Ideen einbringen möchten, weil sie gesellschaftlich etwas bewegen und gleichzeitig selbst Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.

Wer wir sind

Der Deutsche Hilfsbund e.V. (DEHIB) bündelt Hilfsorganisationen und bringt sie mit Menschen aus Wirtschaft, Politik und Wissenschaft zusammen, damit soziales Engagement mehr bewirkt.

Wir verbinden Verbände, schaffen professionelle Strukturen und bauen bundesweit eine Plattform für gesellschaftliche Wirkung auf.

Mit Projekten wie DEHIB Masterminds entwickeln wir innovative Ansätze, um ehrenamtliches Engagement zu professionalisieren, Kompetenzen sichtbar zu machen und Menschen neue Entwicklungsperspektiven zu eröffnen.

Damit aus diesen Ideen erfolgreiche Projekte werden, brauchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und dich.

Deine Aufgaben

· Projekte eigenständig steuern: Projekte von der ersten Planung über die operative Umsetzung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss begleiten

· DEHIB Masterminds mitgestalten: Beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unseres Qualifizierungs- und Leadership-Programms mitwirken

· Projektplanung und Organisation: Ziele, Arbeitspakete, Meilensteine, Zuständigkeiten und Zeitpläne definieren und koordinieren

· Teams und Beteiligte zusammenbringen: Die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Fachbereichen, Ehrenamtlichen, externen Partnern und Projektbeteiligten organisieren

· Fortschritte im Blick behalten: Aufgaben nachhalten, Herausforderungen frühzeitig erkennen und gemeinsam praktikable Lösungen entwickeln

· Kommunikation und Abstimmung: Projektbesprechungen vorbereiten, Ergebnisse dokumentieren und die zuständigen Verantwortlichen regelmäßig über den Projektstatus informieren

· Neue Ideen entwickeln: Bestehende Prozesse verbessern und eigene Vorschläge für weitere Projekte und ihre Umsetzung einbringen

Du musst nicht alles gleichzeitig übernehmen. Gemeinsam legen wir fest, welche Projekte zu deinen Erfahrungen und Interessen passen und welche Verantwortung du eigenständig übernehmen möchtest.

Was du mitbringst

· Freude daran, Projekte zu organisieren, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam Ergebnisse zu erzielen

· Idealerweise Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, in der Projektkoordination, Organisationsentwicklung oder Vereinsarbeit

· Fähigkeit, komplexere Aufgaben zu strukturieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und unterschiedliche Beteiligte zusammenzubringen

· Selbstständige, lösungsorientierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

· Kommunikationsstärke, Teamgeist und ein gutes Gespür für unterschiedliche Interessen

· Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen; Microsoft 365 (Teams, Planner, SharePoint, Outlook) ist von Vorteil

· Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

· Bereitschaft, uns regelmäßig etwa 5–8 Stunden pro Woche zu unterstützen

Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss oder eine formale Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung ist nicht erforderlich. Entscheidend ist, dass du Projekte mit Engagement, Struktur und Verantwortungsbewusstsein voranbringst.

Was wir dir bieten

Sinn & Gemeinnutz

· Deine Arbeit hilft, dass unsere ehrenamtlichen Teams, Gremien und Verantwortlichen wirkungsvoll zusammenarbeiten und gesellschaftliches Engagement gestärkt wird.

· Du arbeitest mit Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und gesellschaftlich etwas bewegen wollen.

Exklusives Netzwerk

· Zugang zu einem wachsenden Netzwerk aus Wirtschaft, Politik, Wissenschaft und Non-Profit-Organisationen

· Austausch mit Unternehmer:innen, Führungskräften und Expert:innen ganz unterschiedlicher Fachrichtungen

· Zugriff auf das Know-how unserer angeschlossenen Organisationen und Kooperationspartner

Gestaltung & Verantwortung

· Du übernimmst eigene Aufgaben, gestaltest organisatorische Abläufe mit und bringst deine Ideen ein

· Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Chief of Staff und Einblick in das COO Office und die Gremienarbeit

· Möglichkeit, schrittweise mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen

Entwicklung & Referenz

· Du entwickelst deine Fähigkeiten in Projektkoordination, Kommunikation und digitaler Zusammenarbeit weiter

· Eine starke Referenz: Mitarbeit in einer zentralen Organisationsfunktion einer bundesweit tätigen Organisation

· Qualifiziertes Ehrenamtszeugnis und Tätigkeitsnachweis

So arbeiten wir zusammen

· Komplett remote mit Microsoft 365, deine Zeit teilst du dir weitgehend flexibel ein

· Klare Absprachen: Aufgaben, Zeitumfang und feste Termine halten wir in einer kurzen Ehrenamtsvereinbarung fest

· Strukturierte Einarbeitung, Chief of Staff als feste Ansprechperson und eine Kennenlernphase von zwei bis drei Monaten

· Corporate Benefits

So meldest du dich – ganz unkompliziert

Kein Anschreiben, kein Bewerbungsmarathon: Schreib uns in drei, vier Sätzen, welche Erfahrungen du mit Projekten mitbringst, was dir bei der Projektarbeit besonders liegt und warum dich dieses Ehrenamt reizt.

Danach lernen wir uns in einem kurzen virtuellen Gespräch kennen und schauen gemeinsam, welche Projekte zu dir passen.

Du möchtest nicht nur über gute Ideen sprechen, sondern sie gemeinsam mit anderen verwirklichen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Mehr zu unserem Projekt DEHIB Masterminds: https://masterminds.dehib.com/

title: Electrical Engineer II (Integrations)
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In the UK, with a legally binding Net Zero target for 2050 and a clean-power ambition for 2030, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. With complete independence from Octopus Energy, we are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As our UK fleet grows and we support our expansion across Europe, we are looking for an Integrations Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we scale our fleet of integrated assets, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing.

You’ll be part of an engineering delivery team, based in Manchester, who take an integration project from the very early information stage, design how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turn that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset.

Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches. When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members.

  • Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team.

  • Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on.

  • Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time.

  • Hardware and Software Deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing with guidance from the senior engineers.

  • Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team.

  • Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand grows.

  • Incidents & compliance: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Understanding of the Regulations: Working knowledge of the UK Grid Code, G99 and the other obligations of a grid-connected asset before it can participate in the energy markets.

  • Understanding of the UK Energy Markets: Working understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process.

  • Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution.

  • Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation.

  • Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control.

  • Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation.

  • Hardware and Networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support.

  • Industrial Communication Protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus.

  • CAD, Diagrams and Tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion.

  • Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with the team.

  • Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them.

  • Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration.

  • A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel to customers and sites although travel is very occasional. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Wider knowledge of grid compliance (G99, G100, Grid Code) and where the Kraken system fits in.

  • Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures.

  • Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows.

  • Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (IEC 62443, NIS Regulations awareness).

  • Exposure to wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks and TSO integrations.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

As an Embedded Electrical Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to design the compute modules and associated boards used across our platforms. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly.

Responsibilities

  • Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms.

  • High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity.

  • Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication.

  • Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs.

  • Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification.

Candidate requirements

  • Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree.

  • Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production.

  • Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium).

  • Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs.

  • Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production.

  • Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Energy Markets - France (CDD)
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

  • Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data

  • Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

  • Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

  • Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

  • Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

  • Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

  • Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

  • Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment

  • Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…)

  • Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

title: Engagement Manager
descriptionHtml:
Engagement Manager

London, 4x days per week in-office

 

Vega is looking for exceptional engagement managers to lead client deliveries from end-to-end, and embody client partnership as our competitive advantage. This role acts as the bridge between sophisticated enterprise clients, product, and engineering - holding scope, timelines, and requirements together to drive a truly market-leading client experience.

 

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.


Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

 

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

 

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

 

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

 

In this role, you will:

 

  • Own the day-to-day relationship, requirements shaping, and delivery coordination for a small portfolio of enterprise customers - ensuring they receive maximum value from the platform and a white-glove partnership experience, whilst protecting Product & Engineering teams from unstructured or ad-hoc demand.

    • Including running check-ins, business reviews, roadmap discussions, discovery workshops, etc.

  • Act as the main bridge between enterprise clients and Vega’s product & engineering teams, translating customer needs into clear, prioritised, and deliverable work - with clear success criteria and scalability with the platform.

  • Work with Product to ensure there is a clear linkage between customer demand and product direction - collaborating to understand the trade-offs between effort, impact, and complexity and prioritise customer-driven requests across the product surface and multiple customers.

  • Actively build and shape the playbook for how we run engagements at scale, with processes and automations to coordinate with engineering, track progress, communicate release plans and updates to customers, etc.

  • Support the Growth team to ensure customers adopt and realise value from new features, identify expansion opportunities through deeper platform usage, and maximise opportunities for customer retention and satisfaction.

  • Strong candidates will usually have experience working directly with engineering teams and enterprise stakeholders, particularly in environments involving integrations, configuration-heavy products, or complex customer requirements.

 

What we look for:

  • Experience delivering complex technology projects in enterprise contexts, with a strong focus on customer success or implementation leadership - having done so in a start-up / scale-up context is a strong plus, or as a project leader in consulting focused on tech delivery.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, ability to manage enterprise customer relationships across a range of stakeholders (e.g., business, tech, and ops teams) and collaborate with internal product and engineering teams on delivery.

  • Confidence and judgement, with the ability to decide when and how to challenge requests, and an awareness of scalability and trade-offs when making those judgement calls.

  • Excellent communication skills across both technical and non-technical audiences.

 

Why join us?

  • You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

You do not need experience with every product listed.

  • Security Mindset: Understand the importance of least privilege, secure configuration, data protection, auditability, and careful change management. You know when to escalate a risk or seek specialist guidance.

  • Problem Solving: Take a logical, evidence-led approach to troubleshooting. Explain technical options and trade-offs clearly, and distinguish between immediate mitigation and long-term resolution.

  • Ownership: Take responsibility for work from investigation through resolution and follow-up. Care about the long-term health of the services you support, not only closing individual requests.

  • Communication: Work effectively with colleagues, stakeholders, and technical teams. Translate technical detail into clear updates and provide helpful, user-focused support.

  • Adaptability: Comfortable working across a varied technology estate, learning new tools, and balancing planned delivery with operational priorities in a changing environment.

  • Teamwork: Share knowledge, ask for help when needed, and contribute positively to a team that works across multiple technical domains.

Additional Information

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

title: Engineering Manager, Customs
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Why Customs Matters More Than Ever

International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis — sparked by Trump-era tariffs — has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.

That’s where we come in. The Customs Technology team at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.

The Opportunity

Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.

Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

title: Expert Support Technique et Comptable (Télétravail complet possible - Bretagne)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 million de TPE/PME et plus de 7 000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Tu as une solide expérience en comptabilité et tu aimes comprendre comment fonctionnent les outils SaaS ?
Tu souhaites intervenir sur des problématiques complexes, à la frontière entre métier, produit et technologie ?
Rejoins Pennylane en tant qu’Expert·e Support Technique et Comptable.

Ton rôle
Tu prends en charge les sujets les plus complexes remontés par nos utilisateurs et nos équipes Support.
Ton objectif : comprendre l’origine des problèmes, qu’ils soient comptables, fonctionnels ou techniques, puis coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes Produit et Tech.
Tu joueras un rôle clé entre les utilisateurs, le Support, les développeurs et les équipes Produit.

Tes missions

  • Investiguer des bugs, anomalies et problématiques comptables ou fonctionnelles.

  • Reproduire les problèmes rencontrés et en identifier la cause.

  • Qualifier les incidents et coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes concernées.

  • Échanger avec les développeurs et le Produit pour transmettre des analyses claires et exploitables.

  • Utiliser les outils d’investigation disponibles : logs et SQL simple.

  • Documenter les solutions et contribuer à l’amélioration continue du produit et des process.

  • Partager ton expertise avec les équipes Support.


Le profil recherché

Tu peux venir de différents environnements : cabinet d’expertise comptable ou éditeur de logiciel comptable.

Nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • dispose d’une solide expérience en comptabilité et comprend les problématiques des cabinets et entreprises ;

  • a déjà travaillé sur des sujets complexes nécessitant analyse et coordination ;

  • est à l’aise avec les outils et problématiques techniques ;

  • sait communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques ;

  • parle anglais dans un contexte professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ;

  • fait preuve de rigueur, d’autonomie et de curiosité.

La connaissance de SQL est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable. Ce qui compte surtout, c’est ton envie de comprendre les systèmes et de monter en compétence sur les sujets techniques.

Pourquoi rejoindre Pennylane ?

Tu rejoindras une équipe au cœur de la qualité produit, en lien direct avec les utilisateurs, les développeurs et les équipes Produit. Tu travailleras dans un environnement international, en forte croissance, où ton expertise comptable aura un impact concret

Process de recrutement :

  • Premier échange un/e recruteur - 30 min

  • Étude de cas et debriefing avec deux membres de l’équipe - 60 min

  • Entretien avec le Manager direct - Thibault et Viviane (Associate Team Lead Technical Support) - 60 min

  • Entretien avec Thomas (Team Lead Technical Support) - 45 min

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou @pennylane-partners.com .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. descriptionHtml:
Field Marketing Manager | Precision Semiconductor Metrology
Abingdon, UK, with up to 30 percent travel

Reward and Benefits

  • £69,000 - £80,000 (depending on experience)]
  • A generous annual bonus, death in service and private health care benefits BUPA, EMI Share scheme (UK).

If you are a Field Marketing Manager who enjoys connecting advanced technology with the people who need it, why not join us in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, and own the regional go-to-market programmes for advanced semiconductor metrology systems.

About Infinitesima
Infinitesima is a UK-based pioneer in advanced metrology solutions for the semiconductor industry. Our patented Rapid Probe Microscope (RPM) technology combines the 3D surface detection of atomic force microscopy with high-speed laser actuation and interferometry, delivering sub-nanometre measurements at in-line production throughput. Our Metron3D 300 mm in-line wafer metrology system brings this capability into high-volume manufacturing, addressing process control needs for next-generation devices that optical and electron-beam techniques cannot meet. Metron3D is in use at leading semiconductor manufacturers, and we are growing our team as demand for in-line 3D process control accelerates.

We are looking for an ambitious and adaptable Field Marketing Manager to own our regional go-to-market programmes for semiconductor metrology. You will connect our technology to fab, R&D and advanced packaging customers, equipment partners and industry audiences through trade shows, technical conferences, customer presentations and targeted marketing collateral. You will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Applications, Engineering and Corporate Marketing to build awareness, generate qualified demand and support revenue growth. This role involves travel of up to 30 percent, in the UK and internationally. If your passion is connecting technology with the people who need it, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll be doing

  • Develop and run field marketing plans aligned with business goals, product roadmaps and regional sales priorities, and own our regional go-to-market programmes
  • Identify and prioritise the target accounts (IDMs, foundries, memory makers and OSATs), industry segments, trade shows and regional technical symposia that will do the most for pipeline
  • Create and oversee technical and commercial collateral, from product briefs and application notes to measurement and demo data summaries, case studies, white papers and sales enablement materials, in line with our brand and product positioning
  • Turn complex metrology concepts, such as measurement capability, throughput and process control value, into clear, compelling messages for process engineers, metrology teams and executives
  • Present to customers, partners and industry audiences at conferences, customer sites and webinars, and back Sales up with account-based marketing and executive briefings for key semiconductor accounts
  • Partner with Sales, Product Management, Applications, Engineering and Corporate Marketing to align messaging, launches and priorities, work with regional sales teams so programmes suit local markets, and share customer, market and competitive insight with Product and Engineering

Education and experience

  • Degree in engineering, physics, materials science or a related technical field, or in marketing with a strong technical background
  • [3]+ years’ relevant marketing experience, ideally in field or technical marketing, within a semiconductor or semiconductor equipment company

Skills and experience we’re looking for:

  • A strong understanding of the semiconductor ecosystem, including metrology and inspection, fab process control, customers, supply chain and trends such as advanced logic, 3D memory and advanced packaging
  • A proven record of creating marketing collateral, including technical and product-focused content
  • Strong presentation and public speaking skills, with experience presenting to customers and industry audiences
  • Turning complex technical ideas into clear, compelling messages for engineers and executives
  • A track record of working well with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Product and Engineering
  • Prioritising accounts, segments and events to get the most out of pipeline
  • Comfortable travelling up to 30 percent, in the UK and internationally
  • A valid passport and no international travel restrictions

We’d love to see:

  • A Master’s degree in a technical field
  • Experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms
  • Experience in international or multi-region marketing, particularly in Asia (Taiwan, Korea, Japan) or Europe

Our strength lies in the varied perspectives that come from different cultures, experiences, and identities. We believe that true innovation is fuelled by collaboration, locally and globally. We strive to foster an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully and thrive. If you require adjustments to take part in the recruitment process, please let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

Your recruitment journey:

We will interview you: Monday to Friday UK Time 9am to 4.30pm and we'll be as flexible as we can with Global Scheduling

1st and 2nd stages stage: Remote meetings to evaluate your experience and technical ability and meet some of our global senior team members

Final stage: Face to face onsite to meet our senior leaders

A note on how we use AI:
We use AI only to transcribe our interviews so we can focus fully on you instead of scribbling notes. The AI does not take part in any decision making at any stage. All hiring decisions are made by real humans based on the conversation we have with you.

This position requires a greater onsite presence along with up to 30 percent global travel due to the nature of the work and business need

Recruitment agencies: Infinitesima Ltd only works with approved agencies and does not accept unsolicited agency CVs. descriptionHtml:
JustPlay is looking for a Finance Controller Lead (all genders) to join our growing Finance team. Over the past years, we've grown significantly, and we're now backed by NCSoft as our strategic shareholder, with ambitious plans to keep growing. As we scale, our finance function needs to scale with us, and we're looking for a Lead Finance Controller who owns the numbers that steer our business and leads our controlling function: shareholder reporting, budget and forecast, and the KPIs leadership relies on every week. You will report directly to the Associate Director of Finance, be the finance partner for our core revenue and cost drivers, and help build a controlling function that scales with the company.

Job responsibilities

  • Shareholder reporting (NCSoft): Deliver the monthly management P&L and the quarterly consolidated balance sheet and P&L on time and in the shareholder's templates. Provide preliminary figures within a few days of month-end. Keep a clean bridge between management P&L and statutory figures.

  • Budget and forecast: Own the annual budget and a rolling forecast. Turn the overhead budget into a working budget-control process, with cost-center owners, monthly actual-vs-budget reviews and follow-up actions.

  • Business partnering: Be the finance counterpart for Revenue Generation / Ad Monetisation, User Acquisition, User Payments (payouts and rewards) and the G&A cost centers, with profitability as the focus.

  • Cost control: Build levers and tracking for the largest cost blocks: personnel, SaaS, cloud, consulting, and payment fees (PayPal, FX).

  • Analysis: Run variance analysis against budget, forecast and weekly flash, build scenario models, and prepare quarterly business reviews.

  • Data integrity: Establish Metabase/Looker as a reliable source of finance KPIs. Reconcile BI data against invoices and the ledger, own the KPI definitions and remove double counts and manual add-ons.

  • Liquidity: Work with Treasury on the liquidity forecast (network payout timing, UA spend, user cash-outs).

  • Interface with accounting: Work with the Accounting Lead on the in-house month-end close, including accruals input, cut-off, and cost center and chart of accounts design in DATEV.

  • Team: Lead and review the work of our junior FP&A team member as a lead

Job requirements

  • 6+ years in controlling or FP&A, with at least 2 years in a scale-up or digital B2C business; mobile apps, gaming or ad-tech is strongly preferred.

  • Experience leading, mentoring and developing a finance team, helping others grow while setting high standards

  • Proven experience reporting to a corporate or strategic shareholder or a PE owner, including multi-entity consolidation and delivering to external templates under deadline.

  • End-to-end ownership of a full budget and forecast cycle, including building driver-based models.

  • Self-sufficient with data: hands-on with a BI tool (Metabase/Looker) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets

  • Solid accounting foundation (accruals, FX, revenue recognition), with enough IFRS/HGB knowledge to reconcile management and statutory figures.

  • Fluent English (written and verbal). German is a strong plus, given our work with PwC, DATEV and the local entities.

Nice-to-have

  • Understanding of Ad monetisation and User Acquisition economics: network revenue and payout terms, eCPM, ROAS/LTV, and marketing spend cycles.

  • Experience with an Asian corporate parent or group reporting calendar

  • Hands-on experience with DATEV, Moss or Embat

  • Experience building a controlling function or KPI governance from scratch

  • Familiarity with multi-currency (USD/EUR) payment flows and FX effects

Job benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

  

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

 

Everyone's welcome here

Our customers are universities all over the world, so the work ranges from a straightforward Dutch invoice to a US procurement portal with its own supplier onboarding forms and submission rules. The role is broader than most financial administration jobs at this level, and we are searching for someone who's ready to own it.

I'm looking for a Financial Administrator to take on our day-to-day operations: billing and collections on the receivables side, supplier invoices and payment runs on the payables side, and the Finance mailbox where everything is coordinated. A lot of our processes are still manual, with limited documented processes. You'd be doing the work and improving it at the same time, formalising operating procedures as you go. The ideal team member is someone who notices when a workflow is clumsy, and is proactive in addressing it.

We're a small team of two, and we support the wider organisation with a vast range of topics. You'd work closely with our New Business and Partner Success teams when it comes to billing, and with our Marketing team when it comes to purchasing. When an invoice goes out on time, a university pays on schedule or a purchasing inquiry is resolved ahead of an event, that's visible, and it will be thanks to you. Financial administration can often be limited to a narrow scope of topics within a larger team. If you're eager to get the full picture of operations in a company with an international customer base, this is the right place for it.

What you'll do:

  • Send out sales invoices on time. This includes setting up new customers and uploading invoices to procurement portals such as Ariba and PaymentWorks

  • Set up and maintain customer subscriptions in the ERP system based on signed contracts, and create invoices and credit notes for all legal entities

  • Keep track of unpaid invoices, send payment reminders to institutions that haven’t paid, and flag invoices that stay unpaid

  • Partner with Sales and Partner Success to address billing and payment queries

  • Ensure supplier invoices and expenses are processed on time

  • Prepare the weekly payment run for approval

  • Compare bank transactions with our accounting records and resolve any discrepancies

  • Manage the Finance mailbox: customer invoice and payment questions, supplier requests, supplier onboarding forms, and internal requests that come in through the ticketing system

  • Support month-end close and annual accounts

  • Write down how finance processes work in the Finance database in Notion, and update it when you improve them

What you bring:

  • You stay accurate and organised during busy periods. At month-end you keep daily work running smoothly while closing the month.

  • You follow things through to the end, in a friendly way. Late payments, missing details or an invoice that needs to match a contract: you stay on it until it’s sorted, and people enjoy working with you.

  • You take ownership of your work from start to finish. You plan your own week, set your own priorities and keep things moving.

  • You speak up when something in the numbers looks off, so we can fix it together.

  • You enjoy working with tools and software, and like finding new ways to get more out of them.

  • You’re comfortable building things as you go. You ask good questions, fill in the gaps and make sure you know the next steps before you start.

  • You have at least one year of experience in a finance or similar administrative role (two or more is a plus), including hands-on work with billing or subscriptions. We care more about your experience than your degree.

  • You’ve worked with an accounting system or ERP, such as Exact Online, NetSuite, Dynamics or SAP. Experience with Exact Online, Moss or procurement portals is a bonus

  • You write and speak English fluently, as we use it for all internal and external work.

  • You’re available 24 to 32 hours per week and can work from our Amsterdam office 2-3 days a week.

What you get:

  • 25 paid holidays per year, based on a 40-hour work week

  • Hybrid work schedule (2-3 days onsite)

  • A day off for your birthday

  • Advantageous pension scheme

  • 3 days of volunteering leave per year

  • €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning

  • Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription

  • Free access to our office gym

  • Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp (EU, US, and AUS)

Compensation: €33,600 – €36,480

Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Le Forward Deployed Engineer est ce profil : à moitié ingénieur, à moitié consultant, et toujours responsable du résultat en production. Ton équipe : Tu rejoins la practice AI Modernisation et tu es détaché chez nos clients. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Scope, build, and deliver proofs of concept that demonstrate clear business and technical value.

  • Track record helping large customers move from POC to production.
