title: Head of Revenue Operations
descriptionHtml:
TLDR; Conduct's first revenue operations hire. You will build RevOps from scratch: the systems, planning and data our whole go-to-market team runs on, and make it AI-native from day one.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies compete by being different, and most of that difference lives in the software they've built for themselves, which decides everything from how parcels reach your door to how food gets onto supermarket shelves. That software is a real advantage, but it's also the hardest part of the business to change safely, so good ideas often wait months or even years for the systems to catch up.

Every large enterprise has a software company hiding inside it, and Conduct is building the operating system for it. We read a company's code and processes, work out what needs to change, and help the business and its systems move forward together, wherever custom software has become too complex to change safely.

Fortune Global 500 companies like DHL and Daimler Truck already trust us with their most critical systems, and we've just raised a $60M Series A from Index Ventures, ICONIQ and SAP.

We're a talent-dense team of about 70, growing fast across London and New York, with people from Palantir, G-Research, Legora and Sequoia. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here will shape the company and how the world's largest companies operate.

About the role

Our go-to-market team is growing fast in London and New York, and over the next year we'll scale it several times over, with new account executives and regional directors joining across both offices. They sell a technical product to CIOs and IT leaders at some of the world's largest companies, in long deals with many stakeholders, often alongside partners like SAP and the major consultancies. To grow at that pace, everyone needs one clear picture of the business and an operating rhythm they trust.

Today there's no RevOps function, so you'll be starting from a blank page. You'll decide how we plan, measure and run go-to-market, then build it yourself: the CRM and the systems around it, the planning cycle, the forecast and the analytics that tell leadership where to focus.

We're an AI company, so we expect RevOps to be AI-native too. Agents should do the work that headcount does elsewhere, so a small team can have an outsized impact. You'll work closely with our founders, sales leaders, partnerships, marketing and finance.

What you'll do

  • Build the function from scratch. Hire and lead a small founding team, and set one set of definitions, KPIs and data standards across sales, marketing, partnerships and deployment strategy, so the whole company works from a single source of truth.

  • Own the GTM tech stack. Implement and run the CRM and the tools around it, with clean data captured at the source rather than fixed after the fact.

  • Put agents to work. Design and ship AI workflows for account research, enrichment, routing, pipeline hygiene and forecast inputs, and decide where a human stays in the loop and how the output is checked before anyone acts on it.

  • Run the planning cycle. Own territory and coverage design, capacity and headcount planning, quota setting and comp plan design for enterprise land-and-expand deals.

  • Run the revenue rhythm. Lead forecast calls, pipeline reviews and QBRs, build a forecast leadership can rely on, and deliver board-ready reporting with the story behind the numbers.

  • Set commercial guardrails. Work with our deal desk on pricing discipline, approvals and contracting workflows for complex enterprise and partner deals.

  • Decide where we play next. Turn win/loss, conversion and customer data into decisions, size the market by vertical and geography, and build the case and the infrastructure for new markets.

What we're looking for

  • A track record of building or scaling RevOps at a high-growth B2B software company, ideally one selling complex, technical products to enterprises. You've owned territory design, quota and comp plans, forecasting and pipeline management, and hired the team to run it.

  • Deep, hands-on CRM expertise (Salesforce or HubSpot at admin level) and experience designing an integrated GTM stack.

  • AI-native. You've put AI agents or LLM-powered workflows into production for a business team, and can show what broke, what you changed and the impact. Your default is to automate.

  • Strong analytical skills, including SQL and BI tools, with experience sizing markets and turning data into go-to-market decisions.

  • Equally strategic and hands-on. You design the system and also build the models, dashboards and workflows yourself.

  • A clear communicator who earns credibility with sales leaders, founders and the board.

  • Experience with long enterprise sales cycles, the SAP ecosystem or systems integrator co-sell motions is a strong plus.

  • An appetite for being in the office every day, close to the team and the work.

Your seniority does not matter. Ambition, craft and the ability to turn ideas into high-quality work quickly do. We sponsor visas from everywhere. We're convinced diverse teams build better products, and we especially encourage people from groups underrepresented in tech to reach out.

descriptionHtml:

title: Infrastructure Engineer, GPU Clusters
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

About the Role

We spend tens of millions per year on GPU compute to train tabular foundation models. That's not a target, it's what we're running today, and it's growing. The person who owns this infrastructure makes decisions worth millions of dollars: cluster architecture, scheduling efficiency, provider strategy, hardware selection.

Today we run on Slurm across multiple clusters. We're scaling to multi-cluster, multi-provider infrastructure using SkyPilot and evaluating new hardware generations as they come online. You own the full stack, from cluster orchestration and cost optimization to CI/CD, automation, and the tooling that keeps researchers moving fast. You work directly with the research team and understand what they're doing well enough to make infrastructure decisions that actually help them.

What you'll work on:

  • Own and evolve multi-cluster GPU infrastructure, from Slurm and SkyPilot on GCP today to multi-provider orchestration and new GPU generations tomorrow. Drive architecture, automated provisioning, workload scheduling, reliability, cost optimization, and capacity planning against growing compute demands

  • Build the developer productivity layer: CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, reproducible environments, experiment tracking, and internal tooling that keeps research iteration speed high

  • Improve infrastructure reliability through monitoring, observability, infrastructure as code, and automation. Reduce operational toil and make complex systems easier to manage.

  • Help guide compute spending decisions. You understand cost per FLOP across providers and hardware, and you hate wasted compute

Tech stack: Slurm, SkyPilot, GCP (+ AWS and Azure to come), Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Python, uv, wandb

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 3+ years building and operating production infrastructure at scale, ideally involving compute clusters, distributed training systems, or HPC

  • Hands-on experience with cluster management and workload orchestration systems such as Slurm, Kubernetes, or similar technologies. You've debugged scheduling failures and operated infrastructure where downtime has real cost

  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and reliable build and deployment workflows

  • Strong systems engineering fundamentals: Linux, networking, storage, and distributed systems. You're comfortable debugging complex infrastructure problems across the stack.

  • Strong Python skills and enough familiarity with training to profile a run and tell whether the bottleneck is data loading, communication, or compute

  • Track record of making infrastructure decisions that measurably improved reliability, developer productivity, or cost efficiency

  • Strong AI tooling skills. You use Claude Code, Cursor, or similar fluently to move fast without sacrificing quality

Bonus:

  • Familiarity with GPU infrastructure, PyTorch, GPU profiling, and distributed training

  • Experience operating at tens-of-millions-scale compute spend

  • Multi-cloud or hybrid HPC/cloud infrastructure experience

  • Experience scaling from single cluster to multi-cluster orchestration

  • Background building experiment tracking, model registries, or ML pipeline tooling

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

Compensation: €100K – €210K • €20K – €280K Equity • Multiple Ranges

  • Europe | Berlin, Freiburg • €100K – €210K • €20K – €280K Equity
  • US | NY • $170K – $355K • $25K – $315K Equity

title: Investment Team Intern (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
We are building Germany's leading tax advisory firm. Many business owners want a tax advisor who acts as a true sparring partner: proactive, responsive and strategic. What they often get is a service provider that books receipts and files returns, with little real advice. We're building the alternative.

Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We're starting with healthcare professionals, a complex and underserved segment, and we grow both organically and through M&A.

This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI now enables a fundamental shift, and there are no playbooks yet. We're writing them. We're a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company, Y Combinator and the former Klarna Head of Engineering.

The role

You join the team that finds, evaluates, finances and integrates the tax firms that join Taxforce. You work directly with our founders on live deals and own your workstreams from first screening to closing and beyond.

Tasks

  • Deal sourcing. Build and maintain a pipeline of tax firms that fit our focus, from research and screening to first outreach.

  • Firm analysis. Turn DATEV reports, business analyses, annual accounts and payroll data into a clear picture of revenue, clients, team capacity and profitability.

  • Models and valuation. Build and maintain valuation and financing models in Excel.

  • Due diligence. Prepare and run due diligence workstreams, from data room to question lists.

  • Financing. Prepare materials for banks and financing partners and keep the process on track.

  • Decision papers. Write investment memos and presentations for founders and investors.

  • Post-merger integration. Support the onboarding of acquired firms, from process documentation to cross-firm coordination.

Requirements

  • Strong academic background. You have a very good Bachelor’s degree or are enrolled in a Master’s in business, economics, finance or a related field.

  • First deal experience. You’ve interned in M&A, transaction services, private equity, investment banking, corporate finance or consulting.

  • Financial fluency. You understand P&Ls, balance sheets and cash flows and quickly spot what doesn’t add up.

  • Analytical mindset. You turn incomplete information into a clear recommendation.

  • AI-native. You use AI tools to build analyses and models faster.

  • German language skills. Sellers and banks speak German, so we require fluent German (C2) and English.

Benefits

  • Work directly with experienced founders. Learn first-hand from a team with backgrounds at Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company and Klarna, and from a former Y Combinator founder.

  • Buy-and-build from the inside. See how a group of tax firms is built at an early stage.

  • At the table. Meet sellers, banks and investors and present your own analysis.

  • Ownership from day one. Take on real responsibility early, on live clients, deals and projects.

  • Front-row seat to AI in the real world. See how AI transforms a traditional industry and help build it.

  • Steep learning curve. Work on real problems, ship quickly and build skills that prepare you to start your own company.

  • A path to stay. Strong interns get an offer to continue as working student or full-time.

The details

Full-time internship for 3 to 6 months, start any time of the year, on-site in our Berlin office five days a week.

How to apply

Send us your CV and a few lines on why this role fits you. Our process has three steps: a 30-minute intro call, a short live case from our day-to-day work, and a conversation with the founders.

title: iOS Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Story Hello there. We’re Zopa. We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife
About the team

We are a mobile-first bank, and our iOS app is a critical part of how customers experience Zopa.

Having recently completed our migration to fully native mobile, we are now focused on making our iOS platform exceptional: fast, reliable, accessible and easy for engineers to build on.

You’ll join our Mobile Platform team, which owns the infrastructure, tooling and engineering standards that sit beneath our customer-facing mobile experiences. This includes areas such as app architecture, shared modules, our design system, observability, developer tooling and CI/CD.

The team is accountable for keeping these foundations reliable, scalable and easy for our product squads to build on. You’ll help shape the direction of mobile engineering at Zopa, improve the developer experience, and reduce the underlying technical complexity that product engineers need to manage.

The Mobile Platform team does not own individual customer journeys or build product features on behalf of squads. Product teams remain responsible for their customer experiences and the services they own, including responding to incidents within those product-owned areas. Instead, your focus will be on creating and maintaining the shared capabilities, tooling and standards that enable those teams to deliver safely and effectively.

You’ll also be part of a strong iOS engineering community, contributing to standards, sharing knowledge and helping us continue to mature our native engineering practice.


The role:
  • Joining our Mobile Platform team, you will report to the Engineering Manager, and work alongside talented iOS engineers building the foundations of Zopa’s mobile experience.
  • Collaborate with the wider mobile community, including React Native engineers, to share best practice and make thoughtful decisions about native development.
  • Help make the Zopa app faster, more reliable and genuinely enjoyable to use—identifying bottlenecks, resolving bugs and improving performance where it matters most to customers.
  • Build and evolve customer-facing features that make the most of iOS’s native capabilities.
  • Partner closely with Product, Design and Backend teams to shape solutions from early idea through to a high-quality release.

    • About you:
  • You’re an iOS engineer with experience building and shipping polished production apps using Swift.
  • You have a solid understanding of iOS frameworks and native mobile development principles.
  • You’ve worked on modern, high-engagement apps and care about creating fast, intuitive experiences for customers.
  • Quality is central to how you work. You write maintainable code, value strong engineering practices, and take pride in improving reliability, testing and overall app quality.
  • You’re curious, collaborative and motivated by building products that make a meaningful difference for customers.

    • Added bonus (but not essential):
  • Experience applying mobile security best practices.
  • You have collaborated with Android engineers using Kotlin and/or React Native engineers.
    • #LI-IB1

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

    Diversity Statement

    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

title: Junior Consultant in der Medizin (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die meisten Einstiegsjobs in der Unternehmensberatung bedeuten:
Analysen vorbereiten. Präsentationen bauen. Dem Senior Consultant zuarbeiten.

Dieser nicht.

Bei uns hast Du bereits früh direkten Kontakt mit Praxisinhabern, die sich für eine Zusammenarbeit mit uns interessieren. Du besprichst mit Ihnen „wo der Schuh drückt“ und zeigst Lösungsansätze auf. Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Beratern entstehen konkrete Lösungskonzepte, deren Umsetzung Du als Assistenz mitbegleitest.

Denn Mediziner sind hervorragend ausgebildet, um Patienten zu behandeln. Darauf, ein Unternehmen mit Mitarbeitern, Prozessen, Kennzahlen und wirtschaftlicher Verantwortung zu führen, bereitet sie ihr Studium dagegen kaum vor.

Genau hier kommen wir ins Spiel.

Wer wir sind

Die MediKom Consulting GmbH ist eine auf ambulante Medizin spezialisierte Unternehmensberatung mit Sitz in Nürnberg. Wir haben hunderte Arztpraxen dabei begleitet, ihre Wirtschaftlichkeit zu verbessern und ihre Zukunft zu sichern. Wir sind zwölf feste und freie Mitarbeitende. Das heißt: Deine Arbeit ist sichtbar. Niemand muss sie erst durch drei Hierarchieebenen tragen.

Aufgaben

Was du tust

Als Junior Consultant arbeitest du an anspruchsvollen Beratungsprojekten für niedergelassene Ärzte und medizinische Einrichtungen.

  • Analyse.
    Du analysierst Arztpraxen nach unserem Beratungssystem und identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale bei Prozessen, Organisation, Mitarbeiterführung, Kommunikation, Marketing und Wirtschaftlichkeit.
  • Kennzahlenmanagement.
    Du erfasst und analysierst monatlich die betriebswirtschaftlichen Kennzahlen unserer Mandanten, bereitest sie verständlich auf und schaffst damit eine fundierte Grundlage für unternehmerische Entscheidungen.
  • Konzeption und Umsetzung.
    Aus deinen Analysen entwickelst du konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen und begleitest unsere Mandanten bei der Umsetzung – praxisnah, lösungsorientiert und mit Blick auf messbare Ergebnisse.
  • Strategietage und Workshops.
    Du unterstützt unsere Consultants bei Strategietagen und Beratungsterminen, häufig direkt vor Ort in den Arztpraxen.
  • Schnittstelle zum Marketing.
    Du erkennst den Unterstützungsbedarf unserer Mandanten bei Themen wie Praxismarketing, Patientenkommunikation oder Recruiting und koordinierst die Umsetzung mit unserem Marketing-Team.
  • Schnittstelle zu Steuerberatern.
    Du stehst im Austausch mit den Steuerberatern unserer Mandanten, holst relevante Unterlagen ein und bereitest betriebswirtschaftliche Daten für unsere Analysen auf.
  • Projektmanagement.
    Du koordinierst Aufgaben und Termine, behältst den Projektfortschritt im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass vereinbarte Maßnahmen umgesetzt werden.

Mit zunehmender Erfahrung übernimmst du Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung und führst schließlich eigene Beratungsprojekte.

Qualifikation

Wen wir suchen

Wir suchen keinen fertigen Unternehmensberater.

Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die einer werden will.

Du möchtest verstehen, warum manche Unternehmen hervorragend funktionieren und andere trotz guter Voraussetzungen weit hinter ihren Möglichkeiten bleiben. Du arbeitest gerne mit Zahlen, erkennst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und hast gleichzeitig Freude daran, mit Menschen zu arbeiten und Veränderungen voranzutreiben.

Idealerweise bringst du mit:

  • ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in BWL, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Gesundheitsmanagement, Controlling oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich,
  • ein gutes Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und Freude am Umgang mit Zahlen,
  • ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten,
  • eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und strukturiertes Denken,
  • eine selbstständige und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise,
  • ein souveränes und kommunikatives Auftreten,
  • Organisationstalent und hohe Zuverlässigkeit,
  • Entscheidungsfreude und Eigeninitiative,
  • die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen,
  • Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Mandanten,
  • den Anspruch, dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Entscheidend ist für uns, was du lernen und bewegen möchtest.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Leistungsbezogene Bezahlung ohne Deckelung
  • Ein Mentor statt Onboarding-PDF. Du arbeitest direkt mit Wolfgang Apel zusammen, der dieses Unternehmen aufgebaut und Host des Podcast „Unternehmen Arztpraxis“ ist. Was du hier in zwei Jahren lernst, lernst du in einem Konzern in fünf nicht.
  • Sicherer Job in einem krisenfesten Markt. Der Bedarf an ambulanter Versorgung wächst, unabhängig von der Konjunktur.
  • 30 Urlaubstage. Die gesetzlichen 20, plus 10 von uns obendrauf.
  • Bezahlte Fort- und Weiterbildung.
  • Präsenz statt Homeoffice. Ein Team, das sich im selben Raum sieht.
  • Moderne, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze. Gute Anbindung mit Auto und ÖPNV. Regelmäßige Team-Events. Und einen Dachgarten, auf dem im Sommer die besten Gespräche stattfinden.

So läuft die Bewerbung

title: Junior Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Je bent vol energie om aan je carrière te beginnen. Met deze opdracht geven we jouw carrière als data engineer een flitsende start! title: Junior Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Engine Behind 120M Processed Auctions Daily

The Ad Network team builds and operates the backend services that power adjoe Ads' programmatic advertising engine. The core challenge is straightforward to state and hard to solve: for every incoming ad request from a mobile SDK, decide within milliseconds whether it's a good fit for any active campaign — and at what price to bid.

To solve this, the team has built a Real-Time Bidding platform of 20+ Go microservices that orchestrate ad auctions at 1,500 bid requests per second, integrate with external demand partners via OpenRTB, and connect to ML models making 50 billion predictions daily across 600+ features to optimize bid pricing. The stack runs on Kubernetes, with Kafka handling event streaming, DynamoDB and Elasticache powering low-latency data access, and Prometheus and Grafana providing observability across the entire system.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Golang Backend Foundation: You have a Computer Science degree (or related field) and hands-on experience writing Golang. You will use this foundation to contribute directly to our production backend services from day one at adjoe, rather than writing isolated or throwaway code.

  • Proven Project Portfolio: We look for engineers with tangible projects to show, not just coursework. You will leverage the architectural lessons from your past builds—what worked, why you built it, and what you would change—to design and scale our live systems.

  • Modern Infrastructure Stack: You are comfortable working with REST APIs, version control via Git, and CI/CD pipelines. You will use these core tools, along with your familiarity in cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, to reliably deploy your code into our environments.

  • Iterative Code Ownership: You will work alongside experienced engineers who will rigorously review your pull requests. We need someone who parses technical feedback directly and uses it to continuously refine their system design and coding standards.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

descriptionHtml:
Gestalte Deine Zukunft bei ECOVIS KSO

Als Junior Sales Manager (m/w/d)wirst Du Teil unseres Partnerunternehmens Flexcon IT (https://flexcon-it.de/). Du arbeitest mit ausgewiesenen Expert:innen auf ihrem Fachgebiet, um zukunftsweisende IT-Lösungen zu planen und umzusetzen. Präzise und transparent – nur so geht nachhaltige Digitalisierung für einen langfristig störungsfreien Betrieb. Du hinterfragst mit Bedacht die Herausforderungen von Morgen, entwickelst geeignete Cloud-Strategien im Team und gibst Antworten auf Fragen, die noch gar nicht gestellt wurden? Perfekt! Dies ist die Basis unseres Teams, in dem Eigenverantwortung und Sorgfalt ebenso wichtig sind wie unternehmerisches Denken und Zuverlässigkeit.

Hier bist Du gefragt

Du machst aus einem ersten Kontakt eine qualifizierte Verkaufschance und sorgst dafür,
dass kein guter Lead liegen bleibt. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit erfahrenen Kollegen aus
Vertrieb und Technik zusammen.

  • Du sprichst neue Kunden telefonisch und digital an.

  • Du dokumentierst Kontakte und Opportunities sauber im CRM.

  • Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools für Recherche, Vorbereitung und Vertriebsarbeit.

Dabei geht es nicht um möglichst viele Calls, sondern um gute Gespräche und echte
Verkaufschancen.

Das bieten wir Dir

Du wirst bei uns nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen, aber Du sollst schnell Verantwortung
übernehmen.

Produkte, Kunden, Zielgruppen und Vertriebsprozess kennenlernen.

2. Qualifizieren
Eigene Erstkontakte und Discovery-Gespräche übernehmen.

3. Entwickeln
Eigene Opportunities aufbauen und vorantreiben.

4. Verkaufen
Schritt für Schritt eigene Verkaufsprozesse bis zum Abschluss führen.

Aus Dir wird ein richtig guter B2B-Vertriebler.

Dein Weg zu uns

  • Eine kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung (Bereich IT-System-Management, Büromanagement, Groß- und Außenhandel oder Dialogmarketing) ist von Vorteil, setzen wir nicht zwingend voraus

title: Junior SEA/Google Ads-Account Manager | E-Commerce Fokus (m/w/d) | Frankfurt am Main
descriptionHtml:
Hey, wir sind Hitaj Digital!

Wir sind Wachstumspartner für ambitionierte E-Commerce Brands & Onlineshops mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main. Diesen Onlineshops helfen wir dabei, profitabel auf 7-bis 8-stellige Jahresumsätze zu skalieren mit Hilfe von Google Ads/Google Shopping usw.

Wir bieten unseren Kunden eine einzigartige Partnerschaft, welche

  • Unser firmeneigenes, signalbasiertes PMAX-System nutzt, das gezielt die passenden Neukunden anspielt, kombiniert mit
  • Einem tiefen Verständnis im E-Commerce, der unseren Kunden hilft, gezielt höher zu ranken, als die Konkurrenz & dabei mehr Umsatz zu erzielen und
  • KI für die Kampagnenstrategie & Analysie, sowie Skalierung von E-Com Brands nutzt.

Hast du Bock auf...

  • direkten Kundenkontakt mit jungen Gründern und Online-Shop-Inhabern?
  • Vollzeit im Office in wunderschönen Frankfurt am Main
  • Gutes Gehalt und Möglichkeiten zu wachsen finanziell, als auch persönlich
  • Faires Bonussystem für Vertragsverlängerungen, exzellente Performance als Ergebnis deiner Arbeit und dem Erfolg der von dir betreuten Kunden?
  • Marketing-Strategien für Kunden zu bauen und für unsere Kunden klare Skalierungs-Strategien im Google Ads Account umzusetzen?

Nice, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden dabei zu wachsen und eine Revolution im E-Commerce Space einzuläuten. Dafür geben wir täglich 110%.

**Falls du ebenfalls Bock auf High Performance hast, dich persönlich weiterentwickeln willst und dein volles Potenzial ausschöpfen willst, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Solange du Ergebnisse lieferst, hast du volle Freiheit und Vertrauen deinen Alltag so zu gestalten, wie es dir passt.

**

UNSERE WERTE

  • Kundenerfolge. Wir glauben daran, das beste für die Kunden auch das Beste für uns ist. Daher bekommt jeder Kunde bei uns genau die Unterstützung, die er braucht, so lange bis er wirklich erfolgreich ist.
  • Einfachheit. Weniger ist mehr. Unwichtiges weglassen. Denn Komplexität im privaten und beruflichen Leben ist einer der größten Störfaktoren für die meisten Unternehmer.
  • Hohe Standards. Großartig ist nicht gut genug. Wir glauben daran, dass wir die Branchen-Standarts neu definieren können und uns nur mit dem besten Ergebnissen zufrieden geben sollten.
  • Ehrlichkeit & Transparenz. 100% ehrlich und transparent sein - auch wenn es weh tut. Denn das bringt unsere Kunden und uns selbst langfristig am weitesten.
  • Spaß. Das was wir machen sollte Spaß machen, ob alleine oder im Team oder im Ad-Account.
  • Zahlen, Daten, Fakten. Wir entscheiden analytisch & zahlenbasiert und nicht Ego- oder Emotionsgetrieben.
  • Ergebnisse. **Nur das Ergebnis zählt. Letzendlich ist es "egal", was du genau machst, haupsache es bringt das Ergebnisse, was du dir erhoffst & die Performance stimmt.

WICHTIG: Ohne vorherige Erfahrung in Google Ads bitte nicht bewerben!**

Aufgaben

Als Google Ads Account Manager bist du maßgeblich an unserer nächsten Wachstumsphase beteiligt. Du arbeitest direkt mit unseren Kunden zusammen, um transformativen Mehrwert zu schaffen und gleichzeitig Systeme aufzubauen, die Shopumsätze skalieren.

Deine Aufgaben: Client-Success-Management & Ads-Account Management

  • Übernimm die Verantwortung für diverse Onlineshops, die heiß drauf sind zu wachsen und gib ihnen durch Account-Optimierung, Accountabilty und Strategie-Entwicklung alle Tools mit an die Hand, die sie dafür brauchen.
  • Kickoffs durchführen: Nach Durchsicht einer detaillierten Bestandsaufnahme definierst du eine individuelle Roadmap, die mit höchster Erfolgswahrscheinlichkeit zum Ziel führt.
  • Accountability Calls: In wöchentlich stattfindenden Calls analysierst du die aktuellen Engpässe, beantwortest spezifische Fragen und definierst die nächsten Optimierungsschritte für die Kunden.
  • Google Chat Support: Zwischen Accountability und Themen-Calls unterstützt du die Onlineshops via Google Chat mit hilfreichen Antworten, Loom-Videos oder schickst Screenshots von Erfolgen im Ads Account.
  • Das Endergebnis: Du liefererst konsequent messbare Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden.

Google Ads Account Management

  • Du betreust in Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Spezialisten-Team die Google Ads Accounts von Online-Shops aus diversen spannenden Nischen & Branchen.
  • Account-Strategie & Kampagnen-Setup: In täglichen Meetings tauschen wir uns darüber aus, was aktuell funktioniert, analysieren Ad-Accounts und du erhältst wertvolles Feedback zu deinen betreuten Accounts.
  • Du bist im Austausch mit unserem Sales-Team, hast eine Übersicht über die aktuellen Kunden und bietest rechzeitig Verlängerungen an & Schritte zur Optimierung.

Copywriting

  • Entwickle professionelle Google Ads Copywriting-Fähigkeiten auf Expertenniveau
  • Du optimierst die Ads, Sitelinks, PMAX Kampagnen & Such-Kampagnen von unseren Kunden.
  • Identifiziere Engpässe im Shop-Umsatz und setze effektive Lösungen um
  • Lerne, Signale für Google Ads Kampagnen zu erkennen und zu nutzen

Kurzum: Du bist dafür verantwortlich, die Online-Shops individuell zu betreuen, Engpässe zu lösen und die Performance im Google Ads Account hoch zu halten. Dies geschieht durch 1:1-Calls, Projektmanagement, Account-Management und Google-Chat-Support.

Qualifikation

Fähigkeiten & Erfahrung

  • Digitale Versiertheit und die Fähigkeit, neue Tools schnell zu beherrschen. Du kennst dich mit gängigen KI-Tools aus und bist in der Google Ads-Welt zuhause.

  • Eigenverantwortung & Rapport: Du musst in der Lage sein, dein Gegenüber accountable zu halten, nachdem sie dir gesagt haben, was ihnen wichtig ist. Du musst erkennen, wenn sich Kunden selbst vera*schen, verschiedene Persönlichkeitstypen verstehen, lesen und mit ihnen arbeiten können. Du brinst eine hohe emotionale Intelligenz und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit.
  • Google Ads Erfahrung: Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis, wie Google Ads und die angrenzenden Bereiche funktionieren. Du bist in der Marketing- & Google Ads-Bubble unterwegs, hast vielleicht auch schon das ein oder andere Coaching gebucht. Begriffe wie CLTV, CPA, ROAS oder CTR sind alltäglich für dich.

title: Junior Social Media Account Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Über uns



Wir begeistern und inspirieren Millionen von Menschen! Als innovativer Hybrid aus Social Media Publisher und Social Media Agentur vereint das VS Mediahouse einzigartige Expertise in den Bereichen Content-Kreation, Markenaufbau und Performance-Marketing. Mit einem Team von über 50 Experten in Social Media, Design und Videoproduktion betreiben wir die beliebtesten Social-Media-Marken Deutschlands auf Facebook, Instagram und TikTok. Zu unseren Erfolgsmarken zählen unter anderem VS, Lieblingskollegen und Lieblingsmensch®. Unser tiefes Verständnis für die Dynamik von Social Media und unser Publishing-Know-how ermöglichen es uns, Marken wie Samsung, Schwartau, Bayer und Lexware im Bereich Social Media nachhaltig erfolgreich zu machen. Wir schaffen Verbindungen, erzählen Geschichten und setzen Trends – für echte Wirkung und messbaren Erfolg.

Was erwartet dich

  • Du steuerst zusammen mit deinem Teamlead Kundenprojekte – von der Idee bis zum Reporting.
  • Du berätst unsere Kunden bei Social-Media-Strategien und bringst eigene Ideen mit ein.
  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und Kreation und hältst alle Fäden zusammen.

title: Lead Product Manager - AI Platform
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

⚡ The AI Platform tribe

AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI.

Its flagship product is Joker, Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates.

For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham, the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable.

The tribe's users are the teams inside Joko. Its goal is simple: help them run extremely efficient processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and give the company the leverage it needs to scale in the coming years.

🎯 What you will do

As Lead Product Manager for the Platform tribe, your mission is to make Joko's own machine faster, safer and increasingly agentic. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, own the tribe's roadmap end to end, and lead the Product Managers on its task forces as the team grows. The tribe is being staffed right now, so expect to be hands-on from day one on scopes you own personally, and to build the function as the team grows.

  • Set the tribe's strategy: You will decide what Platform builds, in what order, and what it stops doing. You will map what teams across the company do today in our internal tools, what it costs them and what they need next, then turn that into a roadmap you can defend in front of leadership. This intake runs permanently, as a standing part of the job.

  • Own Joker and Gotham: These are the tribe's most strategic bets and you will drive them personally. Taking Joker from what it is today to a production-grade agent platform, and shipping Gotham's permission model so agents never hold more access than the person they act for, is the highest-leverage work in your scope.

  • Build the automation layer: The approach is capability first: expose an action as a scoped tool, write the instructions an agent needs to use it well, then let the agent run the job. Interfaces come only where they earn their place, and deciding what still deserves a screen is a genuinely new kind of product judgment.

  • Retire what should not exist: Part of the mandate is subtractive: migrating off tools that have outlived their purpose and progressively switching off legacy systems, without breaking the teams that depend on them every day.

  • Own security, compliance and reliability: Identity and access, data retention and minimization, log centralization, audit, test coverage. The requirement often comes from Legal or an auditor, and still has to be shaped into something people will actually adopt.

  • Lead and grow the team: You will hire, mentor and lead the Product Managers who own the tribe's task forces, set the bar on discovery and delivery, and be the person the tribe's engineers and designers look to for product direction.

  • Be the interface for the whole company: You will be the point of contact for Engineering, Ops, Finance, Legal, Data and Care, structuring their demands and arbitrating between them. You will define success in time saved, cost removed, risk reduced and adoption by internal teams, and report on it in those terms.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers. A background on internal tools, back-office products, APIs, platforms or complex B2B products is a strong plus.

  • AI fluency, hands-on: This scope is being rebuilt around agents, so this criterion carries the most weight. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you understand what agents are actually good and bad at, and you have opinions about where automation belongs and where a human interface still earns its place.

  • Product for teams mindset: You are comfortable building for internal users, where the bar is efficiency, robustness and adoption rather than polish. Problems nobody outside the company will ever see still energise you. If what drives you is craft on a consumer surface seen by millions, this scope will frustrate you.

  • Strong technical appetite: You are curious and hands-on with infrastructure, identity, permissions, reliability, security, compliance and data architecture. Coding is not required, but you need to understand how things work.

  • Management: You have a proven track record in people management. You know how to grow Product Managers, set a high bar for rigor, and give direction without taking every decision yourself.

  • Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization and saying no. You can navigate many dependencies, arbitrate between senior stakeholders, and make trade-offs explicit.

  • Analytical & pragmatic: You are data-driven, impact-oriented, and you go straight for the real operational problem.

  • Communication: You are a clear, structured communicator, able to translate complex technical topics into business impact for the exec team.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You are ownership-driven, resilient, and motivated by solving hard, unglamorous but high-impact problems that make the whole company better. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €78.3K – €125.9K

title: Lead Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of major areas of ExTrac's AI-driven platform. Reporting into ExTrac's Head of Product, you will work closely with the design, engineering, research and analysis, and customer success teams to take significant product areas from ambiguity to shipped: leading discovery, defining requirements, driving delivery, and bringing order to the tools and processes that product work runs on.

ExTrac is a founder-led, vision-led company. This role : owning prioritisation within your product areas, keeping stakeholders aligned as plans evolve, and acting as a multiplier for product craft across the teams you work with.

What the job involves

Roadmap ownership

  • Own the roadmap for our core SaaS platform, translating the strategy set by ExTrac's founders and product leadership into a clear, sequenced, deliverable plan.

  • Own prioritisation within your area, balancing user needs, business goals, BD requirements, and specific client requirements, and defending those calls with evidence and reasoning.

  • Stay across all work in flight within your areas: who is working on what, expected timelines, and what is paused, delayed, or blocked.

  • Stay close to industry trends and competitor products, especially in AI and B2B SaaS, and feed that intelligence into roadmap discussions.

Discovery and definition

  • Lead feature development from concept to delivery, with clear and actionable PRDs.

  • Conduct investigations, gather information, and assess feasibility.

  • Keep all stakeholders aligned and up to date as plans and requirements evolve.

Product operations and delivery

  • Bring order to the tools and workflows that product development runs on (issue tracking, documentation, sprint and delivery processes), so they reflect how we actually work and scale as we grow.

  • Own the interface between product management and delivery management within your areas: sequencing, dependencies, and visible progress against commitments.

  • Establish the working hygiene (clearly structured initiatives, honest status, well-maintained backlogs) that lets engineering, design, and leadership trust the plan.

Technical and data judgement

  • Apply technical judgement to guide product development within your areas, especially around AI/ML model integration, data processing, and analytics.

  • Translate complex technical solutions into clear product decisions and communicate the trade-offs to stakeholders.

  • Use behavioural data and analytics as a key input to decisions and prioritisation, alongside domain expertise and conviction.

Research, validation and data

  • Use usage analytics and behavioural data to track adoption and surface friction within your product areas, and build workflows to analyse and act on it.

  • Favour observation over interrogation: watching people work usually tells you more than asking them what they want.

  • Use user research and testing for what it does well, validating legibility, usability, and workflow fit. This evaluative feedback should carry real weight and is often decisive; workflow fit deserves particular care given our high-stakes users.

  • Recognise the limits of research when it comes to direction: what we should build is synthesised from deep expertise across intelligence analysis, subject matter, data science, engineering, and design.

  • For bets that cannot be validated up front, apply post-deployment discipline: define success metrics and evaluation timelines, commit in advance to the evidence that would change your mind, and assess honestly whether the bet is paying off.

  • Organise and run internal alpha and beta testing, plus external testing where possible; partner with Customer Success to recruit proxy users and to surface the friction, workflow issues, and pain points that feed into execution and prioritisation.

Working with AI: Co-Analyst

  • Partner closely with the AI team to ensure AI features are genuinely useful, understandable, and aligned with what our users need.

  • Help track and document the specific behaviours and styles built into Co-Analyst responses.

  • Support the work to adapt Co-Analyst to the needs of specific external organisations.

Raising the bar for product practice

  • Contribute to the product function's processes, roadmapping systems, and prioritisation frameworks, and model their consistent use.

  • Help define and track the metrics that indicate product success, adoption, and customer satisfaction within your areas.

  • Act as a coaching and advisory resource for colleagues, sharing product craft across teams and mentoring less experienced team members as the function grows.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Act as the connective tissue between product, engineering, machine learning, design, customer success, and research within your product areas, ensuring cohesive development cycles and smooth delivery.

  • Partner closely with the design team on design and UX, engineering on build and AI/ML, and the research and analysis team on domain expertise, synthesising their input into coherent product decisions.

  • Facilitate cross-team workshops to bring evidence and expertise together, and strengthen pre-sprint and in-sprint communication.

You should apply if

  • You have shipped complex products in technical domains, ideally AI/ML, data, or intelligence, and you do your best work owning a product area end to end: from opportunity definition to shipped customer value.

  • You are as comfortable in the detail as in the plan. Writing a PRD, interrogating usage data, or pressure-testing a model integration with engineers is the core of your craft, not a chore.

  • You hold evidence and conviction in balance. You know when user research should lead and when expertise-led judgement should, and you can make and defend either call.

  • You do your best work in a founder-led, vision-led company. You know the difference between owning a vision and making a vision real, and the second is the work you enjoy. The pace and ambiguity of a growth-stage company is what you are looking for rather than what you are tolerating.

  • You find genuine satisfaction in bringing order to messy tooling and processes, because you have seen how much leverage a well-run product operation creates.

  • You make the people around you better. You share your craft, coach colleagues, and improve the processes you work within, without needing a title that says you must.

Where this role can take you

  • Deepen your ownership. Strong performance means broader ownership, higher-stakes bets, and more direct influence over product strategy.

  • Help define how AI-native intelligence products get built. Co-Analyst is a category-shaping product, and the work you deliver will influence how the industry approaches human-AI analytical workflows.

  • Grow with the Product function. As ExTrac scales, this role is the natural path towards senior product leadership. Progress on either track: ExTrac values the individual contributor and Manager paths equally, so you can deepen technical scope or take on people leadership as your responsibilities grow.

Requirements

  • ExTrac provides services to a number of government clients, some of which specify nationality criteria for individuals seeking security clearance. For this reason, we can only consider applications from individuals who are nationals of the UK, another NATO member state, Australia or New Zealand.

  • 4+ years in product management, ideally in AI/ML, data science, or intelligence-related fields, with a proven track record of shipping complex products from concept through to delivery.

  • Experience delivering product work in a startup or growth-stage company, with demonstrated ability to own a product area end to end with minimal oversight.

  • Able to translate complex technical solutions into product decisions, judging when user research should lead (usability and workflow fit) and when expertise-led conviction should (what to build), and using data and analytics as inputs rather than the whole answer.

  • Comfortable working hand in hand with engineering and ML teams, with a good understanding of how complex ML models are integrated into user-facing products, alongside data processing and analytics.

  • Skilled at working with engineering, ML, design, and customer success, and at synthesising input from multiple disciplines into coherent product decisions in a collaborative, agile environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present complex information clearly to executives, clients, and internal teams.

Desirable

  • Experience in threat intelligence, risk analysis, or geopolitical intelligence, or in other highly regulated or security-sensitive environments (e.g. government, defence).

  • Experience working within complex, data-led startups or other high-growth digital environments.

  • A foundation in machine learning, data analytics, or AI product management, particularly integrating complex ML models into user-facing products.

Interview Process

We aim to ensure that each person who interviews with our team has the opportunity to showcase their experience and strengths, and to have honest conversations about whether ExTrac and the role align with their career aspirations. The process for this role is as follows:

  • Initial Intro Interview - 30 Minutes

  • Craft & Competency-based Interviews - 60 Minutes x 2

  • Senior Executive Interview - 45 Minutes


Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

  • A generous benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions.

  • Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • A sabbatical leave offer.

  • £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays.

  • Flexible working, with the opportunity to spend 3 days a week remotely alongside regular days with our team in our central London office.

  • A role that combines mission-driven purpose with cutting-edge technology in a fast-growing company.


ExTrac AI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

ExTrac AI is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing open role within our organisation. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position but all hiring decisions will be made by a member of our team.

descriptionHtml:
What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

The opportunity.

AI is changing the engineering industry, and we see it as a huge opportunity to deliver more value to our customers, at unprecedented scale and pace, and to a higher standard than ever before. We want to be at the forefront of this change as we become an AI-native engineering organisation.

We're looking for a Lead Software Engineer to help drive this change, leading the technical direction of major projects and shaping the next generation of products that transform how organisations around the world use data. You'll join our R&D department, over 200 people across London, Ireland and Malaga, working in cross-functional teams helping to build the Quantexa Platform, our core Contextual Decision Intelligence offering. Our technology helps customers tackle complex challenges across fraud detection, financial crime, data management and more.

What you'll be doing.

  • Lead entire technical workstreams for your team, owning the design, planning, estimation and delivery of projects that can span multiple quarters

  • Act as the technical owner of a significant area of the Quantexa Platform, with a deep understanding of its architecture and how it fits within the wider system

  • Stay hands-on, writing high-quality, performant code with agentic tools and providing astute review of others' work

  • Drive the adoption of AI-native engineering within your team and beyond, shaping how agentic tools and practices are used across the software development lifecycle

  • Take accountability for the quality and risk of your team's work, ensuring our engineering standards are met, from rigorous testing strategies to a consistently upheld definition of done

  • Proactively identify technical debt, risks and gaps in functionality, and propose workstreams to resolve or de-risk them

  • Work independently with Product Management and other stakeholders, coordinating with other teams on larger pieces of work and reporting progress to Engineering leadership

  • Influence technical decisions that impact other teams and the wider function, and grow the engineers around you through mentoring, targeted feedback and leading interviews

Tech Stack.

Agentic tooling and automated workflows are embedded across our software development lifecycle, from design and coding through to testing, review and release, and we are building our own software factory, using services such as Claude to automate and accelerate how our engineers work.

On the back end, we build highly scalable, performant distributed services in Scala, capable of processing huge volumes of data. Our services are built on the Typelevel ecosystem (Cats, Cats Effect and fs2) and Apache Pekko, and we apply techniques such as event sourcing and CQRS in our persistence layer, giving us scalable datastores, flexible enough to meet the varied requirements of our customers. We also use Apache Spark and Kafka for large-scale data processing and streaming.

Our front end is built with Angular, TypeScript and Signals and is designed to be highly extensible, with AI agents accelerating how we build UI components and Playwright underpinning our component and integration testing. We also use Python for our client SDKs, enabling data scientists and engineers to work with the Platform from notebooks and data science environments.

What you'll bring.

  • Have a product-focused mindset, with a passion for building high-quality software that has real-world impact and that customers love, and a strong understanding of how product decisions are made

  • Have extensive practical experience using agentic tools (such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor) across the software development lifecycle, and have helped others adopt them effectively

  • Have extensive commercial experience designing and building scalable, high-performance backend systems on the JVM, ideally in Scala with functional programming

  • Have a proven track record of leading technical workstreams or teams, delivering complex projects from design through to production

  • Have deep experience of distributed system architecture, including event-driven design, event sourcing and CQRS, and of designing systems that scale to high volumes of data and users

  • Set the standard for engineering quality, with expertise in testing strategy, performance, security and reliability

  • Communicate clearly and confidently with engineers and senior stakeholders, and can influence technical decisions across teams, challenging constructively where needed

  • Are passionate about growing engineers through mentoring, feedback and interviewing, and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment

Nice to haves.

  • Building large-scale data processing and ETL/analytics pipelines with Apache Spark, ideally on managed cloud platforms such as GCP Dataproc, Azure Databricks or AWS EMR

  • Improving data quality through cleansing, parsing and standardisation, and indexing data into search technologies such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch

  • DevOps tooling and practices such as Infra-as-Code, containerisation, Kubernetes and CI/CD, and delivering software that runs both on-premise and as a service (automation is something we’re passionate about, and we even have a dedicated Developer Tooling team)

  • Building or extending AI-enabled developer tooling, such as custom agents, MCP servers or automated review workflows

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

  • Competitive salary

  • Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare with AXA, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Calm App Subscription #1 app for meditation, relaxation and sleep

  • Continuous Training and Development, including access to Udemy Business

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Employee Referral Program

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. title: Leitende Medizinische Praxisassistent*in (Zürich)
descriptionHtml:
Warum Ovivamed?
Wir bei Ovivamed haben uns eine klare Mission gesetzt: Wir machen eine nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich. Hierzu bauen wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten auf. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen langfristig erfolgreich zu managen, indem wir uns auf das konzentrieren, was am meisten zählt: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität nachhaltig zu steigern.
Bisher haben wir bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, in Deutschland und in
Grossbritannien erfolgreich begleitet. Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und gestalte die Zukunft der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung aktiv mit!

Die Rolle
Als Leitende Medizinische Praxisassistentin (a) steuerst du das tägliche operative Geschäft
unserer Ovivamed-Praxisstandorte in der Schweiz (Zürich, Bern, Basel, Luzern). In dieser vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Rolle führst du ein engagiertes Team von Medizinischen Praxisassistent*innen und Medizinstudierenden. Du stellst einen reibungslosen Patient*innenfluss sowie die kontinuierliche Einhaltung unserer hohen klinischen und operativen Standards sicher. Als mitarbeitende Führungspersönlichkeit arbeitest du aktiv im Praxisalltag mit, unterstützt das Team von der Front aus und befähigt deine Kolleg*innen gleichzeitig zu fachlicher und persönlicher Bestleistung.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Teamführung & Entwicklung: Du leitest, mentorst und schulst bestehende sowie neue Teammitglieder vor Ort und förderst deren berufliche Weiterentwicklung.

  • Praxisorganisation: Du überwachst und optimierst die täglichen Abläufe in den Praxisstandorten, um eine nahtlose Patient*innenerfahrung und effiziente, gut strukturierte Abläufe zu gewährleisten.

  • Qualitätsmanagement: Du implementierst, pflegst und setzt unsere Qualitätsmanagement-Strukturen an den Standorten konsequent durch.

  • Einsatzplanung: Du koordinierst die Einsatzpläne des Teams, delegierst Aufgaben effektiv und stellst jederzeit eine optimale Abdeckung der Praxisaktivitäten sicher.

  • Klinische Unterstützung: Du übernimmst allgemeine MPA-Tätigkeiten wie die Patientenadministration, Laborarbeiten, Triage sowie die Assistenz des ärztlichen Personals.

  • Prozessoptimierung: Du identifizierst operative Engpässe im Tagesgeschäft und treibst kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen aktiv voran.


Dein Profil:

  • Ausbildung: Eine abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Medizinische Praxisassistentin (MPA) mit eidgenössischem Fähigkeitszeugnis (EFZ).

  • Berufserfahrung: Fundierte, praktische Erfahrung in einer Arztpraxis oder einem ähnlichen klinischen Umfeld.

  • Führungskompetenz: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in einer leitenden oder stellvertretend leitenden Kapazität (z. B. als Leitende MPA oder Stellvertretung) sowie ausgeprägte Führungsqualitäten mit der Fähigkeit, ein diverses Team zu coachen, zu motivieren und zu befähigen.

  • Organisationstalent: Exzellente Organisations- und Problemlösungskompetenzen, um in einem dynamischen Praxisumfeld stets den Überblick zu behalten.

  • Digitale Affinität: Eine ausgeprägte Stärke und Begeisterung für die Nutzung moderner digitaler Gesundheitstools und Softwarelösungen.

  • Kommunikation: Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen wie der ärztlichen Leitung und dem Praxismanagement.


Was Ovivamed dir bietet:

  • Die einzigartige Chance, die digitale Revolution im Gesundheitswesen in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Ein abwechslungsreiches und erfüllendes Aufgabengebiet, in dem das Wohl der Patient*innen an erster Stelle steht.

  • Attraktive Benefits wie ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget, Kauf von zusätzlichen Ferientagen sowie fortschrittliche Konditionen bei der beruflichen Vorsorge.

  • Ein hochmodernes Arbeitsumfeld, das Flexibilität und moderne Arbeitsmethoden vereint.

  • Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur, die Zusammenarbeit und Eigeninitiative feiert.



(a) = alle: Vielfalt ist uns wichtig.


Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:
Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich.

Ovivamed engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.
Wir begrüßen und ermutigen Bewerberinnen mit allen Hintergründen und Identitäten einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Nationalität, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, Fähigkeiten, Religion und sozioökonomischen Status. Wir suchen aktiv nach Kandidatinnen, die eine einzigartige Perspektive mitbringen, um uns beim Aufbau eines stärkeren, inklusiven Teams zu helfen.


Ovivamed engagiert sich für die Unterstützung von Kandidat*innen und Mitarbeiter*innen mit Behinderungen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb Dich noch heute!

title: Leiter Technische Entwicklung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

  • Anlagen weiterentwickeln: Sie entwickeln bestehende Maschinen und Anlagen technisch weiter und bringen Ihr Wissen in Automatisierungstechnik und SPS-Programmierung selbst ein, nicht nur in der Planung, sondern auch direkt an der Steuerung.

  • Prozesse optimieren: Sie erarbeiten Lösungen für mehr Anlagenverfügbarkeit, höheren Durchsatz, bessere Qualität und weniger Energieverbrauch in den Produktions- und Recyclingprozessen.

  • Projektführung und Investitionen: Sie begleiten technische Investitionsprojekte, Umbauten und die Einführung neuer Technologien.

  • Zusammenarbeit: Sie arbeiten mit externen Maschinenbauern, Dienstleistern und den internationalen Standorten der Gruppe zusammen.

Ihre Qualifikation:

  • Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Ingenieurstudium, zum Beispiel Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungs-, Verfahrens- oder Kunststofftechnik, oder eine vergleichbare Fachrichtung bzw. eine Ausbildung in diesem Bereich.

  • SPS: Sie kennen sich mit SPS-Steuerungen aus und programmieren selbst.

  • Führung: Sie haben bereits ein kleineres technisches Team geführt

Arbeitsbedingungen und Gehalt:

Monika Moser
