title: Manager Data & Tech Consulting F/H (CDD)
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

À propos de WPP Media

WPP est le leader mondial des services de communication et de transformation créative pour les plus grandes marques.

WPP Media est l'unité opérationnelle média de WPP, réunissant médias, data, technologies et partenariats pour délivrer une personnalisation créative à grande échelle. Connectés via notre plateforme d'IA marketing pionnière WPP Open et alimentés par Open Intelligence, nos collaborateurs permettent aux annonceurs de comprendre avec précision l'impact et la performance de leurs investissements médias.

Pour des raisons de clarté et d'accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l'écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances, en considérant l'ensemble des candidatures sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique, de religion ou de handicap.

Nos valeurs fondamentales :

  • Be Extraordinary : Cultiver un leadership collectif qui inspire des idées transformatrices.
  • Create an Open environment : Créer un équilibre fondé sur la confiance mutuelle, l'écoute et l'épanouissement des équipes.
  • Lead with Optimism : Stimuler activement l'apprentissage et le développement pour faire grandir l'organisation.

Le Rôle:

Au sein de l’entité Data, Tech & Analytics (DTA) de WPP Media, vous rejoignez le pôle Consulting, une équipe agile dédiée à l'accélération technologique et à la valorisation de la data au service des stratégies marketing de nos clients.

En tant que Manager Data & Tech Consulting, vous jouez un rôle pivot à la croisée du conseil stratégique, de l'avant-vente et de l'innovation. Véritable pont entre les enjeux business des annonceurs et l'expertise technique, votre mission est d'écouter, diagnostiquer, vulgariser et prescrire les meilleures solutions data & tech.

Vous intervenez comme un partenaire stratégique de confiance auprès des directeurs marketing clients ainsi que des équipes conseil et expertises médias internes.

Vos Missions Principales:

1. Diagnostic stratégique & Conseil client :

  • Analyser les besoins marketing et médias des clients (annonceurs nationaux et internationaux) et identifier leurs opportunités de transformation data (activation, mesure, attribution, qualification d'audience).
  • Conduire des diagnostics de maturité data et recommander des feuilles de route adaptées aux objectifs business des marques.
  • Vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes auprès d'interlocuteurs non spécialistes.

2. Avant-vente, Prescription & Développement d'offres :

  • Détecter proactivement les opportunités de valorisation des expertises DTA auprès des équipes conseil de l'agence et lors de briefs clients.
  • Concevoir les propositions de valeur adaptées en piochant dans le catalogue de solutions technologiques WPP (notamment la suite WPP Open et les agents IA) ou en élaborant des offres de conseil sur-mesure.
  • Rédiger les propositions commerciales, cadrer les devis (temps de conseil, outils) et porter la soutenance en clientèle lors de pitchs et de rendez-vous stratégiques.

3. Coordination transverse & Synergie technique :

  • Assurer la passerelle entre le besoin d'affaires du client et les équipes techniques internes (Data Scientists, ingénieurs et développeurs de l'équipe DTA).
  • Cadrer les projets en phase d'initiation et veiller à ce que les solutions déployées répondent parfaitement aux attentes initiales de l'annonceur.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d'activation média (Search, Social, Display, Programmatique) pour interconnecter la data et la performance de campagne.

Profil Recherché:

  • Expérience : 5 à 8 ans d'expérience dans une fonction de conseil data, de chef de projet digital/martech, de consultant avant-vente ou de stratégie média, idéalement acquise en cabinet de conseil digital, en agence média ou chez un acteur adtech.
  • Posture Conseil & aisance relationnelle : Excellentes capacités d'écoute, de pédagogie et de conviction. Vous savez instaurer une relation de confiance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau Direction et porter un discours commercial à forte valeur ajoutée.
  • Culture Data & Marketing Digital : Très bonne compréhension globale de l'écosystème de la data publicitaire. Vous maîtrisez le vocabulaire sans avoir besoin de manipuler les outils techniques au quotidien.
  • Esprit de synthèse & présentation : Maîtrise avancée de la conception de présentations percutantes pour traduire des problématiques techniques en opportunités business concrètes.
  • Langues : Français courant et pratique professionnelle fluide de l'anglais à l'écrit comme à l'oral (échanges réguliers avec nos réseaux internationaux et certains clients paneuropéens).

Avantages & vie chez WPP Media:

  • Cadre de travail : Un campus moderne et dynamique à Levallois-Perret, doté d'espaces collaboratifs, d'espaces extérieurs et de services de restauration d'entreprise.
  • Organisation du travail : Politique hybride flexible (jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail par semaine).
  • Accès aux technologies de pointe : Accès direct et formation aux innovations de pointe du groupe (suite WPP Open, solutions d'IA générative).
  • Engagement solidaire : Possibilité de participer à des missions d'intérêt général via notre programme We care and we act.

Processus de recrutement:

title: Marketing Intern
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a Marketing Intern to join the Contentoo team and help us turn good ideas into things people actually see.

This is a social and content-first role for someone who likes writing, design, internet culture, and making things. You might be a writer with a good visual eye, a designer who understands content, or somewhere in between.

You'll work with our Content Lead and Content Marketer, and you’ll help drive social media, campaigns, thought leadership, and podcasts. You'll start with hands-on execution and gain more ownership as you grow, all while collaborating with our wider team of specialists across events, SEO, design, video, and growth.

We're a small team, which means you won't spend six months doing one tiny corner of Marketing. You'll get to see how ideas go from “we should do something about this” to an actual campaign, post, page, podcast, or piece of content in the world.

 

About Contentoo

Contentoo helps global marketing teams scale content without turning their marketers into project managers.

We combine human expertise, technology, and managed content operations to take more of the production and coordination burden off marketing teams — so they can spend more time on the work that actually needs their judgement.

We're based in Amsterdam and work with ambitious marketing teams across Europe and beyond.

 

What you’ll be doing

A big part of the role is helping us get more mileage out of the ideas and content we already create.

You’ll help:

  • Publish and schedule social content

  • Engage with our community and keep an eye on conversations

  • Turn podcasts, reports, customer stories and existing content into new social formats

  • Create and adapt carousels, memes, quote cards, screenshots and other social assets

  • Support our employee advocacy and thought-leadership programmes

  • Help maintain our content and social calendars

  • Upload and format content on our website

  • Keep our content library, customer proof and marketing assets organised and up to date

  • Support campaigns with research, assets, distribution and reporting

  • Research competitors, trends and interesting things happening across marketing

  • Help with podcast, thought-leadership and event research

  • Spot good content worth giving a second (or third) life

You won't necessarily arrive knowing how to do all of this. That's the point!

 

Who we’re looking for

We're less interested in finding someone who already knows every marketing acronym and more interested in someone with taste, curiosity, and initiative.

You might be a good fit if:

  • You love writing or design — ideally with an interest in both

  • You understand what makes something interesting on social

  • You're curious about marketing, brands and internet culture

  • You notice good ideas, good copy and good creative

  • You're organised and care about the small details

  • You're comfortable learning new tools and figuring things out

  • You can take a clear brief and increasingly run with it

  • You have ideas of your own and aren't afraid to suggest them

  • You can start asap and are available 24- 40 h per week, being Tuesday to Thursday at our office in Amsterdam.

Figma skills are a big bonus.

Experience with CMSs, social scheduling, SEO, AI tools, or other marketing platforms is nice to have, but none of it is essential.

Video editing skills are also welcome, but this isn't a video-first role.

 

What you’ll learn

We want this to be an internship where you leave considerably better at marketing than when you arrived.

You'll get exposure to how a small Marketing team works across:

  • Social and content strategy

  • Brand and creative

  • Campaigns

  • Thought leadership

  • SEO and AI search

  • Customer and market research

  • Events and community

  • Product Marketing

  • B2B demand generation

  • Marketing performance and experimentation

You'll start by supporting the team with production and execution, but the goal is for you to take on more progressively.

Spot a meme opportunity? Make it.

Think there's a better hook? Tell us.

Find something interesting in the research? Bring it in.

Have an idea we haven't thought of? Even better.

 

What you'll get

  • A front-row seat to modern B2B marketing and the future of content

  • The chance to learn directly from experienced marketers in branding, ABM, and demand gen

  • The opportunity to experiment with leading AI tools and platforms

  • A €600 monthly internship compensation based on a full-time (40 h) internship. If you can't/don't want to work full-time, we are open to 24- 32 h per week too!

  • Free lunch at the office

  • Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens + remote flexibility)

  • A bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

  • A fun, inclusive team — with rooftop drinks, Mario Kart battles, boat days, and more

 

Sounds interesting?

Let's have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)

Als Mid Market Account Executive verkoop je dit platform aan organisaties met 250 tot 1000 medewerkers. Je bent eigenaar van het hele salestraject, van de discovery tot het getekende contract.

Je hebt de eerste jaren in sales achter de rug en wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen. Je wilt aan tafel zitten met directeuren, oplossingen op maat bedenken en deals sluiten die echt iets betekenen voor een organisatie. Bij Studytube krijg je daar alle ruimte voor, met begeleiding die je sneller beter maakt.

Waarom dit werk ertoe doet

Er worden miljarden uitgegeven aan opleidingen en organisaties investeren significant in opleiden. Toch mist meer dan de helft van de medewerkers nog steeds de skills die ze nodig hebben. Middelgrote organisaties voelen dat sterk: ze groeien snel, maar hebben vaak geen groot L&D-team. Studytube helpt hen leren slim te organiseren en af te stemmen op hun doelen. Jij laat zien hoe dat werkt voor hun situatie.

Jouw rol

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor nieuwe business in het mid-market-segment: organisaties met 250 tot 1.000 medewerkers in uiteenlopende sectoren. Je werkt met deals rond €3k MRR en een cyclus van 4 tot 6 maanden. Je bent eigenaar van het hele traject, van de eerste discovery tot het getekende contract.

  • Je bouwt je portfolio uit. Je combineert leads uit marketing met je eigen outbound en kiest bewust de organisaties waar Studytube het meeste verschil maakt.

  • Je verkoopt consultatief. Je doorgrondt de leer- en bedrijfsdoelen van een klant en vertaalt die naar een oplossing die ook over drie jaar nog werkt.

  • Je regisseert het aankooptraject. Je schakelt tussen HR, L&D en directie en weet wie je wanneer betrekt. Je houdt tempo zonder te pushen.

  • Je bent de stem van de klant. Wat je in gesprekken hoort, vertaal je naar inzichten voor Marketing, Product en Customer Success.


Wat jij meebrengt

  • 2 tot 5 jaar ervaring in B2B-sales, bij voorkeur in software of SaaS.

  • Je hebt zelfstandig deals gesloten van tussen de €25k en €75k ARR of meer, en je kunt laten zien hoe je je target hebt gehaald.

  • Je verkoopt consultatief: je stelt eerst de goede vragen en komt pas daarna met een oplossing.

  • Je praat net zo makkelijk met een L&D-adviseur als met een algemeen directeur.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands, en je Engels is goed.

  • Je wordt gedreven door targets en wilt winnen. Successen deel je met het team.

  • Je wilt snel groeien en vraagt zelf om feedback.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Een beloning die meegroeit met je resultaat. Basissalaris van €70k, OTE van €115k, het variabel deel is zonder plafond en er is een pensioenregeling.

  • Een duidelijk groeipad. Van Mid Market naar Enterprise AE, of richting een teamleadrol. We laten je zien wat je daarvoor nodig hebt en helpen je er te komen.

  • Ontwikkeling die je sneller beter maakt. Een persoonlijke coach, trainingen via de Studytube Level-Up Academy en dealcoaching van ervaren collega’s.

  • Ondersteuning om te verkopen. Leads uit DemandGen, een Solution Engineer voor complexere demo’s en een product met sterke referenties in jouw segment.

  • Ruimte om je eigen agenda in te delen. Drie dagen op kantoor, de rest bepaal je zelf. We sturen op resultaat, niet op aanwezigheid.

  • Een team en kantoor waar je graag bent. Ambitieuze collega’s die successen samen vieren, een eigen gym, verzorgde lunches en regelmatige teamuitjes.

Over Studytube

Studytube begon in 2011 bij twee rechtenstudenten. Ze bouwden een studietool voor zichzelf en ontdekten hoeveel beter mensen leren als het leren op hén is afgestemd. Dat inzicht is nog steeds de kern van wat we doen. Onze missie: het volledige potentieel van mensen ontsluiten met persoonlijk leren, op grote schaal.

Ons leerplatform combineert een LMS, een leeromgeving met AI-aanbevelingen, een Skill Navigator en een marketplace met meer dan 1.000 opleiders. Meer dan 700+ organisaties werken met Studytube, waaronder bol, a.s.r., CZ, ManpowerGroup en VolkerWessels. Met 200+ collega’s bouwen we aan onze internationale groei, met één doel: het platform voor professionele ontwikkeling worden waar Europa op vertrouwt.

For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

title: Mitarbeiter Kundenservice (m/w/d) - Vollzeit, bis zu 60% Home Office
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

book-n-drive ist einer der führenden regionalen Carsharing-Anbieter. Wir ermöglichen Menschen, flexibel auf ein Auto zuzugreifen, ohne selbst eines besitzen zu müssen. Gemeinsam mit Bus, Bahn und Fahrrad schaffen wir eine praktische Alternative zum eigenen Auto.

Wir möchten nicht einfach mehr Menschen zum Autofahren bewegen. Wir möchten Menschen dabei unterstützen, ihren tatsächlichen Mobilitätsbedarf flexibel, wirtschaftlich und möglichst ohne eigenes Auto zu organisieren.

Dafür entwickeln wir unseren Kundenservice weiter: Neben der zuverlässigen Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen wollen wir unsere Kunden künftig stärker persönlich begleiten, beraten und langfristig betreuen.

Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir eine kommunikative, eigenständige Persönlichkeit, die gerne auf Menschen zugeht, ihre Bedürfnisse versteht und gemeinsam mit ihnen passende Lösungen findet.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kunden aktiv betreuen: Du gehst gezielt auf Kunden zu und unterstützt sie dabei, book-n-drive optimal für ihren Mobilitätsbedarf zu nutzen.
  • Neukunden begleiten: Du hilfst neuen Kunden beim Einstieg, beantwortest Fragen und sorgst dafür, dass sie ihre ersten Erfahrungen mit book-n-drive erfolgreich meistern.
  • Mobilitätsbedarf verstehen: Du findest im Gespräch heraus, wann und wofür Kunden ein Auto benötigen, welche Alternativen sie nutzen und welche Hindernisse einer regelmäßigen Nutzung entgegenstehen.
  • Individuelle Lösungen finden: Du erklärst passende Fahrzeuge, Stationen, Tarife und Angebote und zeigst, wie sich Carsharing sinnvoll mit Bus, Bahn und Fahrrad kombinieren lässt.
  • Kundenbeziehungen entwickeln: Du betreust Kunden auch nach ihren ersten Fahrten, gehst auf Schwierigkeiten ein und hilfst ihnen, book-n-drive dauerhaft und bedarfsgerecht in ihren Alltag zu integrieren.
  • Kundenservice unterstützen: Du bearbeitest auch telefonische und schriftliche Kundenanfragen zu Registrierung, Buchung und Fahrzeugnutzung und unterstützt das Team bei Bedarf im laufenden Service.
  • Kundenfeedback nutzen: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Fragen, Vorbehalte und Verbesserungspotenziale und bringst deine Erkenntnisse in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Angebote und Abläufe ein.
  • Mit Marketing zusammenarbeiten: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Marketingteam Ideen für die gezielte Kundenansprache, unterstützt Kontaktaktionen und hilfst dabei, deren Wirkung zu bewerten.
  • Digitale Werkzeuge einsetzen: Du nutzt moderne Serviceanwendungen und KI-Werkzeuge, um Kundeninformationen aufzubereiten, Gespräche vorzubereiten und deine Arbeit effizient zu organisieren.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und gehst gerne von dir aus auf andere zu.
  • Du kannst gut zuhören, stellst die richtigen Fragen und erkennst, was dein Gegenüber wirklich braucht.
  • Du kommunizierst freundlich, überzeugend und verbindlich – telefonisch ebenso wie schriftlich.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig und behältst auch längerfristige Kundenkontakte im Blick.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse und Interesse an wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen und offen dafür, KI-Werkzeuge im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen.
  • Du hast Interesse an nachhaltiger Mobilität und findest die Idee spannend, Menschen eine attraktive Alternative zum eigenen Auto aufzuzeigen.
  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team und möchtest nicht nur einzelne Kundenanliegen lösen, sondern auch unsere Kundenbetreuung insgesamt verbessern.

Erfahrung in der Kundenberatung, im Kundenservice oder in einer vertriebsnahen Tätigkeit ist von Vorteil. Wichtiger sind uns deine Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative und Freude an der persönlichen Kundenbetreuung.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit, in der du Kundenservice und aktive Kundenberatung miteinander verbindest.
  • Die Möglichkeit, einen neuen Bereich der aktiven Kundenbetreuung bei book-n-drive mit aufzubauen und mitzugestalten.

Dein Einstieg bei uns

Zunächst lernst du unsere Produkte, Systeme und Abläufe kennen und arbeitest dich in den operativen Kundenservice ein.

Anschließend übernimmst du zunehmend Aufgaben in der aktiven Kundenbetreuung. Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Kundenservice entwickelst du Ansätze, um Kunden gezielt anzusprechen, beim Einstieg zu unterstützen und langfristig zu begleiten.

title: ML Runtime Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure?

 Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours.
The AI Engineering team is where models meet the spacecraft. We own the full path from a partner's trained model to something that actually runs — fast — on flight hardware: compiling ONNX models into optimized engines for each accelerator, the Space Inference Engine and its execution providers, the SDK that packages models for flight, and the perf tooling that proves a model fits its power, thermal, and latency budget before it ever leaves the ground. As we open the platform to a growing roster of defense and Earth-observation partners, the team's scope and the range of silicon we target are expanding fast.

As our ML Runtime Engineer, you'll own model compilation and the performance tooling behind it. We're looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who takes an unfamiliar model and an unforgiving power budget, digs into the graph, and gets it running on real hardware without waiting for the path to be handed to them. You'll move between model compilation, runtime internals, quantization, and hardware-in-the-loop CI, sometimes in the same afternoon.
About this role:
  • Own model compilation: turn partner ONNX models into optimized engines per accelerator (TensorRT, Hailo, AMD/ROCm), within power & thermal budgets
  • Build the ground-side compile & delivery path; define how a mismatched engine is detected/rejected on-node
  • Build performance tooling: benchmarking, profiling, operator-coverage matrices, and budget validation
  • Contribute to Space Inference Engine (execution providers) and the SDK (model build & packaging); coordinate the OBSW / Runtime team

Must Haves:
  • Strong C++ and Python
  • Model compilation: TensorRT (and/or equivalent graph compilers)
  • ONNX Runtime, quantization & inference perf optimization
  • Embedded / edge GPU deployment (NVIDIA Jetson)
  • Benchmarking & profiling / perf tooling
  • CI/CD incl. hardware-in-the-loop

Nice to Haves:
  • Hailo SDK and/or AMD ROCm compilation (iX10)
  • Writing custom kernels / operator plugins
  • Remote sensing / large-image handling
  • RF / IQ signal data exposure
  • Meson build, Yocto / minimal Debian images
  • Model-weight protection / secure execution

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    • *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
    Who We Are
    Loft: Space Made Simple.
    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.
    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.
    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

title: Network Development Engineer, Data Center Fabrics
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Network Development Engineer, Data Center Fabrics, you will help design and build systems for operating large-scale networks within our data centers. You will apply deep networking expertise to leaf-spine architecture, automation, testing, and production troubleshooting across Ethernet switching, IP routing, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, and VRFs.

This is a hands-on role for a networking expert who is also comfortable building production software. Go and Kubernetes experience are helpful but not required; strong engineering fundamentals and network automation experience matter more.

What You Will Do

  • Design and evolve leaf-spine underlays, EVPN/VXLAN overlays, and tenant connectivity for multi-tenant AI infrastructure.

  • Translate data-center fabric requirements and safety properties into clear APIs, data models, validation, and automation.

  • Build reliable control-plane software that reconciles desired and observed network state.

  • Design safe change workflows with validation, dry runs, atomic updates, observability, and failure recovery.

  • Integrate with data-center switch operating systems and management APIs while maintaining vendor-neutral abstractions where practical.

  • Participate in the on-call rotation, troubleshoot active data-center network incidents, restore service, and turn root causes into lasting improvements.

  • Review designs and code, explain networking trade-offs, and help raise network engineering quality across the organization.

  • Develop lab and production tests and turn operational lessons into better software and architecture.

What We’re Looking For

  • Deep hands-on experience with Ethernet switching, IP routing, BGP-based leaf-spine fabrics, EVPN/VXLAN, and VRF-based multitenancy.

  • Strong judgment around fabric underlay and overlay design, scale, convergence, isolation, and failure modes.

  • Experience building or operating production network automation, including desired state, idempotency, concurrency, observability, and recovery.

  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in a general-purpose language. You can design, test, debug, and review production systems and are willing to become productive in Go.

  • Experience with southbound network APIs and structured configuration, such as REST, gNMI/OpenConfig, or NETCONF.

  • Hands-on experience with major data-center network operating systems, such as Cumulus Linux, Arista EOS, SONiC, Junos, or NX-OS.

  • Strong diagnostic skills using routing and EVPN state, packet captures, counters, telemetry, and logs.

  • Clear, pragmatic communication and a collaborative approach to technical leadership.

Nice to Have

  • Experience reading, reviewing, or contributing to Go code.

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes controllers, operators, CRDs, reconciliation, or Kubebuilder.

  • Experience with physical or simulated network labs such as containerlab, NVIDIA Air, EVE-NG, GNS3, or similar environments.

  • Experience with high-performance Ethernet, RoCE, InfiniBand, HPC, or large-scale GPU infrastructure.

What We Offer

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

This role is for someone wanting to start a career in operations within a financial services firm. You'll join as a Graduate focused on working complaints and train to become a fully competent Complaints Officer, investigating and resolving our more complex customer interactions across loans, cards and auto-finance. A critical role to help the business understand how it can serve customers better.

This is a casework role. From early on you will hold your own caseload, speak to customers directly, make decisions on whether we got it right, and put things right where we didn't. You will be supported through structured training, coaching and quality feedback as you develop in the role

Some of the areas you'll delve into are:

  • The regulatory framework for complaints: FCA regulation, the DISP rules, Consumer Duty, and how the guidance is applied to real cases.

  • Investigation technique: gathering evidence, interrogating system records and call recordings, and testing what actually happened against what should have happened.

  • Decision making and redress: reaching fair and objective outcomes, and calculating and explaining any compensation due.

  • Customer communication: writing final response letters that break complex issues down into plain English.

  • The Financial Ombudsman Service: how cases are referred, how FOS reaches its view, and how we apply those learnings to future cases.

  • Root cause and feedback: spotting the product and process failures behind complaints and feeding them back to frontline and product teams.

Reporting to a Complaints Manager within the Operations Team, you will be responsible for a live caseload and for the quality of the decisions you make on it.

No prior complaints experience needed, we care about how you think, not what you already know. This role requires an ability to learn quickly, work to deadlines and support our customers effectively.

Your team's objectives

Lendable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and to reaching the right outcomes for our customers.

Feedback is an important part of how we evolve as a business. The team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insight back into the business so we can improve and grow.

Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers and therefore for us as a business has never been more important than now, as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets.

What you'll be doing

  • Investigating and resolving complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, taking each case on its own merits

  • Self-managing a varied and increasingly complex caseload: prioritising cases, choosing the best contact mechanism for each customer, and working efficiently enough to meet our KPI minimum standards

  • Communicating with complainants in writing and by phone — managing expectations, handling difficult situations with tact and professionalism, and finding solutions to the issues raised

  • Writing professional final response letters that set out our decision, our rationale and the customer's right to refer to the Financial Ombudsman Service

  • Following our complaint handling standards and keeping clear records, making sure every decision is backed by demonstrable evidence and a documented rationale

  • Working to resolve complaints without the customer needing to refer to FOS, and applying the learnings from both internal and FOS outcomes to future cases

  • Feeding back to frontline and product teams on the product and process improvements your cases surface, across Operations and the wider Lendable business

  • Keeping your knowledge of Lendable's products current through effective use and review of our policies, procedures and business tools

  • Turning your hand to other areas of operational need as the business requires

What we're looking for

  • Educated to degree level

  • Exceptional written communication - you can structure an argument and explain a complex decision clearly to someone who is not an expert

  • An aptitude for investigation, analysis, problem-solving and dispute resolution

  • Strong organisation and self-management - you can hold a caseload, prioritise it and work to deadlines without being chased

  • Sound judgment and a sound moral compass: willing to speak up to make sure good customer outcomes stay at the heart of what we do

  • Resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced, changing environment

  • A willingness to learn FCA regulation and the DISP complaint handling rules and guidance

The interview process

We're not a corporation so we try our best to get things moving as quickly as possible. For this role we'd expect:

  • A 15 minute cognitive assessment

  • A quick phone call with one of the Talent team

  • An onsite assessment centre with a role focus and a final stage interview with the Complaints Management team to discuss your fit and capability for the role.

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Selon le profil, ce poste peut permettre d'accéder au capital de la société via des BSPCE.

Vos missions

Missions pentest / Red Team

  • Réaliser de nombreux pentests sur divers environnements et applications : externes, web, internes, Cloud, etc. (vous n'aurez pas d'audit organisationnel) ;

  • Réaliser et encadrer nos campagnes de Red Team ;

  • Automatiser vos attaques dans notre plateforme Rigma.

Management de l'équipe pentest

  • Encadrer et faire monter en compétence les pentesters de l'équipe ;

  • Participer au recrutement des pentesters afin de construire une équipe cohérente avec notre ADN.

Rayonnement technique de Mobeta

  • Encadrer les sujets R&D de l'équipe pentest (blog posts, outils, recherche de 0-day) ;

  • Représenter Mobeta en conférences (talks).

Outillage technique & IA

  • Industrialisation et automatisation des phases répétitives du pentest ;

  • Veille active, capitalisation ;

  • Exploitation maximale de l'IA ;

  • Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe produit et participer aux développements à intégrer dans Rigma.

La partie Missions Pentest / Red Team est prioritaire et indispensable, elle représentera, surtout au début, la majorité de votre temps de travail.

Les autres tâches seront intégrées au fur et à mesure de la montée en responsabilité.

Vos compétences

  • Expérience confirmée en pentest / Red Team ;

  • Maîtrise d’un langage de scripting ainsi que des principes de développement sécurisé ;

  • Capacité à encadrer et faire progresser une équipe ;

  • Passionné par la sécurité informatique et le pentest (challenges, CTF, etc.) ;

  • Utilisation intense de l'IA pour les usages concrets, notamment appliqués au pentest ;

  • Sens de l'organisation et de la rigueur, avec de fortes capacités d'analyse et rédactionnelles ;

  • Capacité à apprendre rapidement ;

  • Aisance à l’oral et capacité à restituer clairement des sujets techniques ;

  • Humble et fiable ;

  • Présence physique au moins partielle dans nos locaux à Paris.

Ce qui est apprécié :

  • Certifications en sécurité offensive (OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, CRTE, prolabs HTB, etc.) ;

Avantages

title: People & Culture Graduate (UK) - 2027
descriptionHtml:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.

Job description

About the team

At Castrol, our people are central to how we grow our business, serve our customers and build for the future. Our People & Culture team partners with the business to attract, develop, engage and retain the talent we need to succeed. 

As a People & Culture Graduate, you will join a two-year development programme designed to build strong P&C foundations and prepare you for a long-term career in the function. Through a series of cross-functional rotations, you may gain experience across P&C Partnering, Centres of Expertise such as Talent and Reward, and Operations & Advisory. 

Each assignment will give you the opportunity to contribute to real business and people priorities, build practical P&C capability and understand how different parts of the function work together to support the business. 

Key tasks

  • A structured two-year development journey through cross-functional P&C rotations. 
  • Experience across areas such as P&C Partnering, Talent, Reward, Operations & Advisory, and other P&C disciplines. 
  • Opportunities to build broad P&C capability and deeper expertise through meaningful assignments. 
  • Exposure to business priorities and insight into how P&C contributes to organisational performance. 
  • Ownership of real work, supported by experienced P&C colleagues, line managers and programme leadership. 
  • Potential international exposure where relevant to your development and business needs.
  • Continuous learning through experience, feedback, challenge and formal development opportunities. 

Your assignments will reflect programme priorities, your development needs and business requirements. They may include opportunities to: 

  • Partner with the business on organisation, workforce and people priorities. 
  • Use people data and insight to understand challenges and develop practical recommendations. 
  • Contribute to talent, capability, performance, reward, culture or employee experience initiatives. 
  • Support organisational change and transformation activities. 
  • Help translate people priorities into clear and deliverable actions. 
  • Explore how P&C solutions need to adapt across different markets and business contexts. 

Experience required

Essential 

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Organisational Behaviour or another relevant discipline. 
  • A strong academic track record from a recognised university. 
  • 1-2 years relevant working experience following graduation 
  • A genuine interest in building a long-term career in People & Culture. 
  • Strong intellectual curiosity, learning agility and critical thinking, with the ability to explore issues beyond the surface. 
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data and information into meaningful insight and practical recommendations. 
  • Commercial curiosity and an interest in how people, organisation and culture contribute to business performance. 
  • Strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage stakeholders professionally. 
  • The ability to build effective relationships and work collaboratively across different cultures, perspectives and working styles. 
  • Adaptability, initiative, maturity and resilience, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and change. 
  • Willingness and flexibility to relocate for selected assignments where required. 
  • Strong English communication skills and the confidence to work in a multicultural business environment. 

Desirable 

  • Relevant internships, placements, projects or early-career experience in P&C, consulting, business or a related field. 
  • Experience studying, living or working in a multicultural environment.
  • Evidence of leadership, initiative or meaningful contribution through university, community or professional activities. 

Your Future at Castrol 

Your two-year journey is designed to build broad P&C capability, commercial understanding and the confidence to operate across different parts of the function. 

By the end of the programme, our ambition is for you to have developed strong P&C foundations, meaningful cross-functional experience and the potential to take on a substantive P&C role within Castrol. 

Privacy

We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.).

If you are selected for a position and depending upon your role, your employment may be contingent upon adherence to local policy. This may include pre-placement drug screening, medical review of physical fitness for the role, and background checks.

title: People Performance Manager
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🚀 The Role

We're hiring a People Performance Manager to join our Performance Service.

tem is growing fast. Our goal is to get better as we get bigger - revenue growing faster than headcount. In practice that means keeping our strongest people engaged and performing, getting new joiners productive quickly, and enabling our leaders to multiply their impact over time. Most companies solve that with layers of management. We don't. Our leaders (Player-Coaches) coach their teams while staying hands-on with the work, which means the systems around them have to do more of the lifting. That's where the Performance Service comes in.

We're a team of four, and we own how tem runs as an organisation: the operating rhythm (how work gets planned, tracked, escalated and reported), the onboarding and development that build capability, the frameworks that define what good performance looks like and how people progress and get paid, and the operational backbone of contracts, benefits and payroll. We don't own recruitment. We're adding a second Performance Partner because we need more hands on deck - both partnering with our leaders day to day, and building the frameworks that support them.

Your patch is sustained performance - the part that runs continuously once someone is through the door. You'll carry a portfolio of leaders across our Engines and Services that you're accountable for, and you'll co-own the frameworks that sit underneath them alongside the rest of the team. You will not be handed a finished playbook to administer. You'll report into the Performance Service Manager. HR experience is welcome but not required - we're open to operators, people who've led teams, and the sort of person who ends up owning whatever the company needs next.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Become the first call for a portfolio of leaders on anything to do with their people - performance calls, team decisions and hard conversations.

  • Co-design how progression, performance standards, evaluation and reward actually work at tem, alongside the rest of the Performance team.

  • Handle live cases end to end - performance management, difficult conversations, exits and restructures.

  • Use AI and automation so the operational layer runs itself and your time goes on judgement, not process.

  • Turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service, and measure whether they work.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • Coach and challenge: be a leader's first call on anything to do with their people - a decision they want a second view on, coaching on how to handle a situation, or a read on employment law - and hold a position when you disagree with them.

  • Raise the bar: hold leaders to a high standard on performance, potential, pay and progression - help them make sharper calls, and hold consistency across your patch.

  • Handle live cases end to end: performance management, difficult conversations, exits and restructures.

  • Build to delight: shape how progression, performance standards, evaluation and reward actually work at tem, alongside the rest of the Performance team. We treat our people like top athletes, and our aim is to delight them at every step of their employee experience - the systems around them have to express that at every contact point.

  • Design for our shape, not the textbook: we index on outcomes and impact in everything - how progression works, how teams are structured, what leaders spend their time on. Most standard people frameworks assume a management hierarchy we don't have.

  • Automate the repeatable: use AI and automation so the operational layer runs itself and your time goes on judgement, not process.

  • Think in process, scalability and iteration: turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service. Measure whether they work and redesign when they don't fit the purpose.

✅ Requirements

You do not need a CIPD qualification, and you do not need to have worked in a large, established HR function. You might have been a founder's associate or Chief of Staff at a Series A or B startup, holding the place together while it scaled. You might have built a People function from scratch and taken it from a one-person band to a well-oiled machine. You might have run a team or an Operations function where the people calls were effectively yours, even if People or HR never appeared in your job title. Or you might have done a different job that helped you build the skills below. A background in HR might help you do this job well, but it is not a requirement.

Must-Haves

  • You've held real accountability for decisions on people - you've partnered with leaders, or managed a team yourself, where hiring, performance and exit calls were either yours or made on your guidance.

  • You can be trusted with the hardest conversations in the business and you're recognised for how you handle them, and you understand how decisions about people shape culture and employer brand - balancing efficiency with empathy.

  • You've worked in or towards building a high-performance culture, and you're a confident challenger who carries conviction and can influence leadership decisions.

  • You're comfortable operating without a playbook, in a company where the requirements and the shape of your role change constantly.

  • You think from first principles, get to the root cause of complex problems, weigh competing considerations and anticipate second-order consequences.

  • You're fluent with Notion, automation and AI tooling - your instinct is to build the thing rather than do it manually a second time - and you write clearly enough that a busy person reads it once and comes away with a clear idea of the situation and the next actions.

Desirable

  • Employment relations experience in the UK, Europe or the US - we operate across the UK and Europe today, with plans to expand to the US soon.

  • Experience working across multiple countries, including employer of record arrangements.

  • Compensation and benchmarking experience - salary banding, pay review cycles, market data.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing.

🤝 Interview Process

We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know.

  • Intro call with our Talent team.

  • Skills interview, which might include a practical exercise we may ask you to prepare in advance.

  • Hiring Manager interview.

  • Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Photonics Characterisation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The role

We are looking for a Photonic Characterisation Engineer to join our Photonics team and play a key role in the experimental characterisation of advanced integrated photonic devices.

This is a highly hands-on position where you will design and run experiments, operate optical test equipment, analyse measurement data and help turn experimental results into clear engineering insight. Your work will support teams across photonic design, manufacturing and system testing, helping ensure technical decisions are grounded in high-quality, repeatable data.

You will work across both die-level and wafer-level characterisation, combining practical laboratory work with Python-based data analysis and experimental automation. Over time, you will take increasing ownership of characterisation activities, from defining test approaches through to delivering results and communicating conclusions to stakeholders.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys being in the lab, working through difficult experimental problems and moving comfortably between optics, software and data.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and execute experiments to characterise integrated photonic devices and structures

  • Operate optical and photonic laboratory equipment across a range of measurement setups

  • Carry out die-level and wafer-level testing

  • Analyse experimental data using Python and relevant scientific computing tools

  • Develop scripts and workflows to automate data collection and analysis

  • Translate experimental requirements into practical, repeatable test methodologies

  • Identify measurement issues, investigate unexpected results and troubleshoot experimental setups

  • Validate data quality before results are used by wider engineering teams

  • Produce clear technical reports, analysis and summaries from experimental work

  • Collaborate closely with photonic design, manufacturing and system testing teams

  • Support the development and improvement of laboratory processes, test methods and automation

  • Take ownership of characterisation tasks and provide realistic timelines for delivery

As you develop in the role, you will be expected to work increasingly independently, building new test methods where required and taking experiments from initial planning through execution, analysis and communication of results.

What we're looking for

  • An MSc, PhD or equivalent practical experience in Physics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, or a closely related discipline

  • A strong understanding of optics and photonics fundamentals

  • Hands-on experience designing and running experiments

  • Experience working in an optics, photonics or similarly technical laboratory environment

  • Experience analysing real-world experimental data using Python

  • Familiarity with scientific Python libraries such as NumPy, SciPy or pandas

  • A practical understanding of experimental uncertainty, noisy data and measurement quality

  • Strong fault-finding and troubleshooting skills

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team

  • Strong attention to detail and critical thinking

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills

  • The ability to present technical results clearly to different audiences

You should be comfortable spending a significant proportion of your time working physically in the laboratory. This is not primarily a theoretical or simulation-focused position.

Even better if you have

  • Experience working with photonic wafer-level test systems or probe stations

  • Experience with integrated photonic devices and their characterisation

  • Experience automating experimental setups or measurement equipment using Python

  • Familiarity with optical alignment, calibration and measurement techniques

  • Experience with free-space optics

  • Knowledge of photonic integrated circuit fabrication or semiconductor processes

  • Experience developing reusable experimental or data-analysis tools

  • Previous experience in an R&D or product development environment

  • Experience working in a startup or another environment where processes are still evolving

  • Familiarity with Agile ways of working, Jira or similar project-management tools

  • Experience communicating the same technical results to both specialist and non-specialist audiences

Relevant backgrounds might include photonics or optics R&D laboratories, integrated photonics research, experimental physics, electrical engineering, semiconductor development or related fields. The common thread is strong experimental judgement and the ability to turn physical measurements into trustworthy engineering conclusions.

This is an opportunity to work on genuinely challenging experimental problems in photonics while helping shape how characterisation is carried out as our engineering capability grows.

You will have access to advanced laboratory equipment, work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams and have meaningful ownership over both the experiments you run and how the wider characterisation capability develops.

The role is UK-based and predominantly on site, with a minimum of four days per week in the lab.

descriptionHtml:
Présentation de Télécom SudParis :

Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. La qualité de ses formations est basée sur l’excellence scientifique de son corps professoral et une pédagogie mettant l’accent sur les projets d’équipes, l’innovation de rupture et l’entreprenariat. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

Activités

  1. Assurer des activités de recherche en théorie de l’information quantique

  • Étudier et chercher à démontrer des inégalités entropiques quantiques intervenant en théorie de l’information quantique bosonique, notamment des inégalités liées à l’action des diviseurs de faisceau et d’autres transformations bosoniques physiquement pertinentes.

  • Développer de nouveaux outils mathématiques pour l’analyse des états et canaux bosoniques non gaussiens, en s’appuyant notamment sur des méthodes issues de la théorie de l’information quantique, de l’analyse matricielle et des opérateurs, de la théorie de la majorisation et de domaines connexes.

  • Appliquer ces résultats à la caractérisation de la transmission de l’information à travers les canaux quantiques bosoniques, en particulier à l’établissement de formules de capacité ainsi que de bornes supérieures ou inférieures sur les capacités de communication.

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.

Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée.

Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage.

Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM.

À propos du projet PLEIADES

Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM.

Vos principales missions seront de :

  • Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique

  • Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

  • Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris


Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission optique ainsi qu’en traitement numérique du signal (DSP) appliqué aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique. La maîtrise de MATLAB et/ou Python pour le développement d’algorithmes DSP sera appréciée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes à l’aise dans un environnement multiculturel, notamment pour encadrer des stagiaires et/ou des étudiants. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Vous disposez également de bonnes qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des informations complexes.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers).

  • télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible

  • Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne...

  • A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé
