title: Post-Silicon Validation Team Leader
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

You will lead Fractile’s Post-Silicon Validation team, taking first silicon from power-on to a fully characterised, working product. The team sits within the Architecture group and owns functional validation (bring-up) and characterisation of new silicon as it returns from manufacture, enabling the system-level product bring-up. You will build validation and characterisation content under simulation ahead of first silicon, deploy and debug it on the real devices, and drive the test infrastructure and methodology the whole programme depends on.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor and provide technical direction to the Post-Silicon Validation team

  • Plan, design, develop and debug silicon validation and characterisation tests on pre-silicon platforms ahead of first silicon

  • Deploy and debug validation and characterisation tests on first silicon, from initial bring-up through to full functional coverage and silicon characterisation

  • Develop automated test frameworks and regression suites to raise validation throughput

  • Architect and drive continuous improvement of test infrastructure, methodology and processes

  • Analyse test results, isolate failures and root-cause defects across hardware, firmware and software boundaries

  • Enable and support production systems, firmware and software teams through their bring-up

  • Contribute to shared test and validation infrastructure used across the programme

  • Feed findings back to architects and designers to shape future silicon

  • Report programme status and progress to programme management

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in post-silicon validation in digital ASIC environments

  • Experience in characterisation, failure analysis, test development, statistical analysis

  • Experience leading or technically directing a validation or test engineering team

  • Strong low-level, system software development

  • Excellent working knowledge of digital ASIC design and architecture

  • Ability to work across teams, abstraction layers and programming languages to root-cause deep and complex issues

  • Strong system debug, log analysis and failure isolation skills

  • Ability to drive cross-functional work and communicate clearly with engineering and programme management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Driver-level experience with PCIe, memory technologies (LPDDR, DDR, HBM) or peripherals such as I2C, I3C and SPI

  • Knowledge of mixed-signal building blocks — PLLs, high-speed PHYs — and on-chip control and communication protocols

  • Experience with RISC-V CPUs, system IP and associated debug tooling

  • Experience with AMBA protocols

  • Understanding of ML applications and their workloads

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Pricing & Commercial Strategy Director, WPP Open
descriptionHtml:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

This role is crucial for driving revenue growth and optimising pricing strategies for WPP and specifically WPP Open. The Pricing & Commercial Strategy Director will collaborate with deal support, product teams, operations, and enablement to develop and implement effective pricing models, support client negotiations, and ensure consistent application of pricing principles. This role requires an analytical mindset, excellent communication skills, and a deep understanding of the media and advertising landscape

What you'll be doing:

WPP Open Pricing Strategy: 

  • Lead pricing projects to develop the WPP Open pricing strategy for self service.
  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify pricing trends and opportunities. 
  • Develop and maintain pricing models and tools to support pricing decisions. 
  • Use data-driven insights to inform revisions to pricing models and approaches 

Sales Support & Deal Structuring: 

  • Partner with Account teams and Network commercial teams to develop compelling and competitive pricing proposals for new and existing clients. 
  • Serve as the point of contact and subject matter expert on deal constructs, special pricing, and ad hoc troubleshooting of deal issues and sales escalations. 
  • Negotiate pricing and contractual terms with clients. 
  • Provide quick and accurate responses to client teams inquiries regarding WPP Open pricing. 
  • Develop pricing proposals for individual deals, including WPP Open pilot programs and use cases. 

Enablement: 

  • Create and deliver pricing communication materials, including pricing guides, value propositions, and training sessions for internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Effectively communicate pricing changes and updates to relevant parties. 

Analysis & Reporting: 

  • Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses using internal (e.g., financials) and external (e.g., benchmarks) sources to support pricing strategy development.

title: Principal Connectivity Lead – Data Center Deployment
descriptionHtml:

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The role

We are seeking a Principal Connectivity Lead to drive fiber infrastructure deployment across our data center campus portfolio. This role provides hands-on execution support for immediate campus projects while establishing technical leadership across fiber pathways, ISP/OSP connectivity, vendor management, and quality standards. As the portfolio expands, the role will oversee regional delivery across multiple sites.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Network Connectivity Delivery, you will partner with Construction, Network Engineering, and operational teams to standardise vendor performance and deliver seamless fiber connectivity for high-density compute environments.

What you will do

Pre-construction & Regional Planning

  • Regional Delivery Framework: Establish standardized execution models for ISP/OSP campus fiber deployment across our projects.

  • Infrastructure Alignment: Coordinate intra-campus pathways, duct banks, building entry points, meet-me rooms, optical distribution frames, and data hall cabling layouts with construction and engineering teams.

Field Delivery & Execution

  • Proven experience delivering OSP/ISP fiber connectivity in hyperscale data centers or large campus environments.

  • Track record of managing specialized fiber contractors and coordinating construction interface dependencies.

  • Strong leadership discipline in quality assurance, labeling, as-built documentation, and operational handovers.

Nice to have

  • AI / GPU Environments: Experience with high-density fiber interconnects for GPU clusters or high-performance compute AI architectures.

  • Digital Asset Tracking: Familiarity with network asset management systems, DCIM platforms, or automated fiber monitoring software.

  • Certifications: Industry qualifications in fiber optic design, installation, or testing (e.g., FOA, BICSI, CFHP).

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.

title: Principal Thermal-Mechanical Engineer-Munich, Germany
descriptionHtml:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

title: Product & Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst ein Produkt verantworten, das Ärzt:innen jeden Tag öffnen, um ihre Praxis zu steuern – und selbst dafür sorgen, dass jede Praxis damit Erfolg hat? Du redest lieber mit Nutzer:innen, als Annahmen zu treffen? Dann komm zu MediPulse!

Healthcare is broken. Das wollen wir ändern, und dafür suchen wir Dich!

Über MediPulse

Ärzt:innen führen ihre Praxis wie ein mittelständisches Unternehmen: mit Personal, Investitionen und Kreditlinien. Gesteuert wird sie trotzdem im Blindflug. Das Honorar der KV steht erst Monate nach Quartalsende fest, die BWA kommt Wochen zu spät, und der Überblick entsteht mühsam in Excel. Engpässe zeigen sich erst, wenn sie längst eingetreten sind.

Das ändern wir. MediPulse verbindet Praxisverwaltungssystem und Bankkonten und zeigt Umsatz, Kosten und Liquidität tagesaktuell, aufgeschlüsselt nach KV, HZV und Privat, nach Standort, Arzt und Ziffer. Über 300 Arztpraxen und MVZ steuern damit heute ihre Praxis, 2025 hat uns die ENTSCHEIDERFABRIK mit ihrem Startup- und Digitalisierungspreis ausgezeichnet. Unser Ziel: Jede Praxis in Deutschland weiß jeden Tag, wo sie wirtschaftlich steht.

Wir sind ein kleines Team in München, mit Leuten von McKinsey und BCG, einem Arzt im Gründungsteam und Entwickler:innen mit durchweg 5+ Jahren Erfahrung. Wir arbeiten schnell und mit viel KI, übernehmen Verantwortung für das, was wir bauen, und bleiben dabei bodenständig.

Deine Mission

Als Product & Customer Success Manager bist du nah dran wie niemand sonst: Du bringst neue Praxen erfolgreich an den Start, bist Ansprechpartner:in für unsere Kund:innen und entscheidest mit, was MediPulse als Nächstes kann. Was du in der Betreuung hörst, machst du zu Features, die unser Entwicklerteam mehrmals pro Woche ausliefert. Kein Produktteam, das über Kund:innen redet, sondern eines, das jeden Tag mit ihnen spricht. Deine Arbeit entscheidet, ob eine Praxis ihren Engpass rechtzeitig sieht oder erst, wenn das Geld fehlt.

Woran du arbeitest

  • Onboarding: neue Praxen und MVZ so einrichten und schulen, dass sie ab der ersten Woche mit ihren Zahlen arbeiten

  • Abrechnung im laufenden Quartal: Praxen sollen schon vor dem Honorarbescheid sehen, was sie verdient haben – nach KV, HZV und Privat, nach Arzt und Ziffer
  • Liquidität: aus Kontodaten und Abrechnung eine Vorschau machen, auf die sich eine Praxis bei Investitionen und Personalentscheidungen verlassen kann
  • Roadmap: aus Gesprächen und Nutzungsdaten Prioritäten ableiten und Konzepte schreiben, mit denen das Entwicklerteam direkt loslegen kann

Mit wem du arbeitest

Du arbeitest eng mit Alex und Kolja, unseren Gründern, und mit Jonas, unserem Tech Lead. Jonas ist approbierter Arzt und Entwickler und kennt beide Welten, die das Produkt braucht.

Was dich auszeichnet

  • Du hast einige Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, im Customer Success oder in beidem, idealerweise mit B2B-Software
  • Du erklärst Komplexes einfach und gewinnst das Vertrauen von Ärzt:innen und Praxismanager:innen
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Gesprächen und Daten und kannst sie gut begründen
  • Du schreibst Konzepte, mit denen ein Team direkt loslegen kann
  • Du hast technisches Verständnis und begegnest Entwickler:innen auf Augenhöhe
  • Du hast Lust, dich in eine komplexe Fachdomäne einzuarbeiten (EBM, GOÄ, KV-Abrechnung). Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse – unsere Nutzer:innen sprechen Deutsch

Was wir bieten

  • Büro direkt am Marienplatz und ein Team, das eng vor Ort zusammenarbeitet
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Raum für Home-Office
  • Moderne Hardware deiner Wahl (z. B. MacBook) und Zugang zu den KI-Werkzeugen, die du brauchst
  • Fitnessabo (Wellpass) und attraktive Corporate Benefits
  • Direkter Draht zu echten Nutzer:innen und sichtbarer Impact ab Tag eins
  • Viel Verantwortung und die Chance, unser Produkt von Grund auf mitzugestalten

Bereit, Healthcare besser zu machen?

Kein langes Anschreiben nötig. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen zu einem Produkt, Feature oder Kundenprojekt, auf das du stolz bist – und warum. Dann reden wir darüber, was wir gemeinsam bauen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

In a nutshell, you’ll help more people get onboarded into Marshmallow by reducing friction in our sign up and activation flow. You’ll be thinking about the content on the screen and edge cases too. It’s primarily customer facing, web and app but if your work touches our internal tools, you’ll be thinking about that too.

  • Letting data point the way. You’ll use funnel and analytics data to find where customers get stuck and where we could be causing harm. Then you’ll work with your team to fix it.

  • Building with engineers. You’ll work alongside them from the first idea to what’s shipped. Clear specs and smooth handoffs. If a design tweak is quicker to ship yourself, you can raise the PR.

title: Product Marketing Manager, Energy & Defence
descriptionHtml:
Finance Deserves Better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, project or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée. Now we’re taking Light into specific industries, with the ambition of becoming the operating layer each one runs on. Energy and defence sit among our priority sectors.

The Role

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to go deep on energy and defence and work out how Light wins there.

Energy developers, operators and service businesses share a lot with defence technology and service suppliers. Both run on project and contract economics, both report across several entities, and both face long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles where auditability and approvals carry real weight. Your job is to understand these buyers better than anyone at Light, turn what you learn into positioning and proof our sales team can use, and build the playbook we follow to scale our go-to-market across both sectors.

You’ll sit in our product marketing team and work side by side with the Sales Managers who cover these sectors, with support from demand generation, field marketing and product.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Interviewing customers, prospects and specialist partners to learn how energy and defence businesses buy, what makes them change and where their finance workflows break.

  • Mapping the market with Sales: which segments we go after first, which we test, and which we leave for later.

  • Turning what you learn into positioning, messaging and competitive arguments that hold up in front of a project director or a CFO.

  • Building the sales kit, from customer stories and demo narratives to objection handling and one-pagers, so our reps speak each sector’s language.

  • Training sales reps and SDRs on the buyers, procurement cycles, contract structures and regulatory context of each segment, and joining customer calls to hear what lands.

  • Bringing the sectors’ requirements back to Product, from project and contract economics to cash visibility, evidence trails and integrations with operational systems, and separating the needs that recur from the one-off requests.

  • Giving demand generation and field marketing the insight, content and angles they need for sector campaigns and events, and tracking what turns into pipeline.

  • Writing down what works, so the next sector we enter starts from a playbook rather than a blank page.

What We Think* You’ll Need

  • Product marketing experience at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of taking a product or segment from insight to launch to sales adoption.

  • A habit of talking to customers, and the judgement to turn interviews into clear positioning.

  • Experience in energy, defence, infrastructure, industrials or another complex B2B sector helps. Curiosity and the speed to earn credibility with technical buyers matter more.

  • Strong writing, from a sharp one-pager to a customer story people want to share.

  • Comfort working with Sales every day, and a feel for what helps a rep win a long, complex deal.

  • An analytical streak. You can read funnel data, spot where deals stall and test why.

  • Daily use of AI for research, writing and analysis, with the discipline to check what it tells you.

  • A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant jerks here, please.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

The Good Stuff

🏢 A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in London.
💸 A competitive salary and potential stock options.
🏝 25 days of annual leave plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🌍 Travel to Copenhagen, Munich, New York, Paris and wherever energy and defence customers, partners and industry events take us.
🚀 The chance to define how Light wins in two sectors from their first deals.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

Energy and defence businesses manage complex projects, contracts and entities on finance tools that weren’t built for them. We want to change that, and we want you to learn both sectors inside out and show us how. When you apply, tell us about a segment you got to know from scratch: how you learned it, what you changed because of it, and how you helped Sales win there.

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Location: London (Next to East Croydon Station)

Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days from home

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will be the product owner for one of our product teams. You own that team’s backlog, the discovery work behind it, the acceptance of what the team builds, and the conversations with the customers it is built for. You report to the CTO, and our product manager, who owns product strategy and the roadmap across the teams, supervises your work day to day.

This is a product role first and a coding role second. You also generate code with AI tools, mostly on the front end, at roughly the level of a junior to mid-level engineer. We expect you to build working prototypes and small features that an engineer then takes over. We do not expect back-end work, architecture or being on call.

Our teams are formed from the people we have at the time, so you are not being hired into a named team. You will work with the engineers in your team, the product manager, the CTO and our customer-facing colleagues.

In your first year, you will get a team running on your backlog without the CTO or the product manager stepping in, and you will have personally shipped front-end changes and prototypes that engineers took forward.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own your team’s backlog: decide what goes in, what stays out and what comes next, and keep it in order.

  • Run discovery with customers, so that what the team builds is something customers need and will use.

  • Turn messy requests, rules and processes into small slices of work with precise acceptance criteria that an engineer can build and a customer can recognise.

  • Accept the team’s work against the acceptance criteria.

  • Say no, or reshape the request, when a customer asks for something that does not fit, and agree a next step with them.

  • Build prototypes and small front-end features with AI tools, check what the tools produce, and hand the work to an engineer to take forward.

  • Work with the product manager so that your backlog fits the roadmap, and tell them early when it does not.

Who we’re looking for

  • You have owned a team’s backlog. You decided what was built next and what was not, you accepted the work, and you can say what you decided and why.

  • You have told a customer no, or changed what they asked for. You can say what they wanted, what you said and what happened next.

  • You find out what customers need before building. You can show us a time you did discovery and what it changed.

  • You turn messy requests, rules and processes into small slices with precise acceptance criteria. You can show us a time you did it, how you knew you had it right, and what you got wrong.

  • You build working front-end prototypes or small features with AI tools, in the last 12 months, and an engineer took them forward. You can say what you built and what the engineer changed.

  • You check what AI tools produce. You can describe a time the output was wrong and how you caught it.

  • You work well with engineers: you hand work over clearly and accept the finished work against what you agreed.

Knowledge of parking or of any one industry is welcome, but none of it is required.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working, 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.

  • Real ownership of a team’s backlog and its customer conversations, with a product manager alongside you.

  • A small team and real influence over what we build.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

title: Program Director (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief 

As Program Director, you are accountable for delivering Isar Aerospace's Spectrum launch vehicle on schedule. You own the integrated program timeline, drive execution across all departments, and ensure alignment of technical, resource, and business priorities to achieve key development and flight milestones. 

As the leader of the Program Management function, you provide functional guidance to Program Managers embedded within the technical departments, establishing common planning, reporting, and execution standards across Spectrum. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission:

  • Drive execution across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, test, and launch operations
  • Provide regular program status, schedule forecasts, and recovery plans to Executive Leadership
  • Enable rapid decision-making by highlighting risks, trade-offs, and opportunities impacting schedule and program objectives
  • Technical Leadership of the Program Management function across Spectrum and provide functional direction to Program Managers through a matrix organization

Qualification Checklist 

  • M.Sc. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Business Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience)
  • 15+ years of experience leading complex technical development programs in aerospace, space, defense, automotive, or similar high-technology industries
  • Proven track record of delivering highly complex products on aggressive schedules
  • Extensive experience in integrated master scheduling, critical path management, risk management, and cross-functional leadership
  • Experience in technical leadership of program management teams and matrix organizations 
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including Executive Leadership engagement
  • Ability and experience in operating effectively in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and demanding timelines

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

ITM Power ist ein führendes Unternehmen in der Branche für grünen Wasserstoff und entwickelt und fertigt hochmoderne PEM-Elektrolyseure, die eine Schlüsselrolle bei der weltweiten Dekarbonisierung spielen. Unsere Standorte in Deutschland dienen als zentrale Drehscheibe innerhalb der EU und beherbergen Teams aus den Bereichen Geschäftsentwicklung, Engineering, Beschaffung und Kundendienst, um unseren Kunden schnelle und effiziente Lösungen zu bieten.

ITM Power befindet sich in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase und konzentriert sich auf die effiziente Umsetzung von Projekten. Wir suchen motivierte Talente, die unsere Leidenschaft für saubere Energie teilen und aktiv zur globalen Energiewende beitragen möchten.

Der Projektcontroller ist für die Verwaltung des Gesamtprojektzeitplans und die Kontrolle der Projektkosten verantwortlich und stellt sicher, dass die Ausgaben im Rahmen des Projektbudgets bleiben. Zu den Aufgaben dieser Position gehören die Erstellung von Kostenberichten, die Analyse der finanziellen Leistung im Zusammenhang mit dem Projektplan sowie die Beratung von Projektmanagern und Stakeholdern hinsichtlich Strategien zum Kostenmanagement. Der Projektcontroller arbeitet eng mit den Finanz- und Projektmanagement-Teams zusammen, um eine genaue Kostenverfolgung und Berichterstattung sicherzustellen.

Sie unterstützen Projekte, indem Sie an internen und externen Kosten- und Terminüberprüfungen teilnehmen sowie die Kostenverfolgung und -abstimmung durchführen. Darüber hinaus führt diese Position regelmäßige Überprüfungen und Aktualisierungen des Projektrisikoregisters durch. Sie koordinieren die gesamten Projektsteuerungsaktivitäten unabhängig von Umfang und Komplexität, einschließlich Turnkey- und Pauschalprojekten, unter vollständiger Einhaltung der vertraglichen Anforderungen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie arbeiten gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam an der Entwicklung von Projektsteuerungsstrategien und -plänen, die mit den Projektzielen und vertraglichen Anforderungen übereinstimmen

  • In dieser Position überwachen, analysieren und berichten Sie über den Projektfortschritt, die Kostenentwicklung und bestehende Projektrisiken, gemeinsam mit dem Projektmanager entwickeln Sie Maßnahmen, um kritische Bereiche anzugehen und die Projektziele zu erreichen

  • Sie stellen die Genauigkeit, Vollständigkeit und Konsistenz der Projektsteuerungsdaten und -informationen sicher und implementieren Qualitätssicherungsprozesse, um zuverlässige und einheitliche Projektergebnisse zu gewährleisten

  • Sie entwickeln und pflegen Projektzeitpläne und arbeiten mit den Projektteammitgliedern zusammen, um wichtige Projektmeilensteine zu identifizieren und kritische Pfade zu analysieren

  • Darüber hinaus überwachen Sie die Projektkosten im Vergleich zum Budget und zur Prognose, erstellen gemeinsam mit den Projektmanagern Kostenschätzungen, identifizieren Kostenabweichungen und entwickeln entsprechende Korrekturmaßnahmen

  • Sie steuern die Prozesse zum Änderungsmanagement (Change Orders), um sicherzustellen, dass Änderungen ordnungsgemäß dokumentiert und in die Projektpläne sowie Kostenschätzungen integriert werden

  • Sie überwachen und überprüfen den Verbrauch von Arbeitsstunden im Verhältnis zu den erbrachten Leistungen und identifizieren Änderungen, die sich auf das erforderliche Budget auswirken

  • Sie identifizieren terminliche Herausforderungen und Probleme, die sich aus Einschränkungen oder Schnittstellen zwischen verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Funktionen ergeben

  • Sie überwachen und berichten über den kritischen Pfad sowie die Terminplanentwicklung des Gesamtprojekts

Das bringen Sie mit

Fachliche Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Kosteningenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Kostencontrolling oder in der Projektsteuerung innerhalb der Engineering- und Bauindustrie

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Projektsteuerung im EPC-Umfeld (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) ist von Vorteil, ebenso wie eine Zertifizierung als PMP (Project Management Professional) und/oder AACE (Certified Cost Engineer)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Softwareanwendungen zur Kostensteuerung, beispielsweise Primavera P6, MSP und SAP

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Budgetplanung, Forecasting und Abweichungsanalysen

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Projektmanagement-Software, beispielsweise Power BI, SAP oder Oracle

  • Vertrautheit mit Methoden der Kostensteuerung, insbesondere Earned Value Management (EVM)

Persönliche Kompetenzen

  • Sie treten als engagierter Repräsentant des Unternehmens auf, überzeugen durch ein professionelles Auftreten und gehen mit gutem Beispiel voran

  • Sie sind teamorientiert und arbeiten effektiv mit anderen zusammen, um gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen

Was wir Ihnen bieten

Als Kunde gehst du die angebotenen Abläufe durch: App öffnen, Konto anlegen, Formular ausfüllen, Bestellung abschließen, in eine Filiale gehen. Du testest den Prozess von Anfang bis Ende, dokumentierst jeden Schritt mit Uhrzeit und Screenshot und markierst die Stellen, an denen etwas hakt oder unklar bleibt.

Vor jedem Auftrag bekommst du eine Anleitung mit Schritten, Zeitrahmen und den Fragen, die am Ende beantwortet sein müssen. Kein Rätselraten, kein Vertrieb, keine Kaltakquise. Getestet wird auf deinem eigenen Gerät, in deiner Nähe.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Digitale Produkte testen: App, Website oder Online-Prozess einmal vollständig durchlaufen – von der Anmeldung bis zum Abschluss.

  • Abläufe vor Ort prüfen: in Filialen, Shops oder Servicestellen, mit Blick auf Wartezeit, Beratung und Abwicklung.

  • Auffälligkeiten festhalten: Screenshot machen, Uhrzeit notieren, in zwei bis fünf Sätzen beschreiben, was passiert ist.

  • Bericht einreichen: die vorgegebenen Fragen beantworten, Dauer je Schritt angeben, Ergebnis knapp zusammenfassen.

  • Nachfragen beantworten: wenn das Team zu einem Befund etwas wissen möchte, kurz und sachlich antworten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist mindestens 18 Jahre alt.

  • Du hast ein Smartphone oder einen Laptop mit Internetzugang – Geräte für App- und Website-Tests stellst du selbst.

  • Du drückst dich in klaren, verständlichen Sätzen aus und arbeitest sorgfältig.

  • Du hältst Termine ein und meldest dich, wenn etwas nicht klappt.

Das brauchst du nicht

  • Kein Studium, keine Ausbildung in einem bestimmten Bereich, kein Führerschein.

  • Keine eigene Firma, keine Anmeldung beim Finanzamt.

  • Keine Kosten – weder für die Bewerbung noch für die Ausrüstung.

Vergütung pro Auftrag

Feste Pauschale je abgeschlossenem Auftrag, gestaffelt nach Umfang. Ausgezahlt wird monatlich, sobald der Bericht abgenommen ist – unabhängig davon, wie lange du gebraucht hast.

  • Kleiner Ablauf (Anmeldung, Formular, eine Seite) – ca. 60 Minuten – 19 €

  • Großer Ablauf (Konto, Antrag, mehrere Schritte) – ca. 90 Minuten – 29 €

  • Filiale vor Ort (inkl. Anfahrt) – ca. 120 Minuten – 39 €

  • Sonderauftrag (mehrere Geräte, mehrere Termine) – ca. 150 Minuten – 49 €

Richtwerte. Das konkrete Honorar steht in jedem Auftrag, bevor du ihn annimmst. Die Pauschale ist so bemessen, dass der gesetzliche Mindestlohn für die aufgewendete Zeit nicht unterschritten wird.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Faire Pauschale – bis zu 49 € pro Auftrag, monatlich ausgezahlt, ohne Provision und ohne Abzug.

  • Anstellung statt anonymer Crowd – Arbeitsvertrag und feste Ansprechperson statt Bewertungsplattform.

  • Minijob oder Teilzeit – Minijob bis zur Geringfügigkeitsgrenze (2026: 603 € monatlich), Teilzeit bis 20 Stunden pro Woche.

  • Flexible Einteilung – du sagst, wann du Zeit hast; keine festen Schichten.

  • Klare Vorgaben – jede Aufgabe mit Anleitung, Zeitrahmen und den Fragen für den Bericht.

  • Persönliche Begleitung – im Panel erreichst du deinen Supervisor direkt, ohne Ticket-System.

  • Kurzer Weg – Bewerbung in etwa zehn Minuten, Rückmeldung meist innerhalb von zwei Werktagen.

So läuft die Bewerbung

  1. Zehn Fragen beantworten (etwa 5 Minuten) – online, ohne Anmeldung, ohne Lebenslauf.

  2. Persönliche Daten eintragen – Name, Anschrift, Geburtsdatum, Kontaktdaten.

  3. Rückmeldung per E-Mail – bei einer Zusage kommen die Zugangsdaten für dein Panel mit.

  4. Arbeitsvertrag digital unterschreiben – Minijob oder Teilzeit.

  5. Onboarding im Panel – kurze Einführung, danach die ersten Aufträge.

Gut zu wissen

  • Keine Provision: bezahlt wird der abgeschlossene Auftrag, nicht die Anzahl gefundener Fehler.

  • Keine Vorkasse, keine Kaution, kein Verkauf an Freunde oder Familie.

  • Du bestimmst, wie viele Aufträge du übernimmst – es gibt keine Mindestanzahl.

title: Customer Success Manager (w/m/d) - Accounting & Taxation
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

Als Stimme unserer Kunden in Deutschland bist du verantwortlich für ihren Erfolg mit der Pennylane-Plattform.

Deine Kernaufgaben:

- Kunden-Onboarding: Du übernimmst die vollständige Einarbeitung (Onboarding) neuer Kunden – sowohl Unternehmen als auch Steuerberaterkanzleien – in die Pennylane-Plattform. Du stellst sicher, dass sie schnell den größtmöglichen Mehrwert aus unserer Lösung ziehen.

- Bestandskundenbetreuung: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für unsere bestehenden Kunden. Du pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und stellst sicher, dass die Kunden Pennylane optimal nutzen, um ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

  

Das bringst du mit

- Erfahrung: 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Account Management oder einer ähnlichen kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Kanzlei-Umfeld oder alternativ im SaaS- oder Fintech-Bereich.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Steuerberater oder Studium im Finance-Bereich

- Branchenwissen: Ein tiefes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen und/oder Steuerberatern in Bezug auf Finanzen, Rechnungsstellung und Buchhaltung ist notwendig.

- Soft Skills: Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Empathie und ein Talent dafür, komplexe Sachverhalte einfach zu erklären.

- Hands-on Mentalität: Als Teil eines Early-Stage-Teams in Deutschland bist du proaktiv, lösungsorientiert und bereit, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

- Reisebereitschaft: Für das Onboarding im Pariser HQ und für regelmäßige Besuche bei unseren Kunden innerhalb von Deutschland (ca. 1mal im Monat

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau oder Muttersprache) und fließende Englischkenntnisse (für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team).

  

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

title: Field Service Engineer – North England/Scotland
descriptionHtml:
Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're scaling rapidly and need a skilled Mobile Site Engineer to look after our growing estate across the North of England and Scotland.

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on and proactive Mobile Site Engineer to manage the maintenance and overall health of our car park infrastructure across the North of England and Scotland, ensuring that downtime on sites due to equipment failure is kept to a minimum. You'll be responsible for the ongoing maintenance of existing sites and the coordination of subcontractors to keep operations running seamlessly. The role calls for a mix of technical expertise, knowledge of CCTV/ANPR cameras and a problem-solving mindset, with regular site visits to either oversee or carry out maintenance work.

Location & Travel

This is a field-based role covering our northern estate, from Leeds up to Scotland. The ideal candidate will be based between Leeds and Dundee, and must be able to travel regularly to sites across all of our northern locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Equipment maintenance: Maintain ANPR cameras, Pay & Display machines, tablets, signage and other related equipment.

  • RAMS: Ensure Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) are prepared and followed when on site.

  • Signage & frontline maintenance: Install and replace signage and kiosk consumables as required, ensuring compliance with safety and operational standards.

  • Issue resolution: Diagnose and resolve technical issues on site, ensuring all equipment functions optimally.

  • Compliance & safety: Adhere to all safe working procedures and compliance guidelines, ensuring a safe and effective work environment.

  • Site visits: Visit sites across the North of England and Scotland on a scheduled basis to carry out general site health checks.

  • Proactive monitoring: Plan and execute regular site visits and maintenance schedules across the northern estate to maintain a high-quality estate.

  • Subcontractor coordination: Coordinate subcontractors on site to ensure maintenance and project work is delivered on time.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Background in hands-on installation, ideally from companies or industries such as Sky, CCTV, BT, Field IT or IoT-related roles. (ANPR experience is beneficial but not required.)

  • Experience working with subcontractors to ensure projects meet deadlines.

  • Ability to work independently, making on-the-spot decisions to meet project objectives.

  • Experience producing site documentation, such as site maps and install plans.

  • Comfortable working alone, following installation plans and survey documents.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to multitask and adapt to dynamic site conditions.

  • Based between Leeds and Dundee, and able to travel regularly across all of our sites in the North of England and Scotland.

  • Full, clean UK driving licence (essential).

  • Basic knowledge of Risk Assessments and RAMS documentation.

Desirable Qualifications / Certificates

  • Asbestos Awareness

  • Abrasive Wheels Certification

  • Working at Height Certification

  • Ladder Safety Training

  • Health & Safety Awareness

  • C&G 2365 (Electrical Installation)

  • CAT & Genny Training

  • IPAF (Powered Access Equipment)

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary & benefits: Reflective of your experience and designed to support your professional growth and well-being.

  • Company van for site travel.

  • Company pension, sick pay and on-site parking.

  • Flexible, home-based working: Split your time between home and our sites across the North of England and Scotland.

Why Hozah?

At Hozah, you'll play a pivotal role in a purpose-driven company at the forefront of urban mobility innovation. We foster a culture of collaboration, creativity and positive impact, where your contributions help shape the future of smarter cities. If you're looking to make a real difference in transforming the future of mobility, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and be part of this exciting journey!

Job Details

  • Job type: Full-time

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday

  • Location: Field-based, North of England and Scotland (ideally based between Leeds and Dundee)

Hozah does not offer visa sponsorship for this role; applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the Role

As a Principal Software Engineer at Radiant, you’ll be a hands-on technical leader, driving the design and development of our most critical systems, including our GPU orchestration layer, inference-serving infrastructure, and core platform APIs.

You’ll set the standard for engineering excellence across the team, working closely with other principal engineers to align on strategy and drive technical leadership. You’ll partner with peers in infrastructure and machine learning to deliver high-performance AI systems, and mentor engineers across multiple squads. While you won’t have direct reports, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping engineering direction, design decisions, and cross-team collaboration.

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for your team's platform, and lead its design and implementation.

  • Translate product and requirements into robust architectures, APIs, and technical designs, working closely with Product.

  • Own the performance, scalability, reliability, and cost of your platform as our infrastructure grows.

  • Lead integration with Kubernetes, networking, storage, and observability across the platform.

  • Partner with SRE, Infra Ops, and datacentre teams on reliability, bring-up, incident response, and the tooling our operators use every day.

  • Raise the engineering bar across the organisation through mentoring, design and code review, and technical standards.

Your Profile

  • A track record of technical leadership at staff or principal level, including setting direction across multiple teams and delivering complex, high-stakes systems.

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in Go, Python, or similar.

  • Deep technical expertise in your team's area, for example:

  • Provisioning: PXE, iPXE, Redfish, IPMI, BMCs, OS imaging, firmware management

  • Cluster management: inventory, scheduling, capacity, lifecycle automation

  • Observability: metrics, logging, tracing, OpenTelemetry, streaming pipelines, time-series storage

  • Infrastructure: Linux internals, Kubernetes, virtualisation, high-performance networking, GPU servers, and reliability at scale

  • Deep experience designing and deploying distributed systems and APIs (gRPC, REST) in production environments

  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes internals, with deep understanding of operators, deployments and reconciliation loops.

  • Experience with GPU clusters or HPC environments, and with technologies such as Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Postgres, Kafka, NVIDIA DCGM, or similar.

  • Able to reason about trade-offs between performance, cost, and operational complexity.

  • Experience with CI/CD workflows, observability, security and automation best practices

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear design documents and explaining complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Sales Lead - Enterprise - Healthcare
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As Enterprise Sales Lead - Healthcare, you’ll own our North America enterprise motion across providers, payers, and life sciences, helping health organizations put agents in front of patients, members, and clinicians that are safe, fast, and fit the systems they already run.

In regulated industries, relationships are the currency, so we’re looking for a leader who already knows the buyers and the rulebook. You’ll have the mandate to win net-new logos, drive agent sales, and build the playbook and the team.

In this role, you will:

  • Win net-new logos and drive adoption of ElevenLabs, including closing deals yourself and also building and scaling the team

  • Own the enterprise healthcare function across health systems, payers, and pharma/medtech: strategy, pipeline, forecast, process, execution

  • Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for each segment

  • Land and expand with large health systems, health plans, and life sciences companies

  • Open doors through your own network of senior buyers, and turn early wins into the references the rest of the vertical will call

  • Work through BAAs, security review, and AI governance boards (and MLR review for pharma), starting compliance conversations in week one

  • Partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers to scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run

  • Help customers pick one high-volume starting point (scheduling, reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, HCP support) and prove it before scaling

  • Build a reference network of healthcare peers that buyers can call

  • Lead executive briefings, events, and high-stakes negotiations

  • Bring a sharp view of the competitive landscape, including build-vs-buy, platform bundlers, and vertical point solutions, to positioning and strategy

  • Set the bar for sales culture, integrity, and customer-first execution

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales experience, including at least 2 years leading a team.

  • Track record selling into health systems, payers, or life sciences, with deep fluency in HIPAA, BAAs, AI governance, and long, multi-stakeholder cycles

  • An established network of senior decision-makers in one or more of health systems, payers, or life sciences, so you can name the buyers you’d call in your first 30 days

  • Experience building a new sales motion or playbook from scratch, whether as a founding leader or inside a larger company

  • Passion for experimenting to find the positioning and messaging that wins in market, and turn what works into the playbook

  • Seven-figure enterprise deals and complex sales cycles

  • Ability to be strategic and hands-on at once

  • Executive presence at C-suite and board levels

  • Low ego and hands-on: equally at home in a C-suite briefing and in the weeds of a prospecting list or Proof of Value. Motivated by impact and growth more than title

  • Passion for the transformative potential of voice and conversational AI

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

To Be Set Up for Success in This Role, You'll Need to Have

In Addition, We're Always Looking for Candidates Who

title: Senior Technical Pre - Sales Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious (Senior) Robotic Sales Engineer (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

Your mission

As a Robotic Sales Engineer (RSE), you are RobCo’s technical face to the customer and the technical lead on every deal you own, from the first customer call to a handover-ready solution. You work as a team with our Account Executives, and every technical question on the deal runs through you. You carry a quota together with your AE, and you win deals as a team.

Your job is to understand the customer’s process better than anyone else in the room, decide early what is feasible and what is not, and turn a real production problem into a clear, qualified automation case. You recommend the right automation approach and hand it over to our Solutions Development team without late surprises.

You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help bring physical AI from the lab into real production. You show customers what robots that perceive, learn and adapt can do in their plant today. You have direct access to the engineers, product managers and data behind our robots, and you help shape what we build next.

What you will do

  • Qualify – Join discovery calls and site visits with your AE. Assess use cases early for technical fit, business value and risk, and say no when a deal does not fit.

  • Run requirement workshops – Lead structured on-site workshops with production, engineering and operations teams. Capture parts, processes, cycle times, layout, interfaces, safety and acceptance criteria.

  • Check feasibility – Make the first technical call on reach, payload, cycle time, gripping and vision. Use quick layouts, simulations and tests to back it up, and pull in Product or Solutions Development where needed.

  • Drive the concept – Turn workshop results into clear requirements and recommend the right automation approach. You own the collaboration with Solutions Development and Product until a complete, buildable concept is in place.

  • Be the technical face to the customer – Explain our robots and solutions to plant managers, engineers and executives in plain language. Run demos and support business cases and RaaS pricing inputs.

  • Close the loop – Feed field insights back to Product, so what customers need shapes what we build.

What you bring

  • 3+ years where automation meets the customer: technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects

  • You want to be measured by results: you share a quota with your AE and push deals over the line

  • You have had your hands on robot cells, from grippers and vision to feeders, conveyors and safety, and you know what makes them run on the shop floor

  • You walk through a plant, watch a process for ten minutes and see where automation pays off

  • You lead conversations with confidence, whether with an operator on the line or the plant manager signing off the investment

  • You think in structure: after your workshop, the team can build on what you captured

  • You can sketch a layout or check reach in CAD or simulation (e.g. Autodesk Fusion, Visual Components)

  • You speak German and English fluently and enjoy being on the road, around 30% of the time

  • Experience in physical AI (AI-based perception, learning-based manipulation, autonomous robots) is a plus

  • Know-how in machine tending, palletizing, assembly or pick-and-place is a plus

  • Robot programming or system integrator experience is a plus

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: Software Engineer (All Levels), United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
We are open to hiring at multiple levels for this role, depending on experience, impact, and demonstrated ownership. While this role is level-agnostic, it is best suited for engineers with experience owning production systems and working in highly ambiguous problem spaces.

Software Engineer

About the company: 

In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow. These minerals are needed to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. However, the mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold was founded to be the first AI native mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects.

Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations.

KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

We are hiring Software Engineers to accelerate our mission.

About The Role:

At KoBold, software engineers have the unique opportunity to embed directly with their users and learn the ins and outs of mineral exploration and geology while developing state of the art technology solutions. Unlike traditional software engineering roles, we don’t simply ship code and passively wait for feedback about its utility: our userbase includes our colleagues… and ourselves! While there are real technical challenges in making mineral exploration data broadly searchable and accessible to both humans and machines, we believe that solving these technical challenges cannot be done without “getting our hands dirty” – sometimes literally! – by embedding directly with the exploration teams and even occasionally (~once a year) joining our colleagues in the field, be it in Zambia, Canada, or Arizona, to experience the impact of our software in real time.

As a Software Engineer on the Data Systems Engineering team at KoBold, your main role will be to enable systematic exploration and materially improve exploration success rates by making mineral exploration data broadly accessible to humans and machines.  Past projects have included SIP (the Structured Ingest Pipeline), DataKit generation (producing curated sets of data on demand), and RAG (Retrieval Augmentation Generation, utilizing natural language processing on unstructured data). Our tech stack is primarily python and includes Django, React, AWS, and additional technologies like Retool and Prefect. 

Your work will empower KoBold to unlock invaluable insights and streamline intricate scientific processes. Collaborating with our exceptional team of data scientists, geologists, and other software engineers, you will have the opportunity to tackle complex problems head-on and collectively pave the way for the discoveries of vital energy transition metals like lithium, copper, nickel, and cobalt. Together we can shape the future of mineral exploration and contribute to building a sustainable world.

This role be responsible for:

  • Deep engagement with exploration geologists and data scientists, continual learning about mineral exploration, and tailoring technology development to the needs of exploration project scientists
  • Building data pipelines and tooling for deriving advanced human and machine insights from exploration data, often leading a small group of software engineers to successful delivery
  • Developing expertise in KoBold’s Data Systems and deeply understanding how they impact exploration
  • End-to-end ownership of projects from design to implementation and testing to continued engagement with colleagues on exploration teams using your solutions
  • Responding well to design and code feedback, also providing feedback to teammates 
  • Operationally managing the team’s services and assisting scientific colleagues with our tooling

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience, ideally building production cloud data systems
  • Proficiency with Python
  • Ability to write production-quality code that is correct, readable, well-tested, scalable and extensible
  • Skilled in large-scale system design
  • A track record of taking ownership from definition of the problem and delivering projects with demonstrated impact in an iterative manner
  • Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain. Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights through using our tools in exploration and willing to work directly with geologists in the field.
  • Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts who are not software developers. A strong communicator who enjoys working with colleagues across the company.
  • Excitement about joining a fast-growing early-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on an evolving range of responsibilities.
  • Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.

Nice to Haves 

  • Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React
  • Experience with geospatial data and building map-based experiences
  • Familiarity with containerization and container orchestration platforms, such as Docker, AWS ECS, Kubernetes, etc.
  • Formal education or job exposure to natural sciences

The UK base salary range for this full-time exempt position is $120,000 - $210,000 USD.

Location: Remote, Candidates can be located anywhere in the United Kingdom. 

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

Compensation ranges are listed in USD. If you are based outside the US, the range may not translate directly: US pay reflects a different market with different competitive dynamics, so we benchmark roles against the local market rather than converting the listed figure.

descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Technical & Solution Architect (Distributed Ledger / Regulated Financial Services)

Location: Hybrid - remote + regular on-site (London)

This is a hands-on technical leadership position in the making.

You will work across product management, engineering, and client-facing discussions to document and evolve the design of a distributed ledger-based post-trade platform operating within regulated financial services. You will initially contribute as our technical documentation lead while progressively taking ownership of system-level architecture, solution design, and technical direction.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to: Move from senior technical writer or senior engineer to architect; Work on real financial market infrastructure problems; Combine deep technical thinking with business context; Shape a product at an early stage.

Why join us? You'll have real ownership and influence in a small, high-calibre team, with direct exposure to cutting-edge financial market infrastructure and a genuine say in product and architectural direction. The role offers a steep learning curve spanning technology, regulation, and market structure, along with a clear path to grow into a formal Technical & Solution Architect position.


Responsibilities:

Technical Documentation:

  • Maintain and improve our existing documentation framework

  • Produce and maintain technical documentation for the core product:

    How its business capabilities have been implemented

    How it can be deployed and operated by our clients

    How it should evolve to meet new business requirements

Architecture & System Design:

  • Design scalable and secure distributed solutions in regulated environments

  • Define and evolve system architecture, APIs, and integration patterns

  • Apply appropriate software design patterns and architectural principles

  • Contribute to product hosting and capacity planning decisions

  • Ensure auditability, resilience, and operational robustness

Distributed Ledger & Digital Assets:

  • Work with distributed ledger technologies and smart contracts. Design models for:

  • Tokenised assets

  • Natively digital assets

  • Atomic settlement

  • DvP and RvP mechanisms

  • Central bank digital currency (CBDC) integration concepts

  • Evaluate trade-offs between on-chain and off-chain components

Financial Services Context:

  • Translate regulatory and market structure requirements into technical documentation and design

  • Understand settlement models and post-trade infrastructure

  • Work within business frameworks such as CSDR and GDPR

Communication & Influence

  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, product management, clients, and regulators (where applicable)

  • Tailor messaging to different audiences.

  • Use structured thinking and persuasive communication to amplify the impact of our technology

  • Contribute to technical documentation and client materials

Requirements:

Technical:

  • Strong experience designing and documenting software products

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems principles

  • Familiarity with tokenisation and digital asset concepts

  • Good understanding of API design (REST, event-driven architectures, etc.)

Financial Services Knowledge (or strong motivation to learn):

  • Understanding of post-trade processes

  • Familiarity with: CSDR; Central securities depositories; DvP and RvP models; Atomic settlement

  • Appreciation of regulatory constraints in financial infrastructure

Communication & Leadership Potential:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Ability to adjust technical depth depending on audience

  • Structured and persuasive thinking

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity

  • Ambition to grow into a Technical & Solution Architect role

  • Ownership mindset and startup resilience

What Success Looks Like:

Within 6–12 months, success in this role means closing technical documentation gaps, owning key architectural decisions, and leading solution design discussions both internally and with partners. You'll be the go-to person for system-level trade-offs, using your technical insight to influence and document product direction, and you'll act as the bridge between business requirements and engineering implementation.
