title: Reward Lead (Part-Time, 2 Days a Week, Permanent)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

This is a permanent, part-time role, working two days a week. Unity is a scaling business with strong reward foundations already in place. We now need a senior reward specialist to strengthen them, fill the gaps and shape them into a framework that grows with the firm. We want reward that reflects how Unity actually works: Partner-led client teams, Functional Leader-led enablement teams, and a culture built on trust, direct feedback and progress over process. We don’t want a generic framework lifted from a larger, more traditional firm.

You’ll take what we have, judge what’s working and what isn’t, and build it out where it needs to go next. You’ll also run it: pay reviews, benefits renewals, and the data and reporting that keep it trusted. You’ll refine it each cycle and make sure the framework is well documented and easy for others to work with.

It suits someone who gets energy from building and improving, and who knows that reward only proves itself once it’s live. You’ll be comfortable with ambiguity and confident making judgement calls. You’ll respect what’s already been done while being willing to challenge it. You’ll also take satisfaction in the steady work of keeping a system accurate, fair and well-run.

This is a role where one expert can own reward end to end, without needing a full-time seat. It will suit an experienced reward specialist who wants a senior, high-impact role with a bounded commitment, including people with a fractional or portfolio background who now want a permanent home.


What you’ll own

  • Reward strategy and philosophy: build on and evolve Unity’s approach to pay. That covers how we position against the market, how pay works across client-facing and enablement tracks, and how reward reinforces Unity’s “progress over process” culture rather than working against it.

  • Pay structure and benchmarking: develop and maintain salary bands and grading across roles and levels, benchmarked against relevant professional services and advisory market data.

  • Pay review cycles: design and run the annual (or biannual) pay and bonus review. That includes timelines, guidance for Partners and Functional Leaders, calibration support, and sign-off with the Management Team / Partners Group.

  • Benefits: own the benefits offering end to end, including provider relationships, renewals, flexible benefits design and clear communication of value to employees.

  • Pay equity and compliance: run regular pay equity analysis (including gender pay gap reporting where applicable), keep Unity compliant with UK reward-related employment law, and flag risk to the CPO early.

  • Reward governance and data: keep reward data accurate and current in our people systems, and produce clear reporting for the Management Team on pay spend, equity and market position.

  • Advisory support: partner directly with Partners and Functional Leaders on individual pay decisions, such as new hire offers, promotions and retention cases. Your recommendations will be clear, defensible and grounded in the framework, not one-off improvisation.

  • The future of reward at Unity: work with the CPO to shape how reward evolves as the firm grows, including the capability, capacity and structure we’ll need over time.


What success looks like in your first 12 months

  • A refined, published pay and grading framework that Partners and Functional Leaders trust and actually use

  • A clean, well-governed annual pay review with no surprises for the Management Team

  • Reward decisions that are consistent, benchmarked and easy to explain, in keeping with Unity’s “trust and accountability” and “no surprises” principles

  • Reward documented and embedded, so that the framework is understood, easy to work with and keeps improving with each cycle


What we’re looking for

  • Senior reward / compensation and benefits experience, ideally including time in professional services, consulting or another partnership-style environment

  • Equally at home developing and extending an existing framework and running it well day to day, from benchmarking data and banding mechanics to benefits contracts and review timelines

  • Someone who sees the operational side of reward as part of the craft. Each pay cycle, renewal and equity report is a chance to test and improve the framework.

  • A pragmatic operator who can deliver across the full scope of reward in two focused days a week, prioritising the highest-leverage work first

  • Confident advising Partners and senior leaders directly, with recommendations grounded in evidence rather than precedent alone

  • Comfortable working with light process and high trust, building just enough structure and no more

  • Experience of part-time, interim or fractional working is welcome, but not required. We value people who can make an impact quickly and build things that last.


How this role fits at Unity

You’ll sit in the People Team, working closely with the Chief People Officer, the Performance Lead (a fellow part-time specialist), People Ops, and Partners and Functional Leaders across the business. Reward decisions at Unity draw on the same “collective insight, direct feedback” approach that runs through how the firm manages performance and probation. They’re calibrated and evidence-based, never made in isolation.


Additional information

We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments or support when applying or arranging your interview.

We do not accept unsolicited CVs from third-party agencies.

Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today’s CFO, with connected solutions across finance, deals and tax. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict.

title: Security Architect
descriptionHtml:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas:

  1. Physical/embedded device security.

  1. OT (operational technology) network security.

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications.

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun.

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact.

What you will be doing

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments.

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors.

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library

  • Security architecture review process

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services.

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies)

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites.

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.

To succeed in this role:

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will".

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security"

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams.

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure.

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run.

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role.

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team.

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security.

In addition, you have the following technical expertise:

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries

  • Zero trust architecture principles

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc)


The following competence is desired:

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP)

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

  • Container and Kubernetes security

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault)

  • Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience)

What we offer you

💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience.

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price.

🏦 Excellent pension contribution.

🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year.

The world's most discerning companies depend on Scality to accelerate high-performance AI initiatives, optimize cloud deployments, and defend their data with confidence. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality software is reliable, secure, and sustainable.


The job context

The team

Our IT & Security team builds, runs and secures Scality's IT infrastructure. It also supports the whole Scality community: employees, contractors, consultants and freelancers. We make sure everyone works in a secure, compliant and up-to-date environment. We also bring security expertise to our products (RING, ARTESCA, ADI) and to our customers.

You will join a team of 4 to 5 people with varied backgrounds (development, security, IT operations, helpdesk) and 2 to 30+ years of experience.

The mission

You will own Scality's information security compliance program and coordinate the team's security operations. You will lead our ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 (AI management system) certifications and manage vulnerability (CVE) follow-up with Engineering.

You will answer customer security requests and audits. You will also help our products meet new regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).

The role is about 70% governance, risk and compliance (GRC) and product security, and 30% hands-on security operations.


The job description

You will own (Responsible)

  • Security operations coordination: be the point of contact for incoming IT & Security requests, prioritize them and dispatch them within the team.
  • Vulnerability management: Assess product exposure to CVEs by leveraging internal tools powered by our Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs).. Handle customer security requests (RD tickets) with Engineering and Support until a fix version or a customer answer is delivered. Track scan and pentest reports through remediation.

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. title: Semiconductor Product / Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

We are seeking an experienced Semiconductor Product / Test Engineer to lead the development and deployment of manufacturing test solutions for next-generation AI accelerator devices. This role spans the full silicon lifecycle from first silicon bring-up through high-volume production, with responsibility for defining test strategy, developing ATE test content, debugging complex silicon issues, and optimising yield, coverage, and test cost. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in DFT methodologies, high-speed interface testing, and advanced CMOS manufacturing, and will work closely with design, DFT, packaging, and manufacturing partners to ensure robust, scalable production of high-performance compute silicon.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, develop and maintain ATE test programs for an AI accelerator chip for high-volume manufacturing.

  • Develop and debug manufacturing test content for advanced CMOS designs including Scan/ATPG of high-speed logic, BIST of SRAM, DRAM, and high speed IO such as PCIe Gen6.

  • Plan and execute the bring-up of first silicon on ATE and lab equipment, including pattern debug, correlation, test characterisation, and corner lot analysis.

  • Execute silicon characterisation and failure analysis to identify yield limiters and defect mechanisms.

  • Optimise test coverage, test time, and cost while maintaining manufacturing robustness.

  • Work with DFT and design teams to generate and simulate test patterns, improve testability and close coverage gaps.

  • Collaborate with OSATs and external partners on test program development, debug and deployment.

  • Support advanced packaging test flows, including die-to-die interconnect testing and package-level thermal considerations.

  • Contribute to documentation of test programs, debug procedures, and manufacturing release materials.

  • Support the development of burn-in, qualification and reliability tests.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on semiconductor test engineering experience.

  • Strong experience developing ATE test programs (Advantest 93K, Teradyne, or equivalent).

  • Solid understanding of DFT methodologies (scan, ATPG, MBIST) and memory test techniques.

  • Experience debugging silicon issues at the tester and correlating failures to design or process causes.

  • Familiarity with advanced CMOS nodes and production test challenges.

  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional engineering environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing AI accelerators, GPUs, networking ASICs, or other high-performance compute ICs.

  • Experience with PCIe Gen5/Gen6 or other high-speed interfaces.

  • Exposure to advanced packaging, chiplets, or multi-die test flows.

  • Experience improving yield, reducing test time, or optimising cost in high-volume manufacturing.

How we work

  • Ownership and execution: you will have full agency to drive your work forward

  • Rapid iteration: we all work directly with top leadership to move from idea to hardware on ambitious timelines

  • Full-stack engagement: hardware, software, silicon, and modelling teams all work closely together to create a product with generational impact

  • Optimistic and pragmatic: we possess the will to win, and to do the hard work to get us there

  • Team player mentality: the mission is bigger than any of us, and we have the curiosity and technical focus to see the best idea shipped, no matter who’s it is

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Senior AI Engineer - Legal AI
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

The Data Science team is growing at 9fin! We are doing world-class work with groundbreaking technologies to build data-driven products using machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, speech and audio, and knowledge/data mining. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to accelerate our application of AI across teams and products. Come and join us, you will get to build large-scale AI powered systems, learn and apply the latest techniques, and work alongside other great researchers and engineers!

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

  • Design and build generative AI applications tailored to complex financial and legal workflows, leveraging state-of-the-art models to deliver innovative, practical solutions that streamline decision-making and unlock new efficiencies.

  • Drive end to end model development lifecycle, leading the team in best practices, ensuring reproducible research and well managed model delivery/deployment.

  • Collaborate cross functionally to share diverse ideas, understand business problems, and elevate/mentor your teammates.

  • Translate complex problems into well-defined scoped bets in an internal startup style environment, dynamic and fast-paced.

  • Learn and apply ground-breaking research and approaches in advanced topics, iterating improvements with a fail fast mentality.

  • Be a proactive sharer of compelling ideas/work to the rest of the team and organisation. We want you to help lead/push the adoption of AI throughout 9fin.

What Makes This Role Different

This role is focused on converting complex financial and legal documents into structured, reliable data. While experience with chatbots, retrieval systems, and general-purpose AI applications is valuable, the core challenge is building systems that can accurately understand legal documentation and extract the information that powers financial analysis and workflow automation.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Legal Document Intelligence: Deep experience working with complex legal and financial documents, including bond offering memoranda, credit agreements, indentures, court filings, and related transaction documentation.

  • Information Extraction: Expertise in extracting structured data from long, complex documents, including financial terms, covenant provisions, definitions, parties, dates, thresholds, baskets, ratios, and transaction mechanics.

  • Document Understanding & NLP: Strong understanding of document structure, section hierarchy, cross-references, defined terms, tables, exhibits, and other patterns common in legal and financial documentation.

  • LLMs for Structured Extraction: Experience applying LLMs to high-precision extraction tasks, including schema-driven extraction, citation grounding, validation, and confidence scoring.

  • Data Quality & Validation Systems: Ability to design review, verification, and reconciliation workflows that ensure extracted data is accurate, consistent, and auditable.

  • Training Data & Annotation: Experience building labelled datasets, annotation frameworks, synthetic data generation, and evaluation sets for document extraction tasks.

  • Retrieval & Context Engineering: Strong understanding of chunking, document segmentation, retrieval, and context construction for long-document reasoning and extraction workflows.

  • Financial & Legal Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with leveraged finance, debt capital markets, credit agreements, covenant packages, bond documentation, restructuring processes, and related legal concepts.

  • Production ML Engineering: Ability to build and operate extraction pipelines, evaluation systems, model-serving infrastructure, and monitoring for production AI workflows.

  • Strong proficiency in Python for production ready delivery.

  • Experience working in the full model lifecycle (including experimentation, training, testing, monitoring, and deployment). We are data centric and love our evals!

  • You have a strong product focus with a desire to understand the end-to-end impact of your solutions for our end users.

  • Good knowledge of AWS’s AI infrastructure.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance 

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • AI experimentation budget of £800 (UK) per employee to trial AI tools

  • Quarterly team socials

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your first year centres on exploratory analysis: helping the client discover what their data reveals about their business, using light-touch modelling where it sharpens the answer. As business needs evolve, there is room to build more advanced models. You work with a cross-functional team to turn findings into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders. 1581 - Associate, Social, UK 

Role Summary and Impact

About WPP 650 

Join an award-winning team at the heart of UK government, where your work will genuinely shape lives. As part of WPP 650 you’ll be part of a supportive, collaborative environment that values curiosity, kindness, and growth. Together, we use behaviour change principles to design smarter services, influence better decisions, and help millions of people across the country.

Named WPP 650, after the 650 UK constituencies, the name is a reminder that our work must reflect the full breadth of the country, every community, every audience. No two days are the same. The challenges are complex, the problems worth solving, and the learning constant. You’ll tackle issues that matter, alongside talented colleagues who care deeply about what they do. It’s demanding – but always rewarding.

WPP 650 is a bespoke agency unit within WPP, dedicated to serving the evolving communications needs of government clients. We bring together the best of WPP's talent, technology, and insights to deliver impactful, modern, and effective public communications. This is meaningful work with real-world impact – the kind you can point to with pride.

As Account Executive the successful candidate will rapidly develop their knowledge of paid advertising across all the key social channels, from activation through to reporting. They will also learn how to work as part of a team that plan & deliver award-winning work in a busy agency environment that has training + development at its core. 

Key Responsibilities: 

As part of a busy Paid Social team the role is varied with several areas of focus. Account Executives will be given all the necessary training to help develop the skills required to fulfil their responsibilities. These include:

  • Working to produce detailed & accurate weekly/monthly campaign performance reports, often in Microsoft Excel. 
  • Writing performance commentary that delivers valuable insight and recommendations to clients. 
  • Assisting with more detailed analysis including end-of-campaign reporting, quarterly/annual reviews, and on standalone projects. 

Client & Partner Management 

  • Working closely with your line-manager & the wider team (including the Global Hub team) to support the delivery of high-quality work for clients.  
  • Working with partners and attending regular platform training sessions to further develop your paid social skillset. 

Operational Excellence 

  • Responsible for managing your workload and for communicating clearly and in a timely manner with internal and external stakeholders as required across email, chat, video and in-person. 
  • Attend regular internal meetings and training sessions in order to actively contribute to a collaborative and friendly paid social community. 
  • Responsible for following the mandatory agency finance processes. Working with line-manager and to ensure processes are followed, allowing for prompt payment/invoicing and to minimise finance queries. 

Skills and Experience

The Account Executive position is aimed at someone passionate about starting a career in digital marketing and paid social. We are looking for a candidate with the following attributes: 

  • Display an eagerness to learn. You should be diligent and attentive to detail, able to listen, learn new skills, and put these into practice quickly.  
  • Able to display in interest in how digital advertising/marketing works (especially on social media channels) and a have desire to further your knowledge in this area.

  • Teamwork is key to this role and we are looking for someone who is collaborative, friendly, and with a can-do attitude.

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. title: Senior AV Technician | Global Fashion Brand ** New Building**
descriptionHtml:
Senior AV Technician | Global Fashion Brand ** New Building**

Location: London, UK
Salary: £47,000 - £50,000 depending on experience + company benefits
Contract: Full-time, Permanent
Hours: 40 hours per week, working a shift pattern between 08:00 and 19:00 to provide coverage throughout the day. Some flexibility may occasionally be required.
Interview Process: Two stages, virtual followed by face-to-face

Work at the heart of one of the world’s leading fashion brands

This is not your typical corporate AV support role.

Kinly has an exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior AV Technician to join the dedicated onsite technology team supporting the prestigious London headquarters of a major global name within the fashion industry.

Our client is an internationally recognised fashion brand with a significant global presence and a reputation built around quality, creativity and exceptional experiences. This is an opportunity to work behind the scenes of a business whose name and products are recognised around the world.

You’ll be based within an impressive, high-profile corporate environment, supporting newly installed AV and video collaboration technology across executive, meeting and event spaces.

The expectations are high. The technology, environment and service delivered to the client need to reflect the quality of the brand.

The opportunity

As Senior AV Technician, you’ll play a leading role within the onsite Kinly team, providing hands-on technical support while acting as a trusted point of contact for the client.

You’ll take ownership of more complex 2nd and 3rd line AV/VC issues, helping ensure that meeting rooms, executive spaces, presentation environments and event facilities perform reliably and deliver an exceptional user experience.

You’ll work closely with the client's existing IT, Facilities and support teams, establishing a joined-up service model that has the potential to become the blueprint for AV support across the client's wider global estate.

This is therefore more than maintaining meeting-room technology. You'll have the opportunity to help shape how AV support is delivered for a major international fashion organisation.

What you'll be doing

  • Act as a primary technical escalation point and trusted point of contact for the client.

  • Lead by example, setting high standards for onsite AV support and customer experience.

  • Take ownership of 2nd and 3rd line AV and VC technical issues, troubleshooting problems and escalating through the appropriate service channels when required.

  • Work collaboratively with IT, Facilities and other established support functions.

  • Ensure meeting rooms, executive spaces and other priority environments are tested regularly and maintained to a consistently high standard.

  • Carry out proactive daily system checks to identify potential issues before they affect meetings or events.

  • Provide professional AV support for important meetings, presentations and events.

  • Liaise with internal teams, client stakeholders, vendors, venue account managers and project managers to support the successful delivery of events.

  • Maintain accurate technical and operational documentation.

  • Produce monthly reporting for the Service Delivery Manager.

  • Work with Kinly's Health & Safety team to ensure relevant RAMS documentation remains current.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the reliability, performance and overall user experience of the AV environment.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who combines strong technical AV expertise with an exceptional approach to client service.

You'll be operating within the headquarters of a prestigious global brand, so how you communicate, present yourself and respond to users is just as important as your technical ability.

Ideally, you'll bring:

  • Strong hands-on experience supporting AV and video collaboration technologies within corporate environments.

  • Previous experience providing AV services within a large multinational or similarly high-profile organisation.

  • Strong working knowledge of technologies from manufacturers such as Cisco, Crestron and Poly, together with broader enterprise AV technologies.

  • The ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex AV/VC faults.

  • Good knowledge of PCs, networking and associated corporate technology.

  • Experience supporting executive-level meetings, presentation spaces and corporate events.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder-management and customer-service skills.

  • A proactive mindset with the ability to identify potential problems before they impact users.

  • Confidence taking ownership of AV systems and maintaining them to a high standard.

  • The ability to remain calm and professional within a fast-moving, high-expectation client environment.

Industry certifications from organisations and manufacturers such as AVIXA, Cisco, Crestron, Extron or Poly would be advantageous, although strong practical experience is equally important.

The person

The right person will take genuine pride in delivering an outstanding service.

You'll be comfortable interacting with everyone from everyday users through to senior executives and VIP stakeholders, adapting your approach while maintaining the same consistently high standard of support.

You'll also need to be comfortable joining a brand-new client environment. We need someone who enjoys taking ownership, spotting opportunities for improvement and helping establish excellent working practices rather than simply inheriting an established service.

Our expectation is that you'll quickly develop a detailed understanding of the client's environment and be making a significant contribution within your first 3 to 6 months.

Why join Kinly?

Kinly is one of Europe's leading audiovisual and unified communications integrators and a globally trusted technology partner.

For more than 25 years, we have designed, integrated and supported sophisticated workplace technology environments for leading organisations around the world.

For this particular role, however, there is an extra attraction: the client.

You'll have the opportunity to represent Kinly inside the London headquarters of a globally recognised fashion brand, working with high-quality technology in a prestigious corporate setting and helping deliver the standard of AV experience you would expect from an organisation of this calibre.

If you're an experienced AV professional looking for a role that combines technical challenge, client visibility, responsibility and the opportunity to work inside the world of global fashion, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) – HGB / SAP S/4HANA
descriptionHtml:
Your Role

Du gestaltest die Hauptbuchhaltung bei FINN mit, von der laufenden Buchhaltung bis zum Jahresabschluss nach HGB. Wir arbeiten mit SAP S/4HANA und mehreren operativen Subsystemen, deren Daten ins Hauptbuch fließen.

FINN bereitet sich auf die Kapitalmarktfähigkeit vor. Dafür brauchen wir Abschlüsse, die prüfungssicher und gut dokumentiert sind. Du bist Teil unseres Accounting-Teams und gestaltest diesen Weg aktiv mit, vor allem durch saubere Prozesse und Kontrollen.


Your Mission

  • Abschlüsse vorantreiben: Du treibst die Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse proaktiv voran und unterstützt bei Jahresabschlussprüfungen und steuerlichen Prüfungen.

    • Your Profile
    Must have:

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Hauptbuchhaltung, inklusive Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB, egal ob in Unternehmen, Konzern, Kanzlei oder Wirtschaftsprüfung.

  • Eine Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK), einen Abschluss als Steuerfachwirt oder ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen.

    • Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung mit Forderungsverkäufen bzw. ABS-Strukturen, z. B. aus einer Autobank, Leasinggesellschaft oder aus der Prüfung solcher Mandate.

  • Erste Kenntnisse in IFRS.

  • Erfahrung mit SAP, idealerweise S/4HANA.


    • WHY FINN

  • Shared Success (VSOP Finanzbeteiligung): Wir gewinnen gemeinsam. Über unser Virtual Stock Option Program profitierst du direkt vom langfristigen Wertwachstum und dem Erfolg von FINN.

  • Fuel your Growth (1.500€ Weiterbildungsbudget): Stillstand ist keine Option. Mit deinem jährlichen Development-Budget in Höhe von 1.500€ für Fortbildungen und Seminare entscheidest du selbst, wie du dich persönlich und professionell weiterentwickelst.

  • Family First (Kita-Zuschuss & Flexibilität): Wir unterstützen dich und deine Familie. Profitiere von einem monatlichen Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung, exklusiven Zugängen zu Kita-Plätzen in München sowie maximaler Flexibilität, um Berufs- und Familienleben stressfrei zu vereinbaren.

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV): Wir denken an deine Zukunft. FINN bezuschusst deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit einem starken Arbeitgeberanteil von 66 %.

  • Experience our Product (25% Auto-Abo Rabatt): Werde selbst zum FINN-Driver! Du erhältst einen satten Mitarbeiterrabatt von 25% auf dein Auto-Abo oder nutzt alternativ unser attraktives Fahrrad-Leasing (Bike-Leasing).

  • Munich Office Life: Barista-Kaffee auf Knopfdruck, Matcha und der legendäre Obstkorb erwarten dich in unserem modernen Headquarter in München. On top gibt es einen täglichen Lunch-Zuschuss für dein Mittagessen.

  • Team Spirit & Corporate Events: Wir sind mehr als nur Kolleg:innen. Ob Sommer-Events am See oder einfach ein entspannter After-Work-Drink. Wir feiern unsere Meilensteine bei regelmäßigen Teamevents gemeinsam.


    • About Us
    FINN ist Deutschlands führende Auto-Abo-Plattform und eines der wenigen deutschen Unicorns im Mobility-Sektor. Mit über 400 Kolleg:innen aus mehr als 40 Nationen bauen wir an der Zukunft der Mobilität und machen den Zugang zum eigenen Auto so unkompliziert wie nie zuvor. Was uns dabei wirklich stolz macht, sind aber nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern das, was dahintersteckt: unser starker Team-Drive, der Wille, den Status quo zu challengen, und die Ambition, wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Wir stehen allen Personengruppen offen, unabhängig von Alter, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, Ethnizität, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität und/oder -ausdruck, Familienstand oder anderen gesetzlich geschützten Merkmalen.

title: Senior Business Transformation Consultant - Automotive & Manufacturing
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

(Internal Job Title: Senior Value Engineer)

The Team: Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.

The Role: As a Senior Value Engineer, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation within the Automotive & Manufacturing sector by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their ecosystems.

The work you’ll do:

  • Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first discovery through realized ROI for your process areas. Tell the Value Story by crafting powerful executive narratives and leading business value workshops.
  • Stakeholder Management: Cultivate powerful executive sponsorship across core business units to champion transformation programs. Co-own change management with customer leaders and design CoE roadmaps that build self-sufficiency.
  • Program Management: Steer Global Transformations across complex workstreams. Own and implement AI-driven account planning and AI-assisted project management. Automate executive governance (QBRs, SteerCos) with minimal manual friction.
  • Platform & AI Fluency: Act as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI tools for rapid technical outputs while partnering with Applied Value Engineers for deep-dive solution builds. Champion platform adoption.
  • Scale Value & Innovation: Build a strategic expansion roadmap embedding Celonis as a strategic platform to drive adoption. Provide feedback to R&D based on evolving customer use cases.

The qualifications you need:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience taking ownership of complex workstreams, process areas, and customer relationships in Value Engineering, Consulting, or Pre-Sales.
  • AI & Technical & Fluency: Solid background in enterprise IT and business software (e.g., SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle). You operate primarily as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI copilots to generate outputs and automations, avoiding heavy manual coding.
  • Builder Mentality: Comfortable setting your own direction within an account team. Driven to live for customer value, proactively hunting and ideating for highest-impact solutions.
  • Process Improvement & Value Realization: Proven expertise in executing process improvements. 
  • Strategic Program & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated expertise orchestrating multi-region or business unit transformation programs. Expert at mobilizing VP/Director-level sponsorship. Flawless English and French communication with commanding executive presence.
  • Domain & Industry: Deep understanding of the Finance/Supply Chain domains and Automotive/Manufacturing trends. You stay continuously updated on business-critical use cases.
  • Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics,  comparable technical degree or a Business/Economics degree paired with a technical minor

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

title: Senior Collections Advisor
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

We're looking for an experienced individual to fill the role of Senior Collections Advisor. This position requires an important balance of both credit and conduct risk as we focus on delivering the right outcomes for our customers based on their individual circumstances, always.

You will be working alongside as part of small but rapidly expanding team in our Milton Keynes office, this is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in our Milton Keynes office with flexibility on the other 2. There will also be a requirement to attend our central London office once a month (fully expensed).

The ideal candidate will have excellent attention to detail and be comfortable following documented procedures consistently ensuring that all customers are treated fairly and receive the appropriate outcomes. Tasks also include updating account details, maintaining accurate records, and escalating cases to senior staff if necessary. There will also be a requirement to identify and support customers who may shows signs of vulnerability.

Who you are

  • An experienced Customer facing advisor confident at dealing with customers in arrears with credit products

  • Have a good understanding of FCA regulation including CONC7 and DPA requirements

  • Have an awareness of the broad range of debt solutions i.e. Payment Arrangements, DMPs, IVAs, Trust Deeds, DROs, Breathing Space etc.

  • Understands Customer Vulnerability and how to identity and manage

  • Comfortable working with statements and ledgers to interpret transactions to help resolve customer queries

  • Familiar with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Teams)

  • A strong team player who will help as required to deliver tasks within the team SLAs

What you'll be doing

  • Handling multiple live customer chats

title: Senior Computational Biologist
descriptionHtml:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platform with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by tier one investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

Our internal R&D programs generate a steady stream of open questions, about tumor biology, about the patient-derived models we generate across indications, and about how those models behave under drug exposure. Answering these questions takes real analytical firepower. These questions sit in different programmes across the company and run on different timelines.

What you'll do

  • You'll work alongside domain experts in cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening, and data engineering. You will be part of the team that decides how the question gets tackled, from experimental design through interpretation.

  • Turn analyses into actionable answers that keep programme and product decisions moving, with reasoning solid enough to hold up to scrutiny.

  • Inform key programs (e.g. protocol design, commercial readiness) through deep cross analysis of molecular, functional and clinical data

  • You will communicate your results to internal and external stakeholders: publication-quality figures, panels and supporting narrative, extending to posters, presentations or manuscripts where relevant.

What we're looking for

We are looking for someone who's comfortable working on complex biological questions across different therapeutic areas and drug development programs. You will own analysis and interpretation. The ideal candidate is creative, driven, fast, rigorous and autonomous.

You will be tackling complex internal R&D subjects that are actively slowing down cancer research. Your findings will impact the field and your work is expected to reach leading scientists via international conferences and peer-reviewed papers.

Must have

  • PhD in Computational Biology, bioengineering or any related field, 2 to 3 years analyzing complex biological data in a research or biotech setting is a plus.

  • Strong experience with molecular data: You analyse omics data (transcriptomics, genomics) within the context of cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening…

  • Interdisciplinary mindset: You quickly understand the context and framework within teams outside of your area of expertise. You are comfortable working in an interdisciplinary setting with biologists, lab-based scientists and engineers.

  • Structured communication: You communicate research findings clearly through well-documented code, notebooks, written summaries, and presentations. For example, you can highlight key figures or publications where you drove the computational biology.

  • Real interest in cancer biology: You don't need to arrive as an expert: there's considerable depth around you and you'll absorb a great deal of it. But you should find the cancer biology genuinely interesting, and be the sort of person who goes the extra mile to understand what happens behind the result.

  • Strong programming skills: Python and fluency in the scientific coding stack.

  • Fluent in English: We are an interdisciplinary and multicultural team working in English.

Nice to have

  • Strong experience working with experimentalists.

  • Comfortable holding two or three analyses in parallel without losing track of either.

  • Experience in working with or analyzing data generated from sophisticated patient-derived cellular models (e.g. PDOs, PDXOs).

  • Industry experience where your analyses fed real go/no-go decisions.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Role: be in a high-impact research role at the core of a distinctive oncology discovery platform, where you will have access to rare PDO multi-omics and functional datasets, and a dedicated engineering counterpart to turn your methods into durable building blocks.

  • Impact: participate and have ownership in a fast-growing, multi-faceted project at the early stage of a growing start-up, with the opportunity to shape it; a role where your technical expertise will have a tangible impact on patient outcomes.

  • Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process

  1. HR Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

  3. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

Orakl Oncology is committed to diversity and equal opportunity. All qualified applications will be considered.

Das Controlling bei momox ist ein Team von vier Personen für ein Unternehmen mit 400 Mio. € Umsatz. Das funktioniert nur, weil bei uns niemand Zahlen verwaltet, sondern jeder sein Thema von der Query bis zur Empfehlung ans Senior Management verantwortet und weil wir konsequent automatisieren, was sich automatisieren lässt. KI ist dabei kein Pilotprojekt, sondern täglicher Bestandteil der Arbeit. Wir suchen jemanden mit dem fachlichen Standing, eigene Themen gegenüber Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen zu vertreten und mit dem Anspruch, Controlling technisch weiterzudenken.

Das wirst du meistern

  • Management Reporting & Steuerung: Du verantwortest das monatliche Reporting fürs Senior Management inkl. Abweichungsanalysen über Geschäftsbereiche, Vertriebskanäle und Ankaufsländer, und du kommentierst so, dass eine Entscheidung daraus folgt
  • Planung & Forecasting: Du treibst Budget und Quartals-Forecasts, moderierst die Planungsrunden mit Geschäftsführung und Bereichsleitungen und verantwortest das Planungsmodell
  • Deckungsbeitragssteuerung: Du entwickelst unsere Deckungsbeitragsrechnung fachlich weiter und stellst den relevanten Fachbereichen die Kostenbasis für kostendeckende Entscheidungen im An- und Verkauf bereit
  • Business Partnering: Ad-hoc-Analysen, Sonderauswertungen, Profitabilitätshebel - du findest sie selbst, bewertest sie und bringst sie in den Fachbereichen zum Fliegen
  • Daten, Automatisierung & KI: Du ziehst dir deine Daten selbst per SQL aus BigQuery, baust Reports in Looker und automatisierst wiederkehrende Auswertungen, statt sie jeden Monat neu zu klicken. KI-Tools nutzt du dabei für echte Controlling-Arbeit: Datenaufbereitung, Analyse, Code, Prüfroutinen, und entwickelst unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mit weiter

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Controlling eines datengetriebenen Unternehmens (E-Commerce, Handel, Logistik o. ä.)
  • SQL auf Analystenniveau - du wartest nicht auf BI, du schreibst die Query
  • Souverän in Excel/Power Query und in der Modellierung komplexer Planungsrechnungen
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von GuV, Deckungsbeitragsrechnung und Monatsabschluss
  • Praxis im Einsatz von KI-Tools in der eigenen Arbeit - du kannst konkret beschreiben, welchen Prozess du damit verkürzt oder abgeschafft hast
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Zahlen verständlich und auf den Punkt zu vermitteln
  • Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir arbeiten nach einem hybriden Modell mit 20 Office-Tagen pro Quartal, die den persönlichen Austausch im Team fördern und gleichzeitig eine moderne, flexible Arbeitsweise ermöglichen. An den übrigen Tagen kannst du von zuhause aus arbeiten - zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr aus Ländern innerhalb der EU zu arbeiten. Außerdem profitierst du von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die sich an deine individuellen Bedürfnisse anpassen.
  • Individuelle Arbeitsumgebung: Gestalte deinen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz ganz nach deinen Wünschen – mit höhenverstellbaren Tischen und dem Laptop deiner Wahl (MacBook oder ThinkPad). Wenn es im Büro mal etwas lauter wird, sorgen deine Bose Noise-Cancelling-Kopfhörer für ungestörtes Arbeiten. Bei Bedarf stellen wir dir auch einen ergonomischen Stuhl oder zusätzliche Monitore für dein Homeoffice zur Verfügung.
  • Offenes Arbeitsumfeld: Wir arbeiten gemeinsam in einem hellen, offenen Großraumbüro, in dem die wenigen vorhandenen Türen immer offen stehen. Unsere Teams sind motiviert und aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen. Bringe deine Kreativität ein und setze sie um! Wenn du einen Moment der Ruhe brauchst, kannst du dich in eine gemütliche Ecke der medimops-Bibliothek im Pausenraum zurückziehen oder dich bei einer Runde Kicker, Tischtennis oder an der PlayStation austoben.
  • Sport- und Fitnessangebote: Unter der Woche hast du die Möglichkeit, an verschiedenen Sportangeboten teilzunehmen. Ob Online-Training, Massagen oder Stretching am Arbeitsplatz – es ist für jeden etwas dabei. Außerdem kannst du zu einem vergünstigten Mitgliedspreis ein Abo bei Urban Sports Club oder Wellhub abschließen.
  • Reduziertes Ticket für den Nahverkehr: Spare bares Geld mit dem Deutschland- oder Jobticket der Berliner S-Bahn.
  • Firmenfeiern: Der Spaß an unserer Arbeit und das gemeinsame Feiern unserer Erfolge sind fest in unseren Werten verankert. Deshalb treffen wir uns regelmäßig zu verschiedenen Events, um uns auszutauschen, besser kennenzulernen und unseren Teamgeist weiter zu stärken.
  • 1/2 Tag Urlaub am Geburtstag: An deinem Geburtstag bekommst du einen halben Tag Urlaub. Komm später, geh früher oder nimm einfach noch einen halben Tag Urlaub dazu, um deinen ganzen Geburtstag frei zu haben – vorausgesetzt, dein Geburtstag fällt auf einen regulären Arbeitstag. Außerdem bekommst du am 24.12. und 31.12. je einen halben Tag frei.
  • Unternehmensrabatte: Als momoxian kannst du dich jeden Monat auf einen Gutschein für unseren momox fashion Onlineshop, sowie medimops freuen. Darüber hinaus profitierst du natürlich von zahlreichen Unternehmensrabatten unserer Partner.
  • Weiterbildung: momox ist nur so gut wie du. Deshalb findest du bei uns Raum und Budget für deine individuelle professionelle Entwicklung mit Sprachkursen, internen Schulungen, Konferenzen, (Online-) Kursen und mehr.
  • Bürohunde: Unsere Bürohunde tragen zu einer entspannten Arbeitsatmosphäre bei und freuen sich immer über eine extra Portion Streicheleinheiten.

title: Senior Counsel, DACH Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

The Celonis Legal team is an energetic and proactive global group of experts in their field, focused on identifying, avoiding, mitigating and solving challenges within the Celonis business. We sit at the heart of the Celonis organization and are proud to be seen as valued business partners across all aspects of the business. The Celonis Legal team is led by the Chief Legal & Trust Officer, with deputy and assistant GCs leading our global GTM & Product, Corporate, Employment and Ethics & Compliance practices. The Senior Counsel, DACH Public Sector will sit within the GTM practice, reporting to our Legal Director, EMEA Commercial.

The Role:

The Senior Counsel, DACH Public Sector position will be a new and important role in the company’s Legal group, responsible for supporting Celonis’ fast-growing Public Sector Go-to-Market (GTM) efforts in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, as well as providing additional legal support as requested. As Celonis’ home market, DACH is a critically important region and Celonis is committed to working with and supporting many of the region’s largest public sector organisations. The primary focus of the role is negotiating key commercial customer transactions in DACH with both state and federal organisations, working alongside senior Celonis stakeholders. A successful candidate will be expected to provide pragmatic, creative, collaborative and solution-oriented legal support. As a self-starting, experienced communicator and problem-solver, the Senior Counsel, DACH Public Sector must be able to prioritize effectively and drive issues to resolution within a team environment focused on growth, execution and process improvement. 

The work you’ll do:

  • Serve as the principal Legal business partner to GTM, Information Security, Engineering, Product and Compliance teams to drive the expansion of Celonis’ DACH Public Sector business.
  • Draft, review, analyze and negotiate a wide variety of commercial contracts, including cloud and on-premise subscriptions, professional services agreements, GenAI terms and data processing agreements. A significant portion of this may include working on framework contracts accepted by the relevant public sector organisations, such as EVB-IT terms
  • Draft and negotiate partnership contracts, including with public sector resellers and tech provider collaborations   
  • Collaborate closely with internal and external information security experts to address state and federal government cybersecurity requirements applicable to public procurement processes and the provision of cloud or on-prem services
  • Coordinate with and manage external counsel, as required
  • Develop and maintain commercial contract templates
  • Consistently anticipate, analyze, communicate, and propose mitigation strategies for potential risks in contractual, regulatory, compliance, financial and legal areas
  • Provide training on a variety of topics to sales and other cross-functional teams
  • Contribute to ongoing process improvement, reduction of friction and problem solving within areas of Legal and Compliance
  • Seamlessly partner with senior stakeholders (including C-Suite and Executive Management) within the Celonis organization, including but not limited to Sales, Deal Desk, Finance and Compliance
  • Further Celonis’ business, financial and risk management objectives through diligent, proactive and creative lawyering 

The qualifications you need:

  • Law degree from a highly-regarded university
  • Qualified lawyer in Germany (2nd state exams and eligible for bar registration)
  • Native-level German language. Business fluency in English and German
  • 7+ years post-qualification experience in law firm and/or in-house legal department including significant drafting and negotiation experience in relation to SaaS, on-premise and professional services agreements with DACH public sector organisations
  • Experience in supporting quota-carrying, enterprise-level sales personnel 
  • Working knowledge of regulatory matters, including international DACH public procurement rules, data protection, corporate compliance and applicable EU regulations
  • Ability to think “outside the box” and address complex matters with creative solutions 
  • Excellent interpersonal, written/verbal communication and negotiation skills
  • Highly responsive and service-oriented attitude
  • Ability to independently organize, prioritize and manage deadlines in a fast-paced and demanding work environment
  • Ability to maintain strong working relationships with high-performing internal clients and work effectively with remote team and management members

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.
