title: Senior CRM Executive - Lifecycle
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

This position will be part of the central CRM & Ops team, composed of 18+ specialists, dedicated to driving and executing global strategic initiatives to grow and retain our New Customer base. Collectively, the team is targeted on growing orders, expanding our subscriber base, improving engagement metrics to retain Deliveroo customers. Serving as the voice of the customer, the CRM & Ops team does this by enhancing personalised user experiences, activating best-in-class campaigns, and putting relevancy at the heart of everything.

The Role

As a Marketing Manager within the Lifecycle CRM & Ops team you are the voice of Deliveroo when speaking with our customers across the globe. You'll operate under a hybrid work model, spending a minimum of three days a week at our London HQ.

Reporting into the Senior Marketing Manager on the New Customer squad, and working closely with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Global CRM, Marketing Promotions, and Data Science, You'll be a technical, commercially minded CRM marketer who is hands-on in the tooling: building Lifecycle journeys, setting up experiments and audiences, and configuring promotions and in-app merchandising. You'll have end-to-end ownership of the New Customer Lifecycle, from journey design and build through to measurement and ROI. You'll also use personalisation and AI to make journeys more relevant. Your primary focus will be on creating customer-centric journeys that are highly relevant, using the right channels at the right time to deliver meaningful business impact, while working with local markets as you scale your initiatives internationally.

What you'll be doing

  • Collaborate with multiple stakeholders to support growing the new customer base by combining data-driven insights with CRM best practice to initiate and deliver programs internationally
  • Build and configure multi-channel journeys (email, push, in-app), including audience logic, triggers, testing and QA
  • Design and build multi-variant Lifecycle experiments
  • Create promotions for new customer acquisition and retention, ensuring accurate setup, targeting and tracking
  • Manage in-app merchandising placements, working with Product and Marketing Promotions
  • Deliver personalisation at scale, and test where AI can improve content and efficiency
  • Own operational delivery, optimisation, reporting of campaigns and weekly trading
  • Proactively monitor and report on campaigns to stakeholders & propose/manage changes and optimisations where necessary
  • Collaborate with the New Customer Lifecycle Manager and Marketing Promotions teams to develop the global CRM new customers lifecycle strategy
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on key projects to create and implement test strategies that optimises performance of new & existing campaigns
  • Be comfortable with data targeting, segmentation & analysis - pulling it, manipulating it and interpreting it, whilst using marketing technology to help achieve customer touchpoints faster and more efficiently than ever before
  • Drive innovative ideas and solutions in response to business and customer needs
  • Provide regular communication with stakeholders, such as the central marketing team, product and engineering teams and local markets, to ensure workloads & deadlines are managed efficiently (we love Slack channels for everything)
  • Conduct post campaign reporting, pulling out the most interesting lessons and using these to guide your future ideas

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree (Marketing or Business preferred) or strong relevant experience
  • A minimum of 3+ years CRM experience
  • Can work in a fast-paced environment and prioritise workload
  • Attention to detail and campaign deadlines are adhered to, maintaining high standards of accuracy
  • Highly computer literate with:
    • HTML familiarity (ability to understand where changes need to be made)
    • Liquid logic
  • Technical knowledge in CRM automation development
  • Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders groups
  • Data visualisation tools & reporting experience (Looker preferred)
  • CRM deployment experience (Braze or similar is a plus!)

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information..

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Senior Data & Insights Executive
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact

This role is within The Goat Agency, a leading brand within WPP Media, where you will help global brands harness the power of social and creator-led content to deliver measurable impact. Recognised as a global leader in the space, we deliver award-winning campaigns in more than 70 countries. With over 650 social natives worldwide, we create ambitious influencer programmes—from tactical activations to long-term partnerships—designed to drive awareness, engagement and conversions across the full marketing funnel.

Working within the Intelligence and Insights team, you will support the development of clear, relevant and actionable insights that inform campaign planning and strategy. You will explore consumer behaviour, social conversations, creator activity, competitor performance and cultural trends, turning your findings into compelling stories and practical recommendations. This is an early-career opportunity suited to someone with one to two years of marketing, research, social media or insights experience who is curious about audiences, brands and culture.

Skills and Experience

  • Insight Generation & Analysis:
  • Conduct research into consumer behaviour, social media conversations, creator activity, competitor campaigns and emerging cultural trends.
  • Review campaign results and relevant performance indicators to identify key themes, patterns and opportunities.
  • Bring together information from multiple sources and translate findings into clear, engaging insight stories.
  • Support the development of practical recommendations for campaign planning, creator strategy and content development.
  • Use social listening, audience intelligence and research platforms to gather relevant information, with guidance from senior team members.
  • Maintain a high standard of accuracy and attention to detail across all research and reporting.

Project & Stakeholder Management:

  • Support defined intelligence and insights projects, from initial research and information gathering through to final delivery.
  • Manage assigned tasks and deadlines, raising questions or potential issues with senior team members when required.
  • Collaborate effectively with strategy, planning, campaign and client teams to understand their intelligence needs.
  • Communicate findings clearly and confidently to internal stakeholders, with support where appropriate.
  • Respond positively to feedback and use it to strengthen future research and insight development.

Learning & Best Practice:

  • Build knowledge of influencer marketing, social platforms, creator culture and the wider media landscape.
  • Develop confidence in research, insight generation and storytelling techniques through hands-on experience and team support.
  • Stay informed about emerging platforms, consumer behaviours, cultural shifts and industry developments.
  • Contribute ideas, examples and useful resources that support the team’s shared knowledge.
  • Follow established research standards and best practices, including accurate sourcing and clear documentation.

Key Responsibilities:

Intelligence & Research Operations:

  • Conduct desk research using reliable sources to support campaign briefs, pitches, reports and strategic projects.
  • Monitor social conversations, creator activity, competitor behaviour and category developments to identify relevant insights.
  • Help produce regular intelligence outputs, including trend reports, competitor reviews, audience summaries and campaign learnings.
  • Gather and organise information from internal and external sources, ensuring findings are clearly documented and easy to understand.
  • Support the maintenance of campaign tracking documents, research libraries and shared intelligence resources.
  • Ensure campaigns and relevant information are added promptly to internal platforms, following up with stakeholders when details are missing.

Insight Development & Quality:

  • Identify meaningful themes and patterns within research, social conversations and campaign information.
  • Help turn observations into insights by explaining what is happening, why it matters and how brands could respond.
  • Sense-check findings to ensure conclusions are supported by appropriate evidence.
  • Check sources, calculations, formatting and written outputs carefully before sharing work.
  • Ask thoughtful questions and seek guidance when information is incomplete, unclear or inconsistent.

Platform & Application Knowledge:

  • Develop working knowledge of our core intelligence, campaign and reporting applications, including Benchmark Index, Performance Analyser and Deliverables Calculator.
  • Use social listening, audience intelligence and research tools to gather information and identify relevant trends.
  • Confidently use Excel or Google Sheets for organising information, completing basic analysis and producing clear summaries.
  • Navigate our BI and internal reporting tools to access existing information and dashboards, with training and support provided.
  • Share feedback on internal tools and processes to help improve usability and team efficiency.

Collaboration & Development:

  • Work closely with colleagues across Intelligence and Insights, Strategy, Campaigns and other relevant teams.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively to help ensure actions are completed and projects remain on track.
  • Participate in team discussions and contribute a curious, audience-focused perspective.
  • Build effective working relationships by being dependable, collaborative and open to feedback.
  • Take ownership of personal development and actively build knowledge of the influencer marketing and social media landscape.

The Ideal Candidate:

  • One to two years of experience in marketing, consumer research, social media, influencer marketing, media, strategy or insights, preferably within an agency or brand environment.
  • A strong interest in consumer behaviour, social media, creators, culture and emerging trends.
  • Curiosity and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to look beyond surface-level observations and consider why something matters.
  • Some experience conducting desk research, competitor analysis, social listening or campaign reporting.
  • An ability to turn research and information into clear, concise and engaging stories.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with a willingness to build confidence in presenting findings.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets; experience with social listening, research or audience intelligence tools would be beneficial but is not essential.
  • A proactive, collaborative and solution-focused approach, with a willingness to ask questions and learn.
  • No advanced coding, scripting or complex data-modelling experience is required.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country. 

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location 

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide. 

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Senior Data Ops engineer (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior DataOps Engineer to join the Data and AI Platform team.

Your mission will be to improve and maintain an efficient, reliable and scalable platform that enables Data Product developers and owners to develop, deploy and maintain their data products autonomously, at scale, with clear and maintained interfaces and full observability — ensuring seamless data flow across the organisation and enabling data-driven decision-making.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Maintain the Data Product Controller to give stakeholders full responsibility for managing their data products in an automated way (via CI/CD and infrastructure as code) — securely, reliably, and with full ownership

  • Maintain the Data and AI Platform orchestrator (Dagster) to enable Data Product developers to orchestrate their data products in a decentralised way (Data Mesh), with ownership over their release process and job pipelines

  • Monitor the data platform for performance and reliability, identify and troubleshoot issues, and implement proactive solutions to ensure availability

  • Offer observability components to empower developer teams and data product consumers with the right level of insight into costs, data quality, and data lineage

  • Monitor platform costs, identify optimisation and saving opportunities, and collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and other stakeholders

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of platform architecture, scalability, and developer experience across teams

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have more than 5 years of experience as a DataOps Engineer or in a similar role, with a proven track record of building and maintaining complex data infrastructures

  • Have strong proficiency in data engineering and infrastructure tools and technologies (Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Crossplane)

  • Have expertise in programming languages like Python

  • Are familiar with cloud infrastructure and services, preferably GCP, and have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform

  • Have excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on identifying and resolving data infrastructure bottlenecks and performance issues

  • Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have knowledge of data governance principles and best practices for data security

  • Have experience with CI/CD pipelines for data workflows

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

title: Senior E-Commerce / D2C Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Patronus

Patronus hilft Menschen, Schädlinge im eigenen Zuhause selbst loszuwerden: von Silberfischen über Lebensmittelmotten bis zu Ameisen und Mardern. Mit wirksamen Produkten, klaren Anleitungen und Beratung, die ernst nimmt, wie unangenehm so ein Befall ist.

Seit 2020 verkaufen wir direkt an unsere Kundinnen und Kunden: über unseren eigenen Online-Shop patronus-shop.de, über den TikTok Shop und über Amazon. Unser Team arbeitet remote aus Deutschland, Georgien, Indonesien und Pakistan. KI ist bei uns kein Zukunftsthema, sondern Alltag: Wir bauen unsere Auswertungen, Automatisierungen und viele interne Werkzeuge selbst mit KI.

Die Rolle

Bisher hat einer unserer Gründer den Online-Shop selbst gesteuert. Diese Verantwortung übergeben wir jetzt an dich, und zwar vollständig. Du verantwortest das Wachstum und die Profitabilität unseres D2C-Geschäfts, führst ein Team aus sieben Menschen, steuerst unsere Agenturen und entscheidest selbst über Budgets, Aktionen und Prioritäten. Ohne lange Freigabeschleifen, in direkter Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, idealerweise mit eigener Verantwortung für Umsatz oder Ergebnis

  • Sicheren Umgang mit Performance-Marketing und Kennzahlen: Du weißt, was ein Kunde kosten darf, und rechnest das auch nach

  • Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams, gern remote und über Ländergrenzen hinweg

  • Ein Gespür für Texte, die verkaufen, und für Creatives, die funktionieren

  • Spürbare Begeisterung für KI und die Bereitschaft, deine Arbeitsweise damit grundlegend zu verändern

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift und fließendes Englisch (ein Teil des Teams arbeitet auf Englisch)

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung mit Advertorials, Native Ads und Direct-Response-Marketing

  • Kenntnisse in WooCommerce/WordPress, Google Analytics 4 und Google Tag Manager

  • Erfahrung mit Klaviyo, TikTok Shop oder A/B-Testing-Programmen

  • Grundverständnis von Werberecht, idealerweise im Bereich regulierter Produkte

Deine Aufgaben

Wachstum & Profitabilität

  • Du findest Wachstumsmöglichkeiten im Shop und in neuen Kanälen und bringst sie konsequent auf die Straße.

  • Du verantwortest den Deckungsbeitrag des D2C-Geschäfts: Werbekosten, Preise, Bundles, Rabattaktionen und Margen.

  • Du planst die wöchentlichen Aktionen und das Sortiment im Shop entlang der Schädlingssaison.

Team & Agenturen

  • Du führst sieben Direct Reports: zwei Menschen im Videoschnitt, eine Person im Grafik- und UX-Design, je eine in der Web- und der App-Entwicklung, eine im Kundenservice und eine im CRM.

  • Du steuerst unsere Agenturen, aktuell fürGoogle Ads und TikTok, setzt Ziele und hinterfragst Ergebnisse.

  • Du sorgst für klare Prioritäten, verbindliche Taktung und gute Briefings, damit das Teamschnell und selbstständig arbeiten kann.

Conversion & Shop

  • Du entwickelst Konzepte für Produktseiten, Upsell-Seiten nach dem Kauf und Landingpages, inklusive Feedbackschleifen mit Design und Entwicklung.

  • Du planst A/B-Tests, wertest sie sauber aus und setzt um, was gewinnt.

  • Du verantwortest die Qualität unserer Produktseiten: Inhalte, Produktdaten,Vergleiche und die vorgeschriebenen Produktangaben.

Creatives & Content

  • Du schreibst Skripte und Briefings für Video-Ads, Reels und statische Creatives und gibst sie in Produktion.

  • Du recherchierst je Schädling, was Kundinnen und Kunden wirklich bewegt, und leitest daraus Botschaften, Hooks und Verkaufsargumente ab.

  • Du verantwortest Blog, SEO und weitere Inhalte, die für den Shop arbeiten.

CRM & Kundenbindung

  • Du steuerst E-Mail-Marketing, Kundenbindung und unser Treueprogramm, um Wiederkäufe und Kundenwert zu steigern.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Kundenservice zusammen und machst aus Kundenfeedback Verbesserungen im Shop.

Daten & KI

  • Du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis sauberer Zahlen: Tracking, Attribution und unser eigenes Dashboard sind dein Werkzeug.

  • Du setzt KI gezielt ein, um Prozesse zu verbessern, neu aufzubauen und zu dokumentieren, und baust bei Bedarf eigene Werkzeuge mit KI.

Woran du gemessen wirst

  • Deckungsbeitrag des D2C-Geschäfts nach Werbekosten

  • Profitabilität auf den Erstkauf und Kosten jeNeukunde (CAC)

  • Conversion Rate und Warenkorbwert

  • Wiederkaufsrate und Kundenwert

  • Tempo und Verlässlichkeit deines Teams

Damit arbeitest du bei uns

Du musst nicht alles schon kennen. Wichtig ist, dass du dich schnell einarbeitest und Lust hast, neue Werkzeuge auszuprobieren.

  • Shop & Warenwirtschaft: WooCommerce/WordPress, JTL-Wawi, TikTokShop

  • Werbung: Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads

  • Daten & Tracking: Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Metorik, eigenes Tracking-Dashboard

  • CRM & Service: Klaviyo, Freshdesk

  • Zusammenarbeit & Design: Notion, Figma, WhatsApp

  • KI: Claude, Obsidian als gemeinsames Firmenwissen, Higgsfield / ElevenLabs für Bild und Video

Und wenn ein Werkzeug fehlt, baust du es dir mit KI selbst. So sind bei uns unter anderem unser Tracking-Dashboard und viele Automatisierungen entstanden.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Echte Verantwortung
    Du entscheidest selbst über Budgets, Agenturen und Aktionen

  • KI ohne Grenzen
    Alle KI-Werkzeuge, die du brauchst, zahlen wir

  • Schlanke Strukturen
    Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen

  • Innovatives, internationales Team
    das bereits KI-gestützt arbeitet

  • Remote-Arbeit
    mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland, Workation im EU-Ausland nach Absprache

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Hardware nach Wahl

  • Weiterbildungsbudget
    für Konferenzen, Kurse und Communities

  • Treffen vor Ort
    mit den Gründern, nach Wunsch und Abstimmung

Vergütung

Für diese Position liegt das Gehalt bei EUR 70,000–85,000 pro Jahr + erfolgsbezogenem Bonus bis 20.00€ zusätzlich

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und zwei bis drei Beispiele deiner Arbeit: ein Test, eine Kampagne oder ein Projekt, das du selbst verantwortet hast, mit ein, zwei Sätzen zu deiner Rolle und dem Ergebnis. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Erzähl uns stattdessen kurz, wie du KI heute in deiner Arbeit einsetzt.
Schritt 1: Kurzes Kennenlerngespräch
Schritt 2: Praxisnahe Fallaufgabe aus unserem Shop
Schritt 3: Abschließendes Gespräch mit den Gründern

title: Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer taking on tasks within the AuterionOS ecosystem, from writing applications to adding driver support for new peripherals, maintaining system services and optimizing performance on embedded platforms. You will be working closely with:

  • Linux running on embedded hardware
  • C/C++, Python & Bash codebases
  • Engaged and friendly engineers from across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Board Support team and collaborate with other development teams to build leading-edge products.
  • Add features, solve bugs, write tests and improve the performance of software components running on AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases.
  • Propose new software solutions and take ownership of the implementation. Your technical expertise will have a huge impact on bringing Auterion’s drone products to market.
  • Provide expert support (L3) to customers facing technical issues.
  • Write clear and concise internal documentation, in addition to contributing to the public-facing knowledge base.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, as well as release planning and task prioritization meetings.

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
  • 3+ years of experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python code in a professional setting.
  • Extensive experience working with embedded architectures, including cross-compilation, debugging, and performance optimization.
  • Expert Linux skills, with an excellent grasp of command line operations, resource management, systems services and networking.
  • Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel, embedded device drivers, device tree configuration and u-boot.
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Debian packaging workflows and managing complex Docker environments.
  • Knowledge of OTA updates (e.g. mender).
  • Proficient in networking concepts across all layers of the OSI model, including connectors, and hardware interfaces, IP addressing, routing protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, etc.
  • Skilled in using network diagnostic tools (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump) to identify and resolve network issues.
  • Basic embedded security knowledge, such as secure boot on embedded devices and/or UEFI, boot chain verification.
  • Proven experience with network security protocols (e.g., SSL/TLS, VPNs) and best practices for securing embedded devices, such as secure boot and encryption mechanisms.
  • Basic electrical engineering experience, such as familiarity with schematics and the instrumentation required to debug communication over I2C, SPI, UART, CAN bus.
  • Bonus: Experience with video streaming and MIPI CSI drivers.
  • Bonus: Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms and their associated BSP packages.
  • Bonus: Experience with NXP iMX8 platforms and their associated BSP packages.
  • Bonus: Previous contributions to open source projects, especially in the Linux ecosystem.
  • Bonus: Experience with CI/CD systems, such as Jenkins, GitHub actions, GitLab CI.
  • Experience working in an agile environment, providing daily updates in stand-ups and managing tasks in a sprint board.
  • A product-oriented mindset, with an eagerness to drive forward project initiatives.
  • EU Citizenship required.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support
  • Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

  • Company Shuttle: Genieße unseren bequemen Shuttleservice, der dich von Laim in München abholt und zu unserem Standort bringt, mit Rückfahrten am Ende des Arbeitstages.

About us:

Quantum Systems ist ein führendes europäisches Deep-Tech-Unternehmen für unbemannte Systeme in den Domänen Luft, Land und See. Wir entwickeln, produzieren und skalieren integrierte Hardware-, Software- und KI-gestützte Lösungen für missionkritische Einsätze in anspruchsvollen Umgebungen.

Unsere Systeme vereinen autonome Plattformen, hochentwickelte Sensorik, sichere Kommunikationstechnologien, Missionssoftware und künstliche Intelligenz, um einsatzrelevante Informationen bereitzustellen, schnellere Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen und Operationen domänenübergreifend zu unterstützen – in der Luft, am Boden und auf See.

Mit Hauptsitz in Gilching bei München sowie weiteren Standorten in Europa und weltweit entwickelt Quantum Systems seine Kerntechnologien vollständig im eigenen Unternehmen. Dieser integrierte Ansatz ermöglicht es uns, Innovationen schnell voranzutreiben, effizient zu skalieren und einsatzbereite Lösungen bereitzustellen – und damit gleichzeitig die technologische Souveränität Europas zu stärken.

Quantum Systems ist im globalen Dual-Use-Markt tätig und unterstützt Streitkräfte, Sicherheitsorganisationen, öffentliche Institutionen sowie Industrie- und Infrastrukturunternehmen. Unsere Systeme kommen bei einer Vielzahl von Missionen zum Einsatz, darunter Aufklärung und Überwachung (ISR), Lagebilderstellung, der Schutz kritischer Infrastrukturen sowie komplexe domänenübergreifende Operationen.

Was uns auszeichnet, ist die Kombination von Hardware, Software und KI in einem integrierten Ökosystem – entwickelt, um Systeme, Daten und Anwender nahtlos über verschiedene Einsatzbereiche hinweg zu vernetzen.

Unsere Mission ist klar: Accelerate the world’s transition to unmanned systems for a better future.

Our commitment:

Wir sind ein weltoffenes Unternehmen, das Vielfalt nicht nur schätzt, sondern aktiv fördert. Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung sind wir fest davon überzeugt, dass die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter ein wesentlicher Bestandteil unseres Erfolgs ist.

Bei uns wird jede Stimme gehört und jede Perspektive geschätzt. Wir glauben daran, dass unsere Unterschiede uns bereichern und uns helfen, kreative Lösungen zu finden und innovative Ideen hervorzubringen. Wir sind stolz darauf, eine inklusive Arbeitsumgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter ihr volles Potenzial entfalten können.

title: Senior Finance Business Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

As Senior Finance Business Analyst/Senior Accountant, you will be a strategic member of our Controllership team based in Barcelona. This role sits under the Finance Department and you will be able to apply both your accounting and analysis skills. You will be part of the Trade Team, with whom you will be responsible for reconciling sales and purchases between backend data and the ERP, calculating and verifying the commissions and fees, and reconciling and invoicing supplier monthly data, among other adhoc projects. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and enjoys turning data into strategy.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Perform monthly reconciliations between the operational back-end systems and the accounting ERP (NetSuite) to ensure completeness and accuracy of revenue and COGS.

  • Prepare, review and post monthly journal entries, including revenue and COGS accruals, reclassifications and other accounting adjustments, ensuring accuracy, completeness and compliance with applicable accounting policies.

  • Perform monthly flux analysis across revenue, COGS and relevant balance sheet accounts, investigating significant movements against prior periods, identifying underlying business drivers and providing clear explanations for variances.

  • Investigate discrepancies and coordinate with relevant stakeholders (Strategic Finance, Supplier Relationship, Product) to ensure timely resolution.

  • Calculate and review the commissions received from the assigned verticals, and dispute differences if any.

  • Ensure that suppliers within assigned verticals are properly reconciled in NetSuite and that their aging reports are clean and accurate, analyzing open items and clearing accounts and proposing the right treatment for each.

  • Calculate and review the commissions received from the assigned verticals, and dispute differences if any, working with Supplier Relationship on the conversation with the supplier.

  • Read and interpret supplier and partner contracts to understand how commission and fee terms work, including variable elements, and check that they are reflected correctly in the calculations and data.

  • Support external audits, including preparing workpapers and responding to inquiries.

  • Turn recurring findings into insight and recommendations for Strategic Finance, Supplier Relationship and Product.

  • Identify automation and systems optimization opportunities in the order-to-cash and procure-to-pay cycles, replacing manual reconciliation steps with repeatable checks.

  • Participate in process improvement and optimization projects across the accounting function.

  

What We’re Looking For

  • Extensive experience in Financial Business Analytics (Audit, Accounting, Controllership).

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (Master’s or CPA/ACCA a plus).

  • Solid understanding of revenue recognition principles and financial accounting, preferably under US GAAP or IFRS.

  • Proven experience analysing revenue, COGS and gross margin performance, identifying trends and investigating variances between financial and operational data.

  • Ability to interpret commercial agreements and supplier contracts, understanding their financial and accounting implications.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments, with the ability to adapt quickly and prioritize effectively.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills—you can explain complex ideas in simple terms to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • High business acumen and strategic thinking—you're not just delivering data, you're driving decisions.

  • Experience with ERP systems - NetSuite is a plus.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets skills.

  • Proactive, hands-on attitude with the ability to work independently.

  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Tech awareness - active interest in technology and automation. We constantly strive to improve and automate our policies so that we operate world class processes.

  • Excellent team player


What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk.

  • Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays.

  • Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance.

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen.

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party.

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan.

  • Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes.

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year.

  • Nurture your language skills with real-life English, Spanish, and Catalan lessons.

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support.

Interview Process

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
descriptionHtml:
💰 Up to £95k depending on experience

📍 Salary based on London. Hybrid, with flexible hours.

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Close, audit, tax and payments operations are already covered by the finance team. What has not been built yet is planning. This role exists to make planning a discipline the leadership team uses every week: a forecast budget owners trust, and unit economics that change decisions.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Senior FP&A Analyst/Senior Commercial Analyst to build and own Fanvue's company model, forecasting and commercial analysis, reporting to our VP Finance.

This is hands-on. You will build the driver-based model the executive team and board run the business on, turn creator, fan and payments data into unit economics people act on, and partner directly with budget owners across the business. It suits someone who has built models from scratch, pulls their own data, and can put a number on every outcome they claim.

This is not a reporting role. Someone strong on reporting but weak on building models is the wrong hire here, however polished.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Build and own the company model: a driver-based forecast with base, upside and downside cases that leadership and the board use

  • Forecast GMV and net revenue from the real drivers: creators, paying fans, spend per fan, cohorts, seasonality and take rate

  • Run the budget and monthly reforecast, and explain variances in terms budget owners can act on

  • Analyse unit economics, cohorts, pricing and margin, and use that analysis to change pricing and deal decisions

  • Partner with department heads on spend, bringing data and options rather than simply saying no

  • Pull your own data with SQL, reconcile it back to the ledger, and automate reporting so it runs without you

  • Bring AI tools into the planning and reporting workflow

  • Own monthly investor reporting and contribute to board packs and fundraising data rooms

👀 Who You Are

  • You have built a driver-based forecast or company model from scratch, and can walk through every driver in it

  • You have done analysis that changed a pricing, deal or spending decision, and you know the numbers before and after

  • You write SQL and are comfortable in a BI tool. You do not wait for someone else to hand you the data

  • You have run budget reviews with department heads and are trusted by them

  • Experience in a two-sided marketplace, payments, subscription or e-commerce business

  • A scale-up background, ideally having built something from scratch in ambiguity and chosen that stage

Nice to have

  • Experience in the creator economy or a high-risk payments category

  • Exposure to a fundraise or a data room

  • Reporting pipelines automated end to end

  • Background in STEM

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You want to build the planning function rather than maintain a model someone else designed

  • You would rather pull the data yourself than wait for it

  • You like being in the room when the decision is made, not reporting on it afterwards

  • You are comfortable telling a department head the number does not support the spend, and then helping them find a way that does

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You see FP&A as reporting, and want a finished model to maintain

  • You need an ERP or established planning tools in place before you can start

  • You prefer to police budgets rather than partner with the people who own them

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Build planning from the ground up at a company growing this fast

  • Direct exposure to leadership, the board and investor reporting

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

title: Senior HPC Engineer, GPU Compute
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior HPC Cluster Engineer to join our team and play a key role in the development of our cutting-edge hyperscaler platform. The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack. You’ll work closely with hardware virtualization and device emulation technologies, ensuring high performance and security in multi-GPU, HPC environments. The role involves analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving infrastructure to support new hardware, fine-tuning system performance, and automating fault detection and resolution in a complex system.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments. 
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting the root cause of issues related to GPUs and InfiniBand networks, and proposing corrective actions. 
  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM. 
  • Enhancing automation systems for proactive monitoring, detecting, and resolving issues in GPU and InfiniBand environments. 
  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in system-level software development (focused on performance optimization, low-level programming). 
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Linux systems (administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning). 
  • In-depth understanding of server architecture, including PCIe devices, NICs, Linux OS/Kernel, and high-performance computing (HPC) systems. 
  • Strong proficiency in one or more performance-oriented programming languages (C/C++, Go, Python).

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with GPU end-to-end testing in a cluster environment using InfiniBand networking. 
  • Proven track record of analyzing and optimizing the performance of HPC workloads (e.g., simulations, data analysis, AI/ML workloads). 
  • Familiarity with RDMA, RoCE, and InfiniBand protocols for high-performance communication. 
  • Background in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and experience with HPC cluster networking. 
  • Understanding of QEMU/KVM virtualization and managing virtualized environments. 
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, and their integration with HPC systems. 
  • Familiarity with collective communication libraries like MPI and NCCL for distributed computing. 

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: (Senior) Implementation Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Dafür bauen wir ein eigenes Consulting-Team auf, und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.


Die Rolle

Du übernimmst neue Kunden direkt nach der Unterschrift und bringst sie in den ersten 90 Tagen in die produktive Nutzung. Du leitest den Kick-off, klärst mit dem Kunden, wer ausschreibt und mit welchem Projekt es losgeht, schulst Einkauf, Kalkulation und Projektleitung und sorgst dafür, dass die ersten Ausschreibungen rausgehen und Angebote zurückkommen. Wenn ein Kunde hängt, merkst du es früh und drehst ihn, notfalls über die Geschäftsführung. Nach 90 Tagen übergibst du ihn mit klarem Stand an seinen Account Manager.

Du begleitest viele Kunden parallel, vom Familienbetrieb bis zum Generalunternehmer mit mehreren Niederlassungen. Als Senior Implementation Consultant übernimmst du die komplexen Einführungen: mehrere Standorte oder Gesellschaften, Freigabeprozesse, Systemlandschaften und viele Beteiligte. Und du entwickelst mit, wie unser Consulting-Team arbeitet.

Du berichtest an die Leiterin unseres Consulting-Teams.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Deine Kunden sind nach 90 Tagen produktiv: Sie schreiben über Cosuno aus und erhalten Angebote, nachweisbar im Activation Report.

  • Jeder Kick-off endet mit klaren Zusagen: ausschreibende Nutzer, erstes Projekt, Termine, Mandat der Geschäftsführung.

  • Kunden, die hinter Plan liegen, haben schnell einen Plan, und die meisten holen auf.

  • Deine Kunden bewerten ihr Onboarding gut, und dein Account Manager weiß bei der Übergabe genau, wo der Kunde steht.

  • Als Senior: Deine komplexen Einführungen erreichen ihr Ziel, und das Team arbeitet mit Bausteinen, die du entwickelt hast.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist

  • Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

  • Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

  • Drive. Wenn ein Kunde hängt, rufst du an, statt auf die nächste Mail zu warten.

  • Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du gern erklärst und es dich reizt, gerade die Skeptiker zu überzeugen.

  • du lieber vom Ziel rückwärts planst, als Schulungen abzuarbeiten.

  • du bei vielen Kunden parallel den Überblick behältst und weißt, wer heute deine Zeit bekommt.

  • du mit Kalkulatoren und Geschäftsführern gleichermaßen auf Augenhöhe sprichst.

  • du verstehen willst, wie am Bau eingekauft und vergeben wird.

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • du Onboarding als eine Reihe von Produktdemos verstehst.

  • du lieber in langen Projekten mit wenigen Kunden berätst als viele Kunden schnell zum Ergebnis zu bringen.

  • du wartest, bis der Kunde sich meldet.

Harte Anforderungen

  • Mindestens ein Jahr eigene Verantwortung für die Einführung einer Software beim Kunden, etwa als Implementation Consultant, Onboarding Manager oder Customer Success Manager mit Onboarding-Schwerpunkt, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS.

  • Erfahrung mit vielen parallelen Kunden und belegbare Ergebnisse, zum Beispiel Go-live- oder Aktivierungsquoten.

  • Du hältst Schulungen und Workshops souverän, online und vor Ort.

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Gutes Englisch, Erfahrung mit Bau, Immobilien oder Vertical SaaS und sicherer Umgang mit KI-Werkzeugen sind ein Plus.

  • Für Senior Implementation Consultant zusätzlich: Einführungen bei Kunden mit mehreren Standorten, Gesellschaften oder Systemen und viel Kontakt zur Geschäftsführung.

Was wir bieten

  • Aufbau: Du bist von Anfang an Teil eines neuen Teams und gestaltest mit, wie wir Kunden in die Nutzung bringen.

  • Wirkung: Klare Ziele und direkter Einfluss darauf, ob ein Kunde bleibt.

  • Entwicklung: Vom Implementation Consultant zum Senior über immer komplexere Kunden, mit regelmäßigen 1:1s und offener Feedbackkultur.

  • Vertrag: Unbefristet, moderne Ausstattung.

  • Arbeitsort: Remote innerhalb der EU möglich, Berlin-Kreuzberg bevorzugt.

  • Team: Firmen- und Teamevents, online und offline.

So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Kennenlernen mit unserem Head of Customer Success (45 Minuten)

  2. Gespräch mit der Leiterin unseres Consulting-Teams (30 Minuten)

  3. Case Study an einem realistischen Neukunden, dazu ein Gespräch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus dem Team

  4. Referenzgespräch, danach unser Angebot

title: Senior Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role:

We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leveraging your distributed systems expertise to build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
  • Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
  • Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
  • Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
  • Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring:

  • You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
  • You have shown your ability to understand and work on complex, highly distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
  • You demonstrate the ability to build and debug features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities.
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points:

  • Data stores
  • Search, analytics, Lucene
  • Strong knowledge of the JDK
  • Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty.

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

title: Senior Launch Operations Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief

As a Senior Launch Operations Engineer, you’ll join the team in Germany that shapes how our missions come to life. From the moment a campaign is conceived, you are the one aligning global launch sites, synchronizing teams and defining the operational path that ultimately determines how—and whether—the rocket leaves the ground. 

Within the global Launch Operations team, you stand at the core of our mission: transforming complex campaigns into repeatable, scalable and reliable operations over multiple launch sites. Your work creates the structure that enables teams across the world to execute with confidence and precision. 

When a campaign moves from planning to execution, you step directly into the field—joining local teams on site, leading coordination efforts in the company, and operations both inside and outside the control room. In these moments, you carry the responsibility of turning months of preparation into a successful launch day. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Coordinate and prepare launch and stage acceptance campaigns end‑to‑end, ensuring full launch system readiness. Over time, you can grow into a test or launch director role for dedicated missions.  
  • Develop a deep understanding of our launch system to make sound operational decisions, even under pressure. You use this knowledge to guide local teams and maintain global alignment. 
  • Own mission‑level configuration management, keeping design, manufacturing, assembly and testing tightly aligned with mission goals. Your decisions set the operational envelope long before the rocket reaches the pad. 
  • As our launch cadence grows and additional sites come online, you will contribute to our team shaping the future of multi‑site launch operations and define how our global team executes missions. 
  • Feeding flight experience directly back into engineering teams, ensuring that operational insights continuously improve our system design. 

Qualification Checklist 

  • At least five years of experience in the space sector or a comparable high‑stakes environment, with a strong background in mission or operational roles, ideally including launch‑related responsibilities 
  • Degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical engineering or a comparable engineering discipline 
  • System-level technical understanding of launch vehicles and their subsystems 
  • Demonstrated autonomy and a solution-oriented mindset 
  • Experience in multidisciplinary troubleshooting and cross‑functional coordination 
  • Ability to maintain clarity and performance in high‑stress, long‑duration operational settings 
  • Strong organizational discipline, situational awareness, and ability to lead within diverse teams 
  • Comfortable working self‑sufficiently and adapting quickly to highly dynamic environments 
  • Willingness to travel to global launch sites for multi‑week campaign deployments

title: Senior Lead Claims Operations (m/f/x)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Progyny Global, part of the Progyny, Inc. family, we're on a mission to make fertility, pregnancy, and family-forming care accessible worldwide.

By combining world-class clinical expertise with innovative technology, we deliver inclusive, culturally competent support that helps individuals and families navigate some of life's most important journeys.

With Progyny's support and global reach, we're expanding access to care and breaking down barriers so that more people can build the families they want, wherever they are in the world.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Lead Claims Operations to lead our small claims team, strengthen our global claims operations, and drive the development of the tools that support our members and team.

Our members come to us during one of the hardest phases of their lives. A fertility journey is physically and emotionally exhausting, and a slow reimbursement or an unclear answer adds stress nobody should have to carry. That is why member experience sits at the heart of every claims process we run: we respond fast, we explain decisions clearly, and we treat every piece of member feedback as important. We want our members to feel the difference to a traditional insurer at every step.

This is a player-coach role combining team leadership, operational oversight, and product improvement. You’ll guide and develop the team, manage quality and workload, and continuously improve our processes. You’ll also stay close to daily operations by handling complex or escalated cases, reviewing selected claims, and stepping in during periods of increased demand. Your routine caseload will be significantly smaller than that of a Claims Processor, allowing you to focus where your experience and judgement have the greatest impact.

Working closely with the VP Member Experience, Legal, Clinical Operations, and Finance, you’ll help maintain a fair, consistent, and compliant claims framework across our markets. You’ll bring practical judgement to reviewing contracts, invoices, and claims documentation, recognising country-specific requirements and knowing when specialist input is needed.

You’ll also drive the continuous development of our internal claims processing tool, member-facing claims submission experience, and wallet in partnership with Product and Engineering. You’ll translate operational and member needs into clear requirements, help prioritise improvements, and ensure new features meet those requirements before launch.

We’re looking for a collaborative, pragmatic leader who combines strong analytical skills with precision and attention to detail. You’ll enjoy being close to the work, use data to guide decisions, take ownership of improvements, and understand the impact every claim can have on a member’s journey.

What you will do

Team leadership and daily operations

  • Lead and develop our claims team through coaching, feedback, and regular quality reviews.

  • Coordinate workloads, priorities, and coverage to meet service levels and maintain a sustainable workload.

  • Handle complex or escalated cases, review selected claims, and support processing during periods of increased demand.

  • Define clear targets and SLAs for the team, such as turnaround times, processing accuracy, and member satisfaction. Track them continuously, report on progress to the VP Member Experience, and drive measurable improvements quarter over quarter.

Process improvement and member experience

  • Use operational data and team insights to identify recurring issues and improve workflows across markets and product lines.

  • Maintain consistent claims decisions, clear documentation, and effective escalation and quality-assurance processes.

  • Ensure members receive accurate, timely, and empathetic communication throughout the claims journey.

Claims products, wallet, automation and AI

  • Drive improvements to our internal claims processing tool, member-facing claims submission experience, and wallet with Product and Engineering, and identify where AI can make claims work faster and more accurate.

  • Define product requirements and acceptance criteria, including where AI may support a decision and where human review remains mandatory, and help prioritise enhancements based on member needs, operational impact, data protection, and risk.

  • Coordinate user acceptance testing, validate features before launch, and prepare the team through updated workflows and training.

  • Monitor results after launch, including the quality and accuracy of AI outputs, and drive further improvements.

Claims framework, regulatory requirements, and controls

  • Review provider contracts, invoices, and claims documentation for market-specific contractual and regulatory requirements, involving Legal, Clinical Operations, or Finance where needed.

  • Maintain the claims framework and translate agreed requirements into practical workflows, controls, and guidance.

  • Partner with Finance on payment accuracy and reconciliation, support audits, and address control or compliance gaps.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience in claims, healthcare benefits, reimbursement, insurance operations, or a related field, including three years coordinating or leading a team.

  • Hands-on expertise in complex claims, quality assurance, operational controls, and financial reconciliation.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work, ideally in operational workflows such as document processing or case handling, with a clear sense of where human judgement and data protection require oversight.

  • Experience reviewing contracts, invoices, and claims documentation against market-specific contractual and regulatory requirements, recognising when specialist input is needed.

  • Experience defining product requirements with Product and Engineering, testing new features, and supporting operational rollouts.

  • Experience improving processes and managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, ideally within a technology company or scale-up.

  • Strong analytical skills, precision, and attention to detail, using operational KPIs to guide decisions and improvements.

  • Clear communication, sound judgement, and a collaborative, empathetic leadership style focused on the member experience.

  • Professional fluency in English.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

We are looking for a hands-on legal professional to lead the German legal function of an international robotics startup, with a strong operational footprint in Munich, Germany and group headquarters in Limassol, Cyprus. You will be the first lawyer on the ground in Germany, working alongside the Group General Counsel located in Cyprus.


Key responsibilities

  • Establish and oversee the legal framework for the German operating company, aligned with group standards.

  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts, NDAs, partnership and licensing agreements, manufacturing and supplier terms.

  • Oversee regulatory matters, including EU AI Act, EU Machinery Regulation, Cyber Resilience Act, CE marking, product compliance, NIS2, GDPR, and other applicable EU and German requirements (with external specialists where needed).

  • Support trade compliance and export-control obligations as the robotics platform scales across Europe and potentially internationally.

  • Handle German employment law matters, including works council (Betriebsrat) and co-determination obligations as the entity grows.

  • Oversee IP matters together with external counsel: patents, trademarks, copyright, and technology licensing – together with external patent counsel and the Group General Counsel.

  • Contribute to international structuring, investment rounds, and due-diligence preparation.

  • Assist in intercompany arrangements together with finance teams.

  • Liaise with regulators, notaries, and other authorities in Germany, and elsewhere in the EU where required.

  • Develop internal legal policies, templates, and approval workflows to streamline operations.

title: Senior Manager, Content (12m FTC)
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Job Description

Checkout.com is looking for a Senior Manager, Content to lead our Content team, content strategy, and set the editorial direction for everything we publish aligned with our expanding mission, new product segments, and greater global reach.

This is a people management plus hands-on role with real scope. You will own the content roadmap, lead our highest-profile reports and content workstreams, and manage the agencies and budgets that support them. You will also stay close to the craft, personally writing and shaping a wide range of content pieces. You will manage three content specialists, and you will work side by side with senior stakeholders across Marketing and Commercial to make sure our content earns its place in the market.

Why this role exists

Every piece of Checkout.com content should do a job and this role exists to make sure it does.

You will make sure our content:

Drives our commercial objectives, working with teams to ensure there is a clear line from every piece to pipeline, revenue and customer growth

Prepares the ground for our new narrative, so that what we say tomorrow feels earned by what we publish today

Is highly impactful, with a clear point of view and a high bar for quality

Moves our customers, speaking to what they care about in language that changes minds and behaviour

Makes us irresistible in the market, so that Checkout.com is the brand merchants want to work with

Creates genuine thought leadership that shapes how the industry thinks about payments

How you'll make an impact

Editorial direction and content strategy

Set the editorial direction for Checkout.com's content, defining what we stand for, what we say and what good looks like across every format and channel

Translate our evolving narrative and commercial priorities into a clear content strategy, and bring the team and stakeholders along with it

Build and own the content roadmap, making deliberate calls on what to prioritise, what to stop and where to invest

Hold the quality bar for the team's output, making sure every piece is accurate, insight-led and distinctively Checkout.com

Develop and deliver content strategy for new audiences and segments, including SMB and consumer

High-profile reports and content Work-Streams

Lead our flagship reports and highest-profile content work-streams from idea and brief through research, writing, launch and distribution

Personally write or shape our most important content, including large reports, thought leadership, executive-facing pieces and event talk tracks

Make sure our biggest content moments are data-led, evidence-backed and built to be picked up by customers, press and analysts

Define the right measures of success for each workstream, including commercial contribution, audience engagement and share of voice, and use results to decide what to scale, change or stop

Events Content

Drive the content for our high-impact owned and industry events, such as Thrive, SXSW London and Money20/20, so that the story on stage, in the room and after the event is consistent and compelling

Partner with the Experiential team from the start of each event, shaping themes, speaker narratives and content that carries through into wider campaigns and commercial follow-up

Stakeholders and roadmap

Work closely with senior stakeholders across Marketing and Commercial, including Product Marketing, Regional Marketing, Brand, Communications and Sales, to map the content roadmap against business priorities

Act as the content expert in planning forums, communicating recommendations clearly, resolving competing priorities and holding the line on quality and focus when demand outstrips capacity

Ground decisions in customer insight, commercial data and stakeholder feedback

Agencies and budget

Manage the content budget and relevant agency partners, including briefing, performance management and quality control

Shape investment cases and recommend where to spend based on expected value and evidence of returns

Drive agencies to clear KPIs tied to our commercial and marketing objectives

Lead and develop the team

Manage and develop the existing Content team through clear goals, regular coaching, honest feedback and meaningful ownership

Manage team workload and priorities, balancing demand across the business so the team can do its best work at a sustainable pace

Balance personal delivery with team execution: step in on the complex work when your expertise is needed, while making sure the team keeps ownership and grows through the work

Build team capability, including the confident and responsible use of AI to raise both quality and pace

What we're looking for

8+ years in content, editorial or communications, with a proven record of content leadership. We care more about the quality of your career progression than the exact number of years

Experience in a large fintech or a scaled tech business. B2B or B2C backgrounds are both welcome. Payments experience is preferred but not required.

Prior experience managing a team

A strong editorial point of view and an excellent writer, with a portfolio that shows you can produce high-impact reports, thought leadership and executive content

Experience leading flagship, data-led reports or similar high-profile content programmes from brief to launch

Strong commercial understanding, with experience managing budgets and agencies, assessing ROI and using data to guide decisions

Confident communication and stakeholder management, including influencing senior leaders and creating clarity when requirements are ambiguous

Strong operational judgement: you manage multiple workstreams, prioritise with conviction, and explain your choices clearly

AI-fluent: you use AI tools as a genuine productivity multiplier, knowing where they add pace and where the human edit matters

Data-aware: you use analytics to understand performance and adjust, not just report numbers upward

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram
