title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention.
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

title: Staff Information Security Professional (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über IONOS

Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools.

Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen.

Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns.

Als Mitglied des multinationalen Security Management Teams bei IONOS SE arbeitest du für einen der größten europäischen Hoster im rasant wachsenden Cloud-Sektor und bringst dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung ein, um unsere Produkte und Systemlandschaft noch besser zu schützen. Du bist verantwortlich für das Design und den Betrieb eines integrierten Managementsystems, das unter anderem zertifizierte Bereiche nach ISO 27001, KRITIS, NIS2 umfasst und kontinuierlich ausgebaut wird. Das Ziel ist es, die Umsetzung und den Betrieb von Sicherheitsmechanismen zu fördern und zu steuern – nicht nur, um nachzuweisen, dass unsere Produkte die Sicherheitsanforderungen der Standards erfüllen, sondern auch, um den Nutzen für unsere Kund:innen und das Unternehmen zu erhöhen. Du schlägst die Brücke von ISO 27001 zu aufkommenden regulatorischen Standards wie NIS2 und KRITIS und stellst sicher, dass unsere Produkte eine grundsolide Compliance beibehalten und gleichzeitig schnelle Innovationen ermöglichen.

Aufgaben

  • Kontinuierliche Compliance & Audit-Durchführung: Leite die operative Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung interner und externer Sicherheitsaudits. Führe das Unternehmen durch den Einsatz von Echtzeit-Sicherheitsdashboards und modernen GRC-Tools hin zu einer kontinuierlichen Compliance.
  • Regulatorische & Zertifizierungsausrichtung: Gleiche unsere Zertifizierungsrahmenwerke mit sich entwickelnden regulatorischen Anforderungen ab – einschließlich der NIS2- und KRITIS-Standards.
  • Reporting & Executive Interface: Erstelle, kompiliere und präsentiere Sicherheitsmetriken und Zertifizierungsstatusberichte für das Senior Management.
  • Disziplinübergreifende Risiko- & Vendor-Unterstützung: Unterstütze Risikomanagement, Third-Party Risk Assessments (TPRM), Security Awareness und Incident Management über alle Produktlinien hinweg.

Qualifikationen

  • Zertifizierungs- & Framework-Expertise: Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der erfolgreichen Leitung von ISO 27001 Audits. Praktische Vertrautheit mit DSGVO, CSA CCM und neuen Standards (NIS2/KRITIS).

title: Staff Platform Engineer, Fanatics Markets - UK
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

About the Team

Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow—from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.

Role Overview

As a Staff Software Engineer within our Platform team, you will help define the technical direction of the platform underpinning our exchange and trading systems. You will lead the design and evolution of our infrastructure and platform standards to support a highly available, low-latency exchange, partnering closely with exchange engineers and engineering leads to enable rapid innovation without compromising stability or security.

This role requires a balance of deep hands-on software engineering, systems thinking and technical leadership. You will lead complex projects that support the exchange—from load-testing environments and mock integrations to monitoring and automated recovery. You will turn ambiguous requirements into practical designs, own delivery from ideation to production and help operate the platform as the exchange goes live. The balance of coding and infrastructure work varies by project, but you should be comfortable independently developing new software as well as improving existing systems, setting platform standards and mentoring engineers across experience levels.

On the engineering side, we are pioneering the use of AI as a code collaborator. We need engineers who have moved beyond experimentation—who actively use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to ship production code faster while maintaining exceptional quality.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and development of software tools, services and automation that solve complex infrastructure, reliability and developer experience challenges.
  • Define and evolve the architecture of highly available cloud-native infrastructure, balancing performance, reliability, security and cost as the platform grows.
  • Set technical direction for CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling, remaining hands-on in delivering improvements to the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Lead the development of load-testing environments and supporting software, including mock services and integrations.
  • Establish and evolve standards for AI-augmented development, using effective prompting and validation practices to increase velocity without sacrificing code quality.
  • Identify and mitigate AI-generated code pitfalls, such as security vulnerabilities or over-abstraction, and help teams evaluate the impact on quality and productivity.
  • Guide the design and implementation of platform security safeguards and compliance standards to protect the integrity of the firm’s systems.
  • Shape the system observability roadmap and lead improvements to monitoring, tracing, alerting and automated recovery.
  • Partner with exchange, product and engineering leads to resolve architectural trade-offs, align priorities and deliver scalable platform solutions.
  • Mentor engineers across experience levels, lead technical design discussions and raise engineering standards across teams.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation, lead incident response for team-owned services and drive engineering improvements that prevent recurring incidents.

Skills

  • Significant experience in software, backend or platform engineering, with a track record of leading complex technical projects and delivering production software and scalable, cloud-native environments.
  • Deep software development expertise, including the ability to independently design, build, test and deploy services or substantial tools from scratch and guide others through complex implementation decisions.
  • Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience, including designing and operating production environments, troubleshooting complex failures, and establishing patterns for high availability and efficient scaling.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure as code using Terraform, including making architectural decisions across complex environments.
  • High proficiency in Java and Python; Go is a plus. You should be comfortable bridging the gap between infrastructure and application logic.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems and the ability to make and explain trade-offs between low latency, high availability, scalability and operational complexity.
  • Experience shaping CI/CD and observability approaches, with hands-on knowledge of tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or Datadog.
  • Strong proficiency in using AI collaborators such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to ship production code and improve engineering workflows.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated code for security gaps or architectural errors and establish rigorous testing and validation practices.
  • Proven ability to turn ambiguous problems into a clear technical direction and deliver improvements across team boundaries, balancing immediate needs with long-term architectural health.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions, influence without formal authority and collaborate effectively with distributed engineering and product teams.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and building alignment around technical standards and architectural decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-growth startup environments.
  • Experience with financial systems, exchanges, real-money transactions or regulatory compliance.
  • Background in designing and building internal developer platforms, tools, CLI applications or infrastructure automation services.
  • Experience developing load-testing environments, mock services or automated recovery systems.
  • Experience leading technical initiatives spanning multiple teams or evolving platform architecture through significant growth or change.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

Ready to build the future of sports betting? If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply! Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. We are open to fully remote candidates based in the United Kingdom. Remote employees may also be eligible for a home office setup stipend.

title: Staff Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Lead/Staff Product Designer to shape some of the most important experiences in our marketplace. You'll own complex, high-impact problem spaces end to end — from ambiguous discovery through to shipped, measured outcomes — and raise the bar for design craft and pace across the whole team.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with real influence. You'll partner directly with product and engineering leadership, mentor other designers, and set the standard for how design work gets done at Carwow.

A note on how we work: AI fluency is integral to the role. Our design team works AI-natively. We use Claude Code/Design (and similar tools) to move from idea to high-quality prototype in hours, not weeks, and we expect designers at this level to be genuinely fluent in this way of working, not just curious about it. If you're still designing the way teams did in 2023, this probably isn't the right role. If you've rebuilt your workflow around AI and it's made you dramatically faster and more ambitious, we'd love to talk.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own end-to-end design for a major problem space in our marketplace — buying, selling, or dealer-facing products — from discovery and framing through to launch and iteration

  • Prototype at pace using AI, getting real, testable experiences in front of users and stakeholders early and often

  • Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers, using AI-assisted workflows to close the gap between design intent and shipped product — ideally getting hands-on in code where it speeds things up

  • Set direction, not just execute: identify opportunities, make the case with evidence, and bring product and engineering partners with you

  • Raise the craft bar across the team through critique, mentorship, and by making your own work an example worth following

  • Champion AI-native ways of working — sharing techniques, building reusable prompts and workflows, and helping the wider team level up

  • Ground decisions in evidence, combining user research, data, and rapid experimentation

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 7+ years of product design experience, with a track record of leading complex, high-impact work in consumer or marketplace products

  • Native app experience

  • A high degree of AI fluency. Hands-on, demonstrable experience using Claude Design (or an equivalent AI design/prototyping tool) as a core part of your workflow — this is critical to the role, and we'll want to see it in your portfolio and hear about it in interviews

  • Strong end-to-end craft: you can go from a fuzzy problem statement to polished, production-ready design, and everything you ship is considered

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace — you make good decisions with incomplete information and iterate quickly

  • Excellent communication and influence: you can align senior stakeholders, tell a compelling story with your work, and hold your ground constructively

  • Experience mentoring designers and lifting the standard of a team

 

STRONGLY PREFERRED

  • Experience with Claude Code (or an equivalent AI coding agent) — enough to prototype in real code, collaborate more deeply with engineers, or ship small changes yourself

  • Marketplace, e-commerce, or two-sided platform experience

  • Familiarity with experimentation-driven product development (A/B testing, funnel analysis)

 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first six months you'll have taken ownership of a significant problem space, shipped work that measurably moves a core metric, and become someone other designers seek out — both for the quality of your craft and for how you use AI tools to work at a pace and ambition level others want to copy.

 

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

title: Staff Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

About Physical AI

CoreWeave's Physical AI team helps companies apply AI to the physical systems they design, test, and operate, across automotive, industrial, robotics, and autonomous vehicles (AV).

We work as one cross-functional team of product, design, engineering, and forward-deployed engineers, partnering directly with our customers' engineering teams.

Our focus is twofold: making AI usable for engineers who know their machines in depth but are not ML specialists, and supporting robotics and AV teams across the full development loop, from sensor data and simulation to model training and evaluation.

What You’ll Do:

As a Staff Product Designer on the Physical AI team, you will lead design across our portfolio of Physical AI products, turning complex data and ML workflows into tools that engineers who build vehicles, machines, and robots trust and use every day. You'll bring strong design craft and sharp product judgment to a new product area, setting direction and framing ambiguous problems.

This is a role with real breadth. You'll own the end-to-end experience across a number of products, from the customer-facing apps engineers use day to day to the builder tools our Field team use to create and publish those apps. You'll set a shared design vision for the portfolio and consolidate our Physical AI products into the broader CoreWeave design language, so they reuse proven patterns and feel like part of one platform. You'll also spend time with customer engineering teams to understand their workflows, data, and constraints, turning what you learn into clear problem framing for Product and Engineering.

We're looking for a designer who uses AI tools as a core part of their workflow today, to prototype, test ideas, and explore more options in less time. Comfort with technical complexity and a bias toward experimentation are essential here.

As the most senior designer on the Physical AI team, you'll mentor the designers you work alongside, raise the craft bar, and shape how design works with Product, Engineering, and Field Engineering. You'll be joining a small, high-trust design team. The work is broad, the impact is real, and there's room to shape how design operates at one of the fastest-growing infrastructure companies in the world.

Who You Are:

  • 8+ years of experience as a versatile designer who can own all facets of design, including user research, UX, interaction design, prototyping, and UI design.
  • An excellent portfolio showcasing user-centered problem solving through interaction design, visual design, and systems thinking.
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and a solid understanding of building usable, accessible, and modular designs that scale.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering to define strategy and solve complex problems for technical users in B2B, infrastructure, developer tools, or platform contexts.
  • Actively incorporates AI tools into your design workflow, using them to move faster, prototype smarter, and tackle harder problems.
  • Comfortable working with technical complexity and ambiguity; you help teams frame problems, not just resolve them.

Preferred:

  • Experience with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, or modern frameworks for prototyping or implementation.

title: Staff Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About this role:

As a Staff Product Designer at Samsara, you will set a vision and ship work that shapes the way our customers and internal teams operate. You will partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders, set the interaction patterns and visual systems other designers build on, and build direct relationships with our most strategic customers.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact: helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead large, ambiguous initiatives that span multiple product areas, from problem framing through launch and iteration.
  • Be a taste maker and demonstrate good judgement in your domain.
  • Regularly meet and engage with our most strategic customers to bring the customer voice alongside product data into product decisions.
  • Leverage AI tools through every step of the process, defining new ways of working and democratizing design at Samsara.
  • Stay well informed on the emerging trends, tools, and technology. Give back to the community.
  • Ship code to production across our design system, web products, and mobile apps.
  • Set the bar for what great looks like through building and shipping.

Minimum requirements for the role:

descriptionHtml:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

The Firefox team is a community of engineers who care deeply about delivering the fastest, friendliest, most usable browser possible. We are responsible for making the things you see in the browser work securely, quickly, and well! The Enterprise team is a cross-disciplinary team in charge of improving and maintaining Firefox support for large Enterprise deployments. As part of the team, you will be responsible for all things related to services and infrastructure for our Enterprise products.

A Staff Software Engineer is the next level up from a Senior Software Engineer. At Mozilla this role can vary, but typically a staff engineer supports an engineering team, providing technical leadership, building cross-team relationships, and helping the team deliver on their objectives.

What You'll Do:

What You’ll Bring:

title: Staff Software Engineer - OpenTelemetry Python instrumentation | UK | Remote
descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from Germany, UK, Ireland and Spain.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack

The Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications and infrastructure in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it.

The OpenTelemetry SDKs team's mission is to make sure our users succeed in instrumenting their software with OpenTelemetry. We work closely with the OpenTelemetry SIGs to make OpenTelemetry SDKs and instrumentation libraries a success. Members of this team are experts in at least one programming language and have a broad knowledge of various other programming languages.

In this role, you will focus on a language-specific implementation of OpenTelemetry in Python, with an emphasis on OpenTelemetry for Generative AI. You will get to work in an upstream-first approach, helping accelerate the OpenTelemetry project while bringing the innovations to Grafana labs products and offerings. 

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. We are looking for Engineers that are passionate about communicating with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities.

At Grafana Labs, ICs have a dedicated career path and do not have to become managers to progress in their career. Staff Software Engineers at Grafana have a large amount of experience across multiple areas.  They are able to estimate, plan, coordinate and deliver large tasks spanning multiple systems.  They actively coach and mentor other team members in their team and are able to identify and resolve issues with technology and product processes. 

What You’ll Be Doing:

You will bring your software engineering expertise to develop improvements to the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, with a strong focus on AI applications and agent workflows. This is a hands-on role for someone with deep Python expertise and an interest in AI.

  • Collaborate in open-source communities. You will develop and maintain the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, working with maintainers and other vendors on specifications, APIs, and implementation decisions.
  • Build Python instrumentation for AI agents. Build instrumentation that connects agent runs, model calls, and tool execution, including across asynchronous code. Contribute to evolving OpenTelemetry conventions for generative AI, with care for sensitive data and metric cardinality.
  • Improve Python SDK performance. Use profiling and benchmarks to evaluate implementation approaches with the upstream community. Make sound tradeoffs around runtime overhead, compatibility, and maintainability.
  • Be visible as an OpenTelemetry expert. Teach others, promote best practices around OpenTelemetry, semantic conventions, and various technologies and frameworks. Both within Grafana Labs and in the broader OpenTelemetry community.
  • Support the technical direction and vision of the team, and contribute to business conversations on the OpenTelemetry strategy at Grafana Labs. Own projects from an ambiguous problem through design, implementation, testing, documentation, and release.
  • Partner in an open and respectful way. Lend your knowledge and skills to our GTM, Product and Support teams. Join customer conversations, investigate instrumentation issues, and turn what you learn into fixes and practical guidance.

As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so high agency and good communication skills are a must.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

At Grafana Labs, Staff Engineers are defined by the impact they have and the people they enable. You take ownership of complex problems, set technical direction, and help others deliver improvements that matter to customers and the OpenTelemetry community.

  • 8+ years of experience in software development, with strong proficiency in Python and experience debugging production software, language internals, libraries, and asynchronous code.
  • An interest in AI applications and agent systems, and curiosity about how to instrument and troubleshoot them. Prior experience building AI systems is helpful, but not required.
  • Experience working in open-source communities. You are eager to become an active member of the OpenTelemetry community, collaborate with maintainers and users, and keep learning across languages, frameworks, and the wider observability ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry, alongside experience with cloud-based software or systems engineering. You understand production environments and can assess operational risks.

Bonus Points For:

  • You have experience working on open source observability projects, ideally in OpenTelemetry or Prometheus.
  • Experience in Python instrumentation techniques, profiling, runtime diagnostics, or asynchronous context propagation
  • Experience in a hands-on technical leadership role, setting technical direction and leading project teams
  • Experience instrumenting AI frameworks or agent workflows, or working with OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for generative AI
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining Open Source projects, with evidence of successful pull requests and community collaboration
  • Rust experience is a plus for exploring potential Python SDK performance improvements, including Rust-backed implementations.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the UK, the compensation range for this role is GBP 107,000 - GBP 134,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. descriptionHtml:
Ekimetrics est un leader mondial de l'efficacité marketing et commerciale et des solutions d'IA à l'échelle. Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability. Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services. Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.

Contexte

Les modèles marketing sont mis à jour à mesure que de nouvelles données arrivent : ventes hebdomadaires, résultats de campagnes, comportement des clients. Ils comprennent les marketing mix models (MMM), qui estiment le retour sur investissement de chaque canal média, ainsi que les modèles de demande et de promotion et les modèles de réponse client. Chaque mise à jour fait bouger les estimations, et la première question des métiers est : pourquoi ont-elles bougé ?

Notre équipe a développé une méthode qui y répond de façon exacte pour les modèles bayésiens. Elle répartit le déplacement de toute quantité a posteriori entre des groupes d'observations : semaines, campagnes, régions, segments de clients ou expériences. La méthode est en cours d'évaluation par les pairs. Un premier prototype sur le MMM suit déjà une estimation semaine après semaine et lève une alerte quand une mise à jour la déplace plus que prévu.

Sujet : pourquoi l'estimation a-t-elle bougé ? Attribution bayésienne en ligne pour les modèles marketing.

Volet recherche (environ 3 mois)

• Étendre l'attribution à l'apprentissage bayésien en ligne : mises à jour séquentielles, effets variables dans le temps (modèles linéaires dynamiques, filtre de Kalman), oubli des données anciennes.

• Distinguer les trois causes d'un déplacement à chaque mise à jour : les nouvelles données, un vrai changement du marché et une erreur dans un flux de données.

• Calibrer l'alerte de mise à jour : taux de fausses alertes et délai de détection, sur des données simulées dont la vérité est connue et sur des données publiques, pour le MMM et pour au moins un autre modèle marketing.

• Rédiger un article destiné à un public de statistique ou de marketing science.

Volet produit (environ 3 mois)

• Transformer la méthode en un module Python testé, compatible avec nos outils de modélisation bayésienne (le MMM en premier).

• Construire les sorties destinées aux métiers : une vue « ce qui a fait bouger l'estimation » et une alerte de mise à jour.

• Les valider avec des consultants sur des cas réels, puis les documenter et les transmettre à l'équipe produit.

Livrables attendus

• Un article soumis à une revue ou une conférence à comité de lecture.

• Un module Python testé et documenté, intégré à nos outils de modélisation.

• Un guide court pour les consultants : comment lire et expliquer une attribution.

Profil

• Étudiant ou étudiante en dernière année de master ou d'école d'ingénieurs, en statistique, science des données ou probabilités.

• Statistique bayésienne (prior, posterior, MCMC), et idéalement séries temporelles ou modèles à espace d'états.

• Bonne maîtrise de Python (NumPy, une librairie de programmation probabiliste comme PyMC ou NumPyro), Git, tests unitaires.

• Intérêt pour l'application de la statistique au marketing et pour l'explication des résultats à des non-spécialistes. Aucune connaissance préalable en marketing n'est requise. Rédaction claire en anglais.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent — à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte. Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même. En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations. Nous sommes également certifiés Great Place to Work© en France, au Royaume-Uni et aux Etats-Unis, et notre bureau de Hong Kong a reçu le prix Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023©. descriptionHtml:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

  • Breng de impact op tijd, capaciteit en kosten in kaart.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

descriptionHtml:

Vous souhaitez découvrir concrètement comment se développent les projets de stockage par batteries et contribuer à la transition énergétique ? Au sein de l’équipe Novar en France, vous serez accompagné·e par les équipes de développement et les supports techniques. Vos missions

· Analyses et prédimensionnement du projet de stockage sur la base des informations collectées (caractéristiques du réseau électrique à proximité ; règles d’urbanismes ; enjeux liés à l’occupation du sol, aux accès, au voisinage et aux zonages environnementaux).

· Préparer des supports de synthèse (recherches documentaires, cartographie et tableaux de suivi) et apprendre à faire ressortir les principaux points à approfondir.

· Accompagner les Chef.fe.s de projet en Développement et les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets dans leurs missions et se familiariser avec les démarches de sécurisation foncière, de développement de projets et de permitting sous leurs supervisions.

Votre profil

· Bac +5 type Master ou Ingénieur généraliste ou énergie .

· Un intérêt marqué pour les énergies renouvelables, les systèmes électriques et la transition énergétique.

· À l’aise avec la recherche, l’analyse et la synthèse d’informations, ainsi qu’avec la rédaction de documents clairs.

· Rigueur, autonomie, curiosité et esprit d’équipe.

· Bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques ; la connaissance des outils SIG ou de la réglementation en urbanisme et en environnement constitue un plus.

· Bon niveau de français ; la connaissance de l’anglais est appréciée dans notre environnement international.

Ce que NOVAR vous offre

Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables.

Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte?

💰 Une gratification de stage de 900 € par mois, dans le respect de la réglementation en vigueur.

🚆 Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport en commun.
📚 Des opportunités de développement et de croissance au sein de notre scale-up international.

À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe

Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 200 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse.

Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation.

Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 7 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2035. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain.

title: Stagiair(e) Backend developer
descriptionHtml:
24–38.75 uur per week | Utrecht / hybride | Backend development | Python | €600 | wo-bachelor of master

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Wil jij tijdens je stage bouwen aan software die écht gebruikt wordt? Bij Berenschot werk je mee aan digitale platforms voor gemeenten, zorginstellingen en onderwijsorganisaties. Je ontwikkelt backend applicaties en API’s, denkt mee over slimme technische oplossingen en leert werken met moderne technologieën zoals Python, FastAPI en Azure.

Je draait vanaf dag één mee in een ervaren developmentteam en krijgt veel ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen. We verwachten niet dat je alles al kunt: nieuwsgierigheid, leergierigheid en enthousiasme vinden we belangrijker dan een perfecte technische match.

Dit ga je doen

Binnen Berenschot ontwikkelen en beheren we verschillende digitale platforms en applicaties. Denk aan benchmarkplatformen voor gemeenten en zorginstellingen, subsidieplatformen voor het onderwijs en interne tools voor data- en adviesprojecten.

Als stagiair backend development werk je mee aan het verbeteren, uitbreiden en moderniseren van deze applicaties. Je helpt bij het bouwen van nieuwe functionaliteiten, API’s en cloudoplossingen en leert hoe professionele softwareontwikkeling in de praktijk werkt.

Je houdt je bijvoorbeeld bezig met:

  • Ontwikkelen van backend applicaties en API’s in Python

  • Werken aan performance, schaalbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid van applicaties

  • Meebouwen aan nieuwe platformfunctionaliteiten

  • Ondersteunen bij migraties naar moderne architecturen

  • Samenwerken met frontend developers en andere developers binnen het team

  • Meewerken aan cloudoplossingen en automatisering in Azure

Technologieën waar je mee werkt

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • Azure Functions

  • SQL

  • Next.js

  • GitHub

  • CI/CD

  • Azure

Voorbeelden van projecten

Tijdens je stage werk je mee aan toepassingen die dagelijks gebruikt worden door organisaties in heel Nederland, zoals:

  • Benchmarkplatformen waarmee gemeenten en zorginstellingen inzicht krijgen in hun uitgaven

  • Subsidieplatformen voor onderwijsinstellingen

  • Interne tooling voor data- en adviesprojecten

  • Digitale platformoplossingen binnen onze Solutions Hub

Quote

" Bij Berenschot krijg je vanaf dag één echt de ruimte om mee te bouwen aan serieuze software." – Stagiair bij Berenschot.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je komt terecht in team Digital & Data: een multidisciplinair team van developers, data scientists en data-analisten. We combineren technologie, data en consultancy om digitale oplossingen te bouwen die organisaties echt verder helpen.

De sfeer binnen het team is informeel en collegiaal. Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren developers en krijgt goede begeleiding tijdens je stage.


Dit neem je mee

We zoeken een enthousiaste en leergierige student die graag praktijkervaring wil opdoen in backend development.

Wat we belangrijk vinden:

  • Je volgt een wo-bachelor of master in een technische richting

  • Je hebt ervaring met programmeren in Python, onderbouwd met een portfolio of GitHub-link (vermeld deze in je sollicitatie).

  • Je hebt ervaring met het bouwen van REST API’s en SQL-databases.

  • Ervaring met CMS’en of platformen (zoals Umbraco), API-integraties, migratieprojecten, cloudomgevingen (zoals Azure) en CI/CD-/DevOps-werkwijzen is een pre.

Dit bieden we jou

  • Een stageplek van 4 tot 6 maanden

  • Een stagevergoeding van €600 per maand (op fulltime basis)

  • Flexibele werktijden en hybride werken

  • Goede begeleiding van ervaren developers

  • Veel ruimte om jezelf technisch en professioneel te ontwikkelen

  • Een laptop van Berenschot

  • Een informeel en enthousiast team

  • De kans om mee te bouwen aan software met maatschappelijke impact

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het Stageplusprogramma van Berenschot. In dit programma volg je trainingen op het gebied van adviesvaardigheden, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en samenwerken.

Solliciteer meteen

Spreekt deze stage je aan? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Oumnia Makrani via WhatsApp (06 13 33 87 70) of per e-mail () voor informatie over de procedure. Oumnia is op vrijdag bereikbaar. Heb je een dringende vraag? Mail dan naar .

title: Stagiaire Chargé(e) du développement et du mécénat
descriptionHtml:
Vous souhaitez rejoindre une équipe engagée et bienveillante, prendre part à un projet innovant d’intérêt général qui rassemble l’Etat, les entreprises et l’ensemble des membres de l'écosystème de la RSE sur tout le territoire, acquérir de solides compétences en levée de fonds ainsi qu’un réseau professionnel riche ?

Rejoignez-nous, nous recherchons actuellement notre stagiaire chargé(e) du développement et du mécénat.

Description de la Communauté “Les entreprises s’engagent”

“Les entreprises s’engagent”, c’est la Communauté des entreprises françaises engagées, portée par le Ministère du travail et de l’emploi, France Travail et l’association “Les entreprises s’engagent” qui réunit les mécènes de la Communauté.

Première initiative publique-privée du genre, nous animons des coalitions inédites qui réunissent, dans chaque département français, les entreprises de toutes tailles, mais aussi les services de l'État et les collectivités, des décideurs, des associations et des leaders engagés issus de toutes sphères.

Notre Communauté rassemble à ce jour plus de 100 000 entreprises, 101 clubs départementaux et plus de 500 personnes mobilisées pour faire vivre le mouvement quotidiennement partout en France - avec pour ambition d’atteindre 150 000 entreprises d’ici 2027.

Notre conviction est que l'entreprise, quelle que soit sa taille, a un rôle clé à jouer pour répondre aux grands défis sociaux, sociétaux et environnementaux de notre époque.

Nos missions :

  • Nous donnons aux entreprises les moyens d’agir, via la mise à disposition d’outils et de dispositifs d’engagement clé en main et l’organisation d’événements de sensibilisation et de passage à l’action.

  • Nous fédérons et favorisons le dialogue entre dirigeants d’entreprises engagées partout en France, grâce au 101 clubs départementaux.

  • Nous portons la voix des entreprises engagées, valorisons leurs bonnes pratiques et imaginons collectivement l’entreprise de demain.

Description du pôle développement

Votre stage se déroulera entièrement au sein de l’équipe nationale, en contribuant au pôle chargé du développement de la Communauté et de l'Association des mécènes composé d’une directrice, d’une responsable développement, d’une chargée de développement et d’une responsable marketing.

Le pôle développement a pour mission :

  • d’accompagner, d’outiller et de suivre l’activité des grandes entreprises de la Communauté Les entreprises s’engagent et des réseaux d’entreprises partenaires ;

  • de collecter des fonds auprès d’entreprises mécènes de la Communauté via différentes structures, programmes ou territoires à soutenir ;

  • de redistribuer ces fonds à des projets et structures d’intérêt général via des appels à projets ;

  • d’animer les cercles de mécènes et réseaux de partenaires privés.

Le pôle développement fait le lien avec l’ensemble des autres pôles, afin de synthétiser les programmes et ressources à présenter aux entreprises mécènes.

Aufgaben

Als Tax Tech Specialist (m/w/d) bist du ein zentraler Bestandteil unserer Wertschöpfungskette. title: Talent Acquisition Sourcer, Strategic and Leadership Hiring
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Our Strategic & Leadership Hiring team leads Director, Senior Director, VP and C-suite hiring across functions and global locations. We’re looking for an experienced, research-led recruiter to deliver the market insight, candidate engagement and initial assessment behind these business-critical searches. You’ll own research, sourcing and screening for assigned roles, turning complex briefs into thorough talent maps and credible shortlists. This is a hands-on opportunity to take ownership, work closely with senior stakeholders and help shape Checkout.com’s leadership teams.

What you’ll be doing

  • Turn role briefs into focused search plans. Build thorough company and talent maps, understanding organisational structures, role scope and transferable experience to identify strong candidates beyond the obvious talent pools.

  • Write tailored outreach that gives senior, passive candidates a compelling reason to engage. Build rapport, communicate the opportunity credibly and sustain interest through thoughtful follow-up.

  • Lead substantive screening conversations to explore expertise, achievements, leadership behaviours and motivation. Make evidence-based recommendations, highlighting strengths, gaps and areas for further assessment.

  • Keep multiple searches moving. Get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar roles and markets, prioritise effectively and adapt your approach when feedback or results point to a better route.

  • Build trusted relationships with candidates and stakeholders through responsive communication, discretion and clear expectations. Share concise search updates, candidate summaries and useful market intelligence.

  • Maintain accurate candidate intelligence, market maps and applicant tracking system records. Stay on top of commitments and next steps, and flag search risks early.

  • Use research platforms, market intelligence and AI tools to improve search speed and quality, checking accuracy and protecting confidential information.

What we look for

  • Recruitment experience with substantial hands-on responsibility for research, sourcing and candidate screening, and a track record of building strong pipelines for senior or specialist roles.

  • Thorough market-mapping skills. You can build a clear picture of a talent market, identify relevant organisations and people, and explain the reasoning behind your recommendations.

  • Compelling written and verbal communication. You create personalised outreach, engage senior candidates and ask thoughtful, probing questions.

  • Sound judgement across functional expertise, interpersonal skills and leadership behaviours. You distinguish demonstrated capability from polished presentation and recognise where more evidence is needed.

  • High attention to detail and reliable follow-through. Your candidate notes, research, written updates and records are accurate, organised and handled with discretion.

  • Pace, resilience and adaptability. You learn new briefs quickly, balance competing priorities and respond to unanswered outreach, candidate declines and changing requirements with practical alternatives.

  • A collaborative, low-ego approach. You take ownership, welcome feedback, share insights and ask for help early when needed.

Nice to haves

  • Executive search or search-firm research experience, particularly on confidential leadership appointments.

  • Experience sourcing across fintech, payments or technology, and using AI or market-intelligence tools to strengthen research and outreach.

Why join

You’ll take ownership of meaningful search work, partner with senior decision-makers and build deep knowledge of leadership talent across functions and markets. Your research and judgement will help Checkout.com make better-informed leadership hiring decisions.

Additional Information

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

title: Talent Lead at AIOS- Remote, $100-200k inc equity
descriptionHtml:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Talent Lead at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team. As Talent Lead at AIOS, your fundamental role is to supercharge our talent (recruiting) function, ensuring that a lack of key hires never blocks growth. You’ll help define what a killer sourcing process looks like while leveraging frontier tooling to increase your throughput and velocity as you recruit best-in-class operators.

You’ll work across a variety of roles: traditional direct-to-consumer Growth roles (Performance Marketing), technical roles (AI + SWE Engineering & Product), and clinical roles — flexing deftly between more junior roles all the way up to the most senior roles in the org.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice — as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports, full-cycle sourcing/screening/closing, hands dirty in the trenches. You’ll report directly to Cierra Olsen (Head of Talent).

You’ll also work closely with the rest of the Talent Team: Zoe Wheeler (UK Talent Lead), Mika Mansilla (Founder Associate), and Jordan Pellikan (VP Ops).

Key responsibilities

  • Full cycle: Own searches end to end from sourcing, outbound, screening, interview coordination, calibration, and closing (recent examples: Head of InfoSec, Head of Creative, Senior Media Buyer, Affiliate Lead).

  • Sourcing: Build repeatable sourcing engines for hard-to-fill roles. Run LinkedIn X-ray searches, build target-company lists, and do the outbound headhunting yourself. Our best hires won’t come inbound.

  • Processes: Constantly sharpen our hiring bars (seniority, industry fit, recency, builder pattern) consistently across every search you’re DRI for. Help improve interview processes across the org.

  • Hygiene: Keep pipelines, stages, and candidate communication clean and current in Ashby so nothing stalls and our time to hire continually improves.

  • Calibration: Flag pipeline risk early, bring calibration questions before they become misses, and constantly align with leaders across the org to improve our processes.

  • Closing: Manage candidate experience through to signed offer, including comp conversations.

KPIs

  • Time-to-fill on your owned searches, without sacrificing the bar

  • Sourced (outbound) candidates as a % of your total pipeline — we want you building your own pipeline, not living off inbound

  • Offer-accept rate on closed candidates

  • Ashby pipeline hygiene — stages and candidate status always current

Need to have

  • Excellence: You have 5+ years experience personally recruiting (sourcing, screening, managing, and closing) great candidates across difficult searches. You can point to hires that materially raised the talent bar of the teams they joined.

  • Hunter: You can turn a vague candidate profile into target companies, search strings and a high-quality outbound pipeline. You do not depend on inbound applicants or agencies to fill roles.

  • Senior hiring: You have successfully recruited senior leaders and understand how sourcing, assessing and closing them differs from junior hiring.

  • Judgment: You can distinguish exceptional people from candidates who simply have the right companies, titles or polish on their CV. You develop conviction quickly and can clearly articulate why someone does or does not meet the bar.

  • Range: You can move between very different searches without losing depth. You learn unfamiliar markets quickly enough to recruit credibly within them.

  • Multi-workstream: You can run several searches simultaneously while keeping sourcing quality, candidate communication, follow-ups and pipeline hygiene exceptionally tight.

  • Urgency: You push searches forward without waiting to be managed, surface problems early, and change approach quickly when a pipeline is not working.

  • High bar: You care more about making an exceptional hire than filling a seat, and you are comfortable challenging hiring managers when you do not believe a candidate meets org standards.

Nice to have

  • Startups/Scale-ups: You’ve recruited in a fast-moving startup or scale-up where priorities shift quickly, roles evolve mid-search, and there isn’t always an existing playbook.

  • Technical recruiting: You’ve successfully recruited for Engineering, AI, Data, Product or other technical roles and can credibly assess candidate quality beyond surface-level credentials.

  • Regulated industries: You’ve recruited in healthcare, financial services, or another highly regulated industry where candidate requirements and operating constraints are more complex.

  • AI-native: You actively use AI and automation to improve sourcing, research, outreach, screening, and recruiting operations.

  • Systems builder: You’ve helped build or materially improve recruiting processes, tooling, scorecards, sourcing systems, or interview loops rather than simply operating an existing process.

  • Network: You have an existing network of exceptional operators, builders and leaders you’d be excited to bring into AIOS.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.
