title: Technical Delivery Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Technical Delivery Analyst

Remote (UK-based)

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're hiring the first dedicated Technical Delivery Analyst. You will own the delivery of software projects end-to-end — from requirements through to production — working alongside engineers to ensure work lands on time, risks are visible, and stakeholders always know where things stand. As our engineering organisation grows into more specialised teams, you are the person who sits across the space between them — owning the dependencies, coordination, and communication that no single team owns.

This is not an administrative role. You need to understand the technology being built, speak credibly with engineers about architecture and trade-offs, and translate technical reality into clear communication for the business. You are the person who knows what is happening, why it matters, and what might go wrong — and you make sure everyone else knows too.

You will work closely with the Head of Technical Delivery and daily with Engineering, TechOps, and Product, with regular interaction with client-facing teams (Sales, Client Services). The role offers a clear path to Delivery Manager as the team grows and you take on broader ownership.

What You'll Work On

Delivery Ownership:

  • Own projects from inception to production — responsible for outcomes, not just process

  • Understand technical scope, architecture, and dependencies well enough to anticipate problems before they surface

  • Ensure infrastructure, testing, performance, and operational readiness are considered from the start

  • Know the current state of your projects at all times

Communication:

  • Communicate early and often — bad news delivered early is manageable; bad news delivered late is a crisis

  • Provide honest, accurate status updates — never spin, never hide, never assume someone else will raise it

  • Tailor to the audience — technical detail for engineers, business impact for leadership, actionable clarity for everyone

Technical Engagement:

  • Participate meaningfully in technical discussions — you don't write code, but you understand what is being built and why

  • Engage with engineers on architecture, dependencies, and integration points to accurately assess delivery risk

  • Bridge engineering and business by translating technical constraints into language stakeholders can act on

Risk Management:

  • Identify risks early through genuine understanding of the work, not by reading ticket statuses

  • Escalate with context — what is the risk, what is the impact, what are the options

  • Contribute to post-incident reviews with a delivery lens — impact, learnings, prevention

Continuous Improvement:

  • Look for friction in how work flows and propose practical improvements

  • Experiment with AI tooling to improve delivery efficiency — reporting, analysis, coordination, and communication

  • Maintain delivery tooling as a means to an end, not an end in itself

What We Need

Technical:

  • 2+ years' experience in technical delivery, project management, or software engineering

  • Previously worked as a software developer, or strong hands-on technical experience with software systems

  • Comfortable reading code, reviewing pull requests for context, and understanding technical trade-offs without simplification

  • Knows what "done" looks like in production — tested, deployed, monitored, documented

  • Familiarity with Agile practices and tools (Jira, Confluence) — values principles over ceremony

  • Financial services or trading technology experience is a strong advantage

How you work:

  • You own it. End-to-end responsibility. If it's your project, it's your problem — you don't wait for someone to tell you something is off

  • You communicate clearly. Exceptional written and verbal communication. Concise, precise, and honest under pressure. Confident raising difficult topics early — with engineers, stakeholders, and leadership alike — and you absorb pushback as readily as you give it, redirecting heat toward the outcome rather than taking it personally

  • You build trust. Engineers respect people who understand the work, tell the truth, and follow through — not a title. You are genuinely interested in the people you work with, and over time they bring you problems before those problems reach a ticket

  • You steady the room. When a project is drifting or an incident is live, you lower the temperature rather than raise it — calm, calibrated, and focused on what needs to happen next

  • You think in outcomes. Updating a board is not the same as delivering software. You impose structure where needed without over-engineering process

  • You stay technically curious. You genuinely want to understand how systems work and fit together. You don't simplify away the complexity that matters

  • You write things down. Documentation is how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You exercise judgement. You know when to escalate, when to solve, and when to ask for help

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools to amplify our delivery capability — from reporting and analysis to coordination and communication. You should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real delivery problems — owning end-to-end project outcomes on a market-leading trading platform with genuine scale and technical depth

  • Breadth of exposure — work across the full engineering organisation: backend, frontend, platform, infrastructure, and TechOps

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Direct mentorship — access to the Head of Technical Delivery for coaching, feedback, and professional development

  • Career progression — a clear path to Delivery Manager as the team grows and you take on broader ownership

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Senior Leadership Conversation with our CTO

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

 

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy [link to be added].

title: Technical Programme Manager
descriptionHtml:

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at significantly reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards real-world deployment, you’ll have genuine ownership of your area, working alongside a highly technical team of physicists, engineers and software specialists on one of the hardest problems in AI infrastructure.

This role sits at the centre of how Salience Labs turns complex, multi-disciplinary engineering work into delivered hardware. You will drive our technical programmes from design through tape-out, fabrication, test and qualification, keeping photonics, electronics, firmware, test and packaging teams aligned and moving towards clear milestones.

We are looking for someone with an engineering background who has moved into programme or project management and still enjoys getting into the technical detail. You will be credible with engineers, able to understand the real constraints and dependencies, and able to turn them into plans, priorities and decisions that keep work moving.

You will work in a fast-paced, deep-tech environment where the work spans external partners as well as internal teams, and where clear ownership, early risk flagging and disciplined execution make a real difference to how quickly we get to deployment.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the delivery of cross-functional technical programmes, from planning through to milestone completion

  • Build and maintain integrated plans, timelines and critical paths across photonics, electronics, firmware, test and packaging

  • Translate technical requirements and engineering constraints into clear scope, priorities and deliverables

  • Identify, track and escalate risks, dependencies and blockers early, and drive them to resolution

  • Coordinate tape-outs, fabrication runs and build cycles with external foundry, manufacturing and test partners

  • Run regular programme reviews, stand-ups and milestone gates, with clear actions and accountability

  • Report progress, risks and trade-offs to engineering leads and senior leadership with data-led clarity

  • Work with engineering teams to define test readiness, qualification plans and release criteria

  • Manage supplier and partner schedules, deliverables and communication

  • Continuously improve programme management processes, tooling and ways of working

  • Maintain clear documentation of decisions, plans and programme status

What we’re looking for

  • A degree in Engineering, Physics or a closely related technical discipline

  • Experience delivering complex technical programmes or projects in hardware, semiconductor, photonics, electronics or similar deep-tech environments

  • An engineering background, with hands-on technical experience before moving into programme or project management

  • A strong understanding of hardware development lifecycles, such as design, prototyping, build, test and qualification

  • Experience coordinating multi-disciplinary teams and working with external partners, suppliers or foundries

  • Proven ability to plan rigorously, manage dependencies and critical paths, and keep projects moving under changing priorities

  • Strong technical understanding, with the ability to discuss detail with engineers and challenge assumptions constructively

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

  • A structured, proactive and outcome-driven approach, with strong attention to detail

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving deep-tech environment

Even better if you

  • Have experience with photonics/ semiconductor industry

  • Have managed programmes through new product introduction, from prototype to production

  • Have experience with qualification, reliability or manufacturing ramp

  • Hold a recognised project or programme management qualification (for example PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile)

  • Are experienced with programme tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project or similar

  • Have worked in a scale-up or early-stage deep-tech company

  • Have experience line-managing or coordinating a team of project or technical staff

You will join a highly ambitious deep-tech company operating at the intersection of AI infrastructure, semiconductors, and photonics. We are building foundational technology with the potential to reshape the performance envelope of future AI systems.

If you want to apply your engineering background to driving hard, multi-disciplinary hardware programmes at the frontier of AI infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Traffic & Acquisition Manager SEO, SEA et GEO
descriptionHtml:
CDI à mi-temps évolutif vers un temps plein
17 h 30 par semaine
Pacé, près de Rennes
Prise de poste dès que possible

---

Size Up est une agence de marketing et de communication qui accompagne ses clients de la stratégie de marque jusqu’à l’acquisition.

  • Notre conviction : du branding à l’acquisition, chaque détail compte.

Nous travaillons principalement avec des entreprises B2B, mais également sur certains projets B2C. Notre équipe réunit aujourd’hui cinq personnes, en interne et en externe, avec des expertises complémentaires en stratégie, création, communication, acquisition et production de contenus.

  • Pour renforcer notre pôle acquisition, nous recherchons un Traffic & Acquisition Manager capable de générer du trafic qualifié, mais surtout de mesurer sa contribution aux objectifs commerciaux de nos clients.

Vos missions

Vous pilotez les différents leviers permettant d’améliorer la visibilité, le trafic, la génération de leads et les conversions de nos clients.

Vous intervenez aussi bien sur l’acquisition payante que sur le référencement naturel et l’optimisation de la présence des marques dans les moteurs de recherche et les outils d’intelligence artificielle.

Votre rôle ne consiste pas seulement à lancer des campagnes ou à produire des contenus. Vous devez comprendre les objectifs du client, sélectionner les bons leviers, suivre les résultats et optimiser continuellement les actions engagées.

---

Acquisition payante :

Vous concevez, déployez et optimisez des campagnes publicitaires sur différentes plateformes :

  • Google Ads
  • Microsoft Advertising
  • Meta Ads
  • LinkedIn Ads
  • YouTube Ads
  • ChatGPT Ads
  • Toute autre plateforme pertinente selon les objectifs et les audiences du client

Vous assurez la structuration des comptes, le paramétrage des campagnes, la gestion des audiences, le suivi des budgets, la création ou la coordination des annonces, les tests et l’optimisation des performances.

---

SEO, contenus et GEO :

Vous réalisez des audits SEO et identifiez les actions à mener sur les dimensions techniques, sémantiques, éditoriales et de popularité.

Vous prenez notamment en charge :

  • La recherche de mots-clés et l’analyse des intentions de recherche
  • La construction de stratégies et de calendriers éditoriaux
  • La génération, la rédaction et l’optimisation d’articles
  • L’intégration et la publication des contenus dans WordPress
  • L’optimisation des pages existantes
  • Le maillage interne
  • L’identification des problèmes techniques
  • Le suivi de l’indexation et des positions
  • L’optimisation de la visibilité dans les moteurs de recherche
  • Le développement de la visibilité dans les assistants et moteurs alimentés par l’intelligence artificielle
  • La veille sur les évolutions du SEO, du GEO et des nouveaux usages de recherche

---

Mesure et pilotage de la performance :

Vous mettez en place les outils nécessaires pour mesurer précisément les résultats obtenus.

Vous êtes capable de répondre à des questions simples mais essentielles :

  • Combien l’action a-t-elle coûté ?
  • Combien de trafic a-t-elle généré ?
  • Combien de prospects ou de ventes a-t-elle produits ?
  • Quel est le coût par lead ou par acquisition ?
  • Quel est le retour sur investissement ?
  • Que faut-il arrêter, maintenir, tester ou intensifier ?

Vous construisez des tableaux de bord, analysez les KPI et produisez des comptes rendus clairs et exploitables pour les clients.

Conseil et relation client

Vous participez aux réunions de suivi avec les clients.

Vous présentez les résultats obtenus, expliquez les écarts, recommandez les prochaines actions et êtes force de proposition.

Vous savez transformer des données parfois complexes en conclusions compréhensibles et en décisions concrètes.

---

Les outils à maîtriser idéalement :

Vous devez être opérationnel sur une grande partie des outils suivants :

  • Google Ads
  • Google Analytics 4
  • Google Search Console
  • Google Tag Manager
  • Looker Studio
  • Semrush
  • Ahrefs
  • Screaming Frog
  • WordPress
  • Meta Business Manager
  • LinkedIn Campaign Manager
  • Microsoft Advertising

La maîtrise de l’intelligence artificielle est obligatoire. Vous utilisez avec discernement ChatGPT, Claude ou d’autres solutions selon les besoins : recherche, analyse, rédaction, automatisation, idéation, audit et optimisation.

Nous ne recherchons pas quelqu’un qui confie sa réflexion à l’IA, mais une personne capable de l’utiliser pour travailler plus vite, approfondir ses analyses et améliorer la qualité de ses productions.

Vos compétences

Le profil recherché

Vous justifiez d’au moins trois ans d’expérience sur un poste en acquisition digitale, traffic management, SEO, SEA ou performance marketing. Une expérience de trois à cinq ans, idéalement en agence ou auprès de plusieurs clients, est attendue.

Vous êtes :

  • Autonome dans l’organisation et l’exécution de vos missions
  • À l’aise avec les chiffres, les KPI et l’analyse de données
  • Capable de gérer plusieurs comptes clients simultanément
  • Rigoureux dans le suivi des budgets et des performances
  • À l’aise à l’écrit comme à l’oral
  • Capable de rédiger et d’optimiser des contenus
  • Force de proposition
  • Curieux et persévérant
  • Capable de remettre en question une campagne ou une stratégie qui ne produit pas les résultats attendus

Vous n’avez pas besoin de maîtriser parfaitement toutes les plateformes dès votre arrivée. En revanche, vous devez disposer de bases solides en Google Ads, SEO, analytics et tracking, ainsi que d’une réelle capacité à apprendre et à expérimenter.

---

La veille fait partie du poste

Chez Size Up, la veille n’est pas une activité occasionnelle réalisée en dehors du temps de travail.

Elle fait pleinement partie des missions et peut être réalisée pendant les heures de travail. Nous attendons de la personne recrutée qu’elle explore les nouveaux outils, teste de nouvelles méthodes, suive les évolutions des plateformes et partage ses découvertes avec l’équipe.

Cette veille doit cependant rester orientée vers l’action : tester, mesurer, documenter et déterminer ce qui peut réellement améliorer les résultats de nos clients.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à mi-temps
  • 17 h 30 par semaine
  • Poste évolutif vers un temps plein selon les compétences développées, les résultats obtenus et les souhaits du salarié
  • Rémunération : 1800 € à 2300€ net selon profil
  • Convention collective Syntec
  • Statut et classification déterminés selon le profil retenu et les dispositions de la convention collective
  • Période d’essai : 3 mois
  • Bureaux : à Pacé, près de Rennes
  • Télétravail : 1 jour /semaine pendant la période d’essai, puis 2 jours /semaine après validation de la période d’essai
  • 7 semaines de congés payés
  • Prise de poste dès que possible

Pour candidater

Envoyez-nous votre CV, accompagné de quelques exemples concrets de campagnes, audits, contenus ou résultats obtenus.

Au-delà des certifications et des intitulés de poste, nous souhaitons comprendre votre manière de travailler :

  • Les budgets que vous avez pilotés
  • Les résultats que vous avez obtenus
  • Les KPI que vous avez suivis
  • Les optimisations que vous avez mises en place
  • Les tests qui ont fonctionné
  • Les erreurs ou échecs dont vous avez tiré des enseignements

Si vous aimez chercher, tester, mesurer et améliorer, nous serons ravis d’échanger avec vous.

title: Warehouse Associate - Part Time
descriptionHtml:
Warehouse Associate

Location: Hoxton (E2)

Working pattern: Onsite | Part-time | Shift-based (15 hours per week)

Pay: £14.40 per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Associate to join our Hoxton team. Our Warehouse Associates are the beating heart of our day-to-day site operations. You’ll work closely with your management team to ensure our loyal customers get what they want when they need it, ensuring the smooth running of our Hop sites.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Execute precise order fulfillment by picking customer essentials quickly and accurately to meet delivery deadlines.

  • Maintain product integrity by ensuring all goods received and dispatched meet our high standards for freshness and quality.

  • Facilitate seamless logistics through clear communication with riders to ensure prompt order handovers.

  • Drive inventory excellence by supporting the intake of daily stock deliveries and assisting with ongoing inventory management.

  • Champion site safety and standards by maintaining a clean, organized warehouse environment for the whole team.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Adaptability in fast-paced environments, with the ability to remain focused under pressure.

  • Strong attention to detail to ensure order accuracy and high-quality stock control.

  • Effective communication skills to collaborate with teammates, managers, and riders.

  • A proactive, hands-on mentality with a drive to solve problems as they arise on-site.

  • A customer-first mindset, understanding that your speed and accuracy directly impact the user experience.

  • Previous experience in FMCG, Retail, or Warehouse environments is valued but not required.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, operations are central to how we build trust across our marketplace. You’ll work in a fast-paced environment where service excellence drives real impact.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences across our three-sided marketplace.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills with structured progression pathways and real opportunities to move into management.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively to achieve shared goals in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

  • 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Enjoy the benefits of shift-based work that fits your schedule.

Our Interview Process

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine:

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

title: Wordpress Web Developer at United Media
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Wordpress Web Developer.

About us

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

As our Wordpress Web Developer you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our company website. You'll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact in a fast-growing business - You'll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work within a highly talented and motivated team.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your technical, interpersonal, organisation and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Improving the overall performance of our Wordpress website.
  • Developing an exceptional platform for the effective sharing of information between our business and the key stakeholders that we are targeting.
  • Optimising the structure and display of existing and new information on our website.
  • Working cross functionally to identify and tackle business needs to drive its growth.
  • Quickly and effectively supporting our teams through any technical difficulties that they may experience.

What we expect from you

We are looking for a person to take full ownership over our Website's management. Thus, extensive knowledge of Wordpress is required - please share some examples of your work, we would love to see that!

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible

Monday - Friday we work from our office (next to Victoria Station) and do not offer remote work.
